verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis kee sirasaT su karanaihaar ||
verses.translation: He is the Creator Lord of His world.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਬੂਝਿ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: avar na boojh karat beechaar ||
verses.translation: No one else understands Him, although they may try.

verses.original: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: karate kee mit na jaanai keeaa ||
verses.translation: The created cannot know the extent of the Creator.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਵਰਤੀਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak jo tis bhaavai so varateeaa ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whatever pleases Him comes to pass. ||7||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: bisaman bisam bhe bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon His wondrous wonder, I am wonder-struck and amazed!

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: jin boojhiaa tis aaiaa savaiaadh ||
verses.translation: One who realizes this, comes to taste this state of joy.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਜਨ ਰਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai ra(n)g raach jan rahe ||
verses.translation: God's humble servants remain absorbed in His Love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan padhaarath lahe ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, they receive the four cardinal blessings.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: oi dhaate dhukh kaaTanahaar ||
verses.translation: They are the givers, the dispellers of pain.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai sa(n)g tarai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: In their company, the world is saved.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jan kaa sevak so vaddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: The slave of the Lord's servant is so very blessed.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jan kai sa(n)g ek liv laagee ||
verses.translation: In the company of His servant, one becomes attached to the Love of the One.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gun gobidh keeratan jan gaavai ||
verses.translation: His humble servant sings the Kirtan, the songs of the glory of God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak fal paavai ||8||16||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, he receives the fruits of his rewards. ||8||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadh sach jugaadh sach ||
verses.translation: True in the beginning, True throughout the ages,

verses.original: ਹੈ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hai bh sach naanak hosee bh sach ||1||
verses.translation: True here and now. O Nanak, He shall forever be True. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: asaTapadhee ||
verses.translation: Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਸਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: charan sat sat parasanahaar ||
verses.translation: His Lotus Feet are True, and True are those who touch Them.

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੇਵਦਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa sat sat sevadhaar ||
verses.translation: His devotional worship is True, and True are those who worship Him.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan sat sat pekhanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Blessing of His Vision is True, and True are those who behold it.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naam sat sat dhiaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: His Naam is True, and True are those who meditate on it.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਭ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aap sat sat sabh dhaaree ||
verses.translation: He Himself is True, and True is all that He sustains.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape gun aape gunakaaree ||
verses.translation: He Himself is virtuous goodness, and He Himself is the Bestower of virtue.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh sat sat prabh bakataa ||
verses.translation: The Word of His Shabad is True, and True are those who speak of God.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: surat sat sat jas sunataa ||
verses.translation: Those ears are True, and True are those who listen to His Praises.

verses.original: ਬੁਝਨਹਾਰ ਕਉ ਸਤਿ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bujhanahaar kau sat sabh hoi ||
verses.translation: All is True to one who understands.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sat sat prabh soi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, True, True is He, the Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sat saroop ridhai jin maaniaa ||
verses.translation: One who believes in the Embodiment of Truth with all his heart

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan tin mool pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: recognizes the Cause of causes as the Root of all.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai ridhai bisavaiaas prabh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with faith in God

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tat giaan tis man pragaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: the essence of spiritual wisdom is revealed to his mind.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਬਸਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhai te nirabhau hoi basaanaa ||
verses.translation: Coming out of fear, he comes to live without fear.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis te upajiaa tis maeh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: He is absorbed into the One, from whom he originated.

verses.original: ਬਸਤੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਲੇ ਬਸਤੁ ਗਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: basat maeh le basat gaddaiee ||
verses.translation: When something blends with its own,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕਹਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau bhi(n)n na kahanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: it cannot be said to be separate from it.

verses.original: ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: boojhai boojhanahaar bibek ||
verses.translation: This is understood only by one of discerning understanding.

verses.original: ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naarain mile naanak ek ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord, O Nanak, he becomes one with Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur kaa sevak aagiaakaaree ||
verses.translation: The servant is obedient to his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur kaa sevak sadhaa poojaaree ||
verses.translation: The servant worships his Lord and Master forever.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur ke sevak kai man parateet ||
verses.translation: The servant of the Lord Master has faith in his mind.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur ke sevak kee niramal reet ||
verses.translation: The servant of the Lord Master lives a pure lifestyle.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur kau sevak jaanai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The servant of the Lord Master knows that the Lord is with him.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kaa sevak naam kai ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: God's servant is attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevak kau prabh paalanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: God is the Cherisher of His servant.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevak kee raakhai nira(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Formless Lord preserves His servant.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so sevak jis dhiaa prabh dhaarai ||
verses.translation: Unto His servant, God bestows His Mercy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak so sevak saas saas samaarai ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that servant remembers Him with each and every breath. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪਰਦਾ ਢਾਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: apune jan kaa paradhaa ddaakai ||
verses.translation: He covers the faults of His servant.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਪਰ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: apane sevak kee sarapar raakhai ||
verses.translation: He surely preserves the honor of His servant.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: apane dhaas kau dhei vaddaiee ||
verses.translation: He blesses His slave with greatness.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: apane sevak kau naam japaiee ||
verses.translation: He inspires His servant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: apane sevak kee aap pat raakhai ||
verses.translation: He Himself preserves the honor of His servant.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee gat mit koi na laakhai ||
verses.translation: No one knows His state and extent.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ke sevak kau ko na pahoochai ||
verses.translation: No one is equal to the servant of God.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ke sevak uooch te uooche ||
verses.translation: The servant of God is the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo prabh apanee sevaa laiaa ||
verses.translation: One whom God applies to His own service, O Nanak

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak so sevak dheh dhis pragaTaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: - that servant is famous in the ten directions. ||4||

verses.original: ਨੀਕੀ ਕੀਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: neekee keeree meh kal raakhai ||
verses.translation: He infuses His Power into the tiny ant;

verses.original: ਭਸਮ ਕਰੈ ਲਸਕਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhasam karai lasakar koT laakhai ||
verses.translation: it can then reduce the armies of millions to ashes

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਢਤ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa saas na kaaddat aap ||
verses.translation: Those whose breath of life He Himself does not take away

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau raakhat dhe kar haath ||
verses.translation: He preserves them, and holds out His Hands to protect them.

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: maanas jatan karat bahu bhaat ||
verses.translation: You may make all sorts of efforts,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis ke karatab birathe jaat ||
verses.translation: but these attempts are in vain.

verses.original: ਮਾਰੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maarai na raakhai avar na koi ||
verses.translation: No one else can kill or preserve

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jeeaa kaa raakhaa soi ||
verses.translation: He is the Protector of all beings.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe soch kareh re praanee ||
verses.translation: So why are you so anxious, O mortal?

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਲਖ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jap naanak prabh alakh viddaanee ||5||
verses.translation: Meditate, O Nanak, on God, the invisible, the wonderful! ||5||

verses.original: ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: baara(n) baar baar prabh japeeaai ||
verses.translation: Time after time, again and again, meditate on God.

verses.original: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਪੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: pee a(n)mrit ih man tan dhrapeeaai ||
verses.translation: Drinking in this Nectar, this mind and body are satisfied.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan jin gurmukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: The jewel of the Naam is obtained by the Gurmukhs;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis kichh avar naahee dhirasaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: they see no other than God.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhan naamo roop ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Unto them, the Naam is wealth, the Naam is beauty and delight.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naamo sukh har naam kaa sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The Naam is peace, the Lord's Name is their companion.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam ras jo jan tirapataane ||
verses.translation: Those who are satisfied by the essence of the Naam

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan naameh naam samaane ||
verses.translation: their minds and bodies are drenched with the Naam.

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat sovat naam ||
verses.translation: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, the Naam,

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕਾਮ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jan kai sadh kaam ||6||
verses.translation: says Nanak, is forever the occupation of God's humble servant. ||6||

verses.original: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bolahu jas jihabaa dhin raat ||
verses.translation: Chant His Praises with your tongue, day and night.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਜਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apanai jan keenee dhaat ||
verses.translation: God Himself has given this gift to His servants.

verses.original: ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਤਮ ਕੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kareh bhagat aatam kai chai ||
verses.translation: Performing devotional worship with heart-felt love,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apane siau raheh samai ||
verses.translation: they remain absorbed in God Himself.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹੋਆ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo hoaa hovat so jaanai ||
verses.translation: They know the past and the present.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apane kaa hukam pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: They recognize God's Own Command.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਉਨ ਬਖਾਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee mahimaa kaun bakhaanau ||
verses.translation: Who can describe His Glory?

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa gun keh ek na jaanau ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe even one of His virtuous qualities.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar prabh baseh hajoore ||
verses.translation: Those who dwell in God's Presence, twenty-four hours a day

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak seiee jan poore ||7||
verses.translation: - says Nanak, they are the perfect persons. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: man mere tin kee oT leh ||
verses.translation: O my mind, seek their protection;

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan apanaa tin jan dheh ||
verses.translation: give your mind and body to those humble beings.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin jan apanaa prabhoo pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who recognizes God

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: so jan sarab thok kaa dhaataa ||
verses.translation: are the givers of all things.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee saran sarab sukh paaveh ||
verses.translation: In His Sanctuary, all comforts are obtained.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਮਿਟਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis kai dharas sabh paap miTaaveh ||
verses.translation: By the Blessing of His Darshan, all sins are erased.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਡੁ ॥
verses.translit: avar siaanap sagalee chhaadd ||
verses.translation: So renounce all other clever devices,

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan kee too sevaa laag ||
verses.translation: and enjoin yourself to the service of those servants.

verses.original: ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan na hovee teraa ||
verses.translation: Your comings and goings shall be ended.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਸਦ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak tis jan ke poojahu sadh pairaa ||8||17||
verses.translation: O Nanak, worship the feet of God's humble servants forever. ||8||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sat purakh jin jaaniaa satigur tis kaa naau ||
verses.translation: The one who knows the True Lord God, is called the True Guru.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis kai sa(n)g sikh udharai naanak har gun gaau ||1||
verses.translation: In His Company, the Sikh is saved, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: asaTapadhee ||
verses.translation: Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sikh kee karai pratipaal ||
verses.translation: The True Guru cherishes His Sikh.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: sevak kau gur sadhaa dhiaal ||
verses.translation: The Guru is always merciful to His servant.

verses.original: ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sikh kee gur dhuramat mal hirai ||
verses.translation: The Guru washes away the filth of the evil intellect of His Sikh.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee har naam ucharai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, he chants the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sikh ke ba(n)dhan kaaTai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru cuts away the bonds of His Sikh.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sikh bikaar te haaTai ||
verses.translation: The Sikh of the Guru abstains from evil deeds.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sikh kau naam dhan dhei ||
verses.translation: The True Guru gives His Sikh the wealth of the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sikh vaddabhaagee he ||
verses.translation: The Sikh of the Guru is very fortunate.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਾ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sikh kaa halat palat savaarai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru arranges this world and the next for His Sikh.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur sikh kau jeea naal samaarai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, with the fullness of His heart, the True Guru mends His Sikh. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai gireh sevak jo rahai ||
verses.translation: That selfless servant, who lives in the Guru's household,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee aagiaa man meh sahai ||
verses.translation: is to obey the Guru's Commands with all his mind.

verses.original: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aapas kau kar kachh na janaavai ||
verses.translation: He is not to call attention to himself in any way.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam ridhai sadh dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: He is to meditate constantly within his heart on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: man bechai satigur kai paas ||
verses.translation: One who sells his mind to the True Guru

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis sevak ke kaaraj raas ||
verses.translation: - that humble servant's affairs are resolved.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa karat hoi nihakaamee ||
verses.translation: One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau hot paraapat suaamee ||
verses.translation: shall attain his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: apanee kirapaa jis aap karei ||
verses.translation: He Himself grants His Grace;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so sevak gur kee mat lei ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that selfless servant lives the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: bees bisave gur kaa man maanai ||
verses.translation: One who obeys the Guru's Teachings one hundred per cent

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: so sevak paramesur kee gat jaanai ||
verses.translation: that selfless servant comes to know the state of the Transcendent Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur jis ridhai har naau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru's Heart is filled with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik baar gur kau bal jaau ||
verses.translation: So many times, I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nidhaan jeea kaa dhaataa ||
verses.translation: He is the treasure of everything, the Giver of life.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar paarabraham ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, He is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: braham meh jan jan meh paarabraham ||
verses.translation: The servant is in God, and God is in the servant.

verses.original: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: ekeh aap nahee kachh bharam ||
verses.translation: He Himself is One - there is no doubt about this.

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sahas siaanap liaa na jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: By thousands of clever tricks, He is not found.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak aaisaa gur baddabhaagee paieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, such a Guru is obtained by the greatest good fortune. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: safal dharasan pekhat puneet ||
verses.translation: Blessed is His Darshan; receiving it, one is purified.

verses.original: ਪਰਸਤ ਚਰਨ ਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: parasat charan gat niramal reet ||
verses.translation: Touching His Feet, one's conduct and lifestyle become pure.

verses.original: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: bheTat sa(n)g raam gun rave ||
verses.translation: Abiding in His Company, one chants the Lord's Praise,

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham kee dharageh gave ||
verses.translation: and reaches the Court of the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਕਰਨ ਆਘਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: sun kar bachan karan aaghaane ||
verses.translation: Listening to His Teachings, one's ears are satisfied.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਆਤਮ ਪਤੀਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: man sa(n)tokh aatam pateeaane ||
verses.translation: The mind is contented, and the soul is fulfilled.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੵਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa gur akhayeo jaa kaa ma(n)tr ||
verses.translation: The Guru is perfect; His Teachings are everlasting.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat dhirasaT pekhai hoi sa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Beholding His Ambrosial Glance, one becomes saintly.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun bia(n)t keemat nahee pai ||
verses.translation: Endless are His virtuous qualities; His worth cannot be appraised.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak jis bhaavai tis le milai ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who pleases Him is united with Him. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਏਕ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: jihabaa ek usatat anek ||
verses.translation: The tongue is one, but His Praises are many.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੋਲ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sat purakh pooran bibek || kaahoo bol na pahuchat praanee ||
verses.translation: The True Lord, of perfect perfection - no speech can take the mortal to Him.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar prabh nirabaanee ||
verses.translation: God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, balanced in the state of Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: niraahaar niravair sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: He is not sustained by food; He has no hatred or vengeance; He is the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat kinai na paiee ||
verses.translation: No one can estimate His worth.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਬੰਦਨ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik bhagat ba(n)dhan nit kareh ||
verses.translation: Countless devotees continually bow in reverence to Him.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal hiradhai simareh ||
verses.translation: In their hearts, they meditate on His Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: sadh balihaaree satigur apane ||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jis prasaadh aaisaa prabh japane ||5||
verses.translation: by His Grace, he meditates on God. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih har ras paavai jan koi ||
verses.translation: Only a few obtain this ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit peevai amar so hoi ||
verses.translation: Drinking in this Nectar, one becomes immortal.

verses.original: ਉਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਨਤਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: aus purakh kaa naahee kadhe binaas || jaa kai man pragaTe gunataas ||
verses.translation: That person whose mind is illuminated by the treasure of excellence, never dies.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har kaa naam lei ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach upadhes sevak kau dhei ||
verses.translation: The Lord gives true instruction to His servant.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: moh maiaa kai sa(n)g na lep ||
verses.translation: He is not polluted by emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: man meh raakhai har har ek ||
verses.translation: In his mind, he cherishes the One Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਕ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhakaar dheepak paragaase ||
verses.translation: In the pitch darkness, a lamp shines forth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਤਹ ਤੇ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak bharam moh dhukh teh te naase ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, doubt, emotional attachment and pain are erased. ||6||

verses.original: ਤਪਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਠਾਢਿ ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tapat maeh Thaadd varataiee ||
verses.translation: In the burning heat, a soothing coolness prevails.

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anadh bhiaa dhukh naaThe bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Happiness ensues and pain departs, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran ke miTe a(n)dhese ||
verses.translation: The fear of birth and death is dispelled,

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਉਪਦੇਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo ke pooran upadhese ||
verses.translation: by the perfect Teachings of the Holy Saint.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਚੂਕਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਬਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhau chookaa nirabhau hoi base ||
verses.translation: Fear is lifted, and one abides in fearlessness.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਖੈ ਨਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal biaadh man te khai nase ||
verses.translation: All evils are dispelled from the mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa saa tin kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: He takes us into His favor as His own.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jap naam muraaree ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਚੂਕੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: thit paiee chooke bhram gavan ||
verses.translation: Stability is attained; doubt and wandering cease,

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sun naanak har har jas sravan ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, listening with one's ears to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਰਗੁਨੁ ਭੀ ਓਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: niragun aap saragun bhee ohee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is absolute and unrelated; He Himself is also involved and related.

verses.original: ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੋਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kalaa dhaar jin sagalee mohee ||
verses.translation: Manifesting His power, He fascinates the entire world.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਚਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: apane charit prabh aap banaae ||
verses.translation: God Himself sets His play in motion.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: apunee keemat aape paae ||
verses.translation: Only He Himself can estimate His worth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har bin dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: There is none, other than the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nira(n)tar eko soi ||
verses.translation: Permeating all, He is the One.

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: ot pot raviaa roop ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Through and through, He pervades in form and color.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: bhe pragaas saadh kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: He is revealed in the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਰਚਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: rach rachanaa apanee kal dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Having created the creation, He infuses His own power into it.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: anik baar naanak balihaaree ||8||18||
verses.translation: So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||8||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saath na chaalai bin bhajan bikhiaa sagalee chhaar ||
verses.translation: Nothing shall go along with you, except your devotion. All corruption is like ashes.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har naam kamaavanaa naanak ih dhan saar ||1||
verses.translation: Practice the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, this is the most excellent wealth. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: asaTapadhee ||
verses.translation: Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa mil karahu beechaar ||
verses.translation: Joining the Company of the Saints, practice deep meditation.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ek simar naam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Remember the One, and take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: avar upaav sabh meet bisaarahu ||
verses.translation: Forget all other efforts, O my friend

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal ridh meh ur dhaarahu ||
verses.translation: - enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran so prabh samarath ||
verses.translation: God is All-powerful; He is the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhiraR kar gahahu naam har vath ||
verses.translation: Grasp firmly the object of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: eih dhan sa(n)chahu hovahu bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: Gather this wealth, and become very fortunate.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kaa niramal ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: Pure are the instructions of the humble Saints.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ek aas raakhahu man maeh ||
verses.translation: Keep faith in the One Lord within your mind.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab rog naanak miT jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: All disease, O Nanak, shall then be dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhan kau chaar ku(n)T uTh dhaaveh ||
verses.translation: The wealth which you chase after in the four directions

verses.original: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: so dhan har sevaa te paaveh ||
verses.translation: you shall obtain that wealth by serving the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: jis sukh kau nit baachheh meet ||
verses.translation: The peace, which you always yearn for, O friend

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: so sukh saadhoo sa(n)g pareet ||
verses.translation: that peace comes by the love of the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਲੀ ਕਰਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis sobhaa kau kareh bhalee karanee ||
verses.translation: The glory, for which you perform good deeds

verses.original: ਸਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: saa sobhaa bhaj har kee saranee ||
verses.translation: - you shall obtain that glory by seeking the Lord's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anik upaavee rog na jai ||
verses.translation: All sorts of remedies have not cured the disease

verses.original: ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: rog miTai har avakhadh lai ||
verses.translation: - the disease is cured only by giving the medicine of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nidhaan meh har naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Of all treasures, the Lord's Name is the supreme treasure.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jap naanak dharageh paravaan ||2||
verses.translation: Chant it, O Nanak, and be accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man parabodhahu har kai nai ||
verses.translation: Enlighten your mind with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਤ ਆਵੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis dhaavat aavai Thai ||
verses.translation: Having wandered around in the ten directions, it comes to its place of rest.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau bighan na laagai koi ||
verses.translation: No obstacle stands in the way of one

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai ridhai basai har soi ||
verses.translation: whose heart is filled with the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਤਾਤੀ ਠਾਂਢਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kal taatee Thaa(n)ddaa har naau ||
verses.translation: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so hot; the Lord's Name is soothing and cool.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar sadhaa sukh paau ||
verses.translation: Remember, remember it in meditation, and obtain everlasting peace.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: bhau binasai pooran hoi aas ||
verses.translation: Your fear shall be dispelled, and your hopes shall be fulfilled.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਆਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhai aatam paragaas ||
verses.translation: By devotional worship and loving adoration, your soul shall be enlightened.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: tit ghar jai basai abinaasee ||
verses.translation: You shall go to that home, and live forever.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak kaaTee jam faasee ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the noose of death is cut away. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: tat beechaar kahai jan saachaa ||
verses.translation: One who contemplates the essence of reality, is said to be the true person.

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਚੋ ਕਾਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: janam marai so kaacho kaachaa ||
verses.translation: Birth and death are the lot of the false and the insincere.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gavan miTai prabh sev ||
verses.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended by serving God.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: aap tiaag saran gurdhev ||
verses.translation: Give up your selfishness and conceit, and seek the Sanctuary of the Divine Guru.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eiau ratan janam kaa hoi udhaar ||
verses.translation: Thus the jewel of this human life is saved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har simar praan aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Remember the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਨ ਛੂਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: anik upaav na chhooTanahaare ||
verses.translation: By all sorts of efforts, people are not saved

verses.original: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)mirat saasat bedh beechaare ||
verses.translation: not by studying the Simritees, the Shaastras or the Vedas.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat karahu man lai ||
verses.translation: Worship the Lord with whole-hearted devotion.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬੰਛਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: man ba(n)chhat naanak fal pai ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desire. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਧਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g na chaalas terai dhanaa ||
verses.translation: Your wealth shall not go with you;

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਿਆ ਲਪਟਾਵਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) kiaa lapaTaaveh moorakh manaa ||
verses.translation: why do you cling to it, you fool?

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਅਰੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sut meet kuTa(n)b ar banitaa ||
verses.translation: Children, friends, family and spouse

verses.original: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਕਵਨ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: ein te kahahu tum kavan sanaathaa ||
verses.translation: who of these shall accompany you?

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: raaj ra(n)g maiaa bisathaar ||
verses.translation: Power, pleasure, and the vast expanse of Maya

verses.original: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ein te kahahu kavan chhuTakaar ||
verses.translation: who has ever escaped from these?

verses.original: ਅਸੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਰਥ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: as hasatee rath asavaaree ||
verses.translation: Horses, elephants, chariots and pageantry

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਡੰਫੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa dda(n)f jhooTh paasaaree ||
verses.translation: - false shows and false displays.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਨ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhe'ee tis bujhai na bigaanaa ||
verses.translation: The fool does not acknowledge the One who gave this;

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naam bisaar naanak pachhutaanaa ||5||
verses.translation: forgetting the Naam, O Nanak, he will repent in the end. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਲੇਹਿ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee mat too(n) leh iaane ||
verses.translation: Take the Guru's advice, you ignorant fool;

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਡੂਬੇ ਸਿਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat binaa bahu ddoobe siaane ||
verses.translation: without devotion, even the clever have drowned.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat karahu man meet ||
verses.translation: Worship the Lord with heart-felt devotion, my friend;

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਚੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: niramal hoi tum(h)aaro cheet ||
verses.translation: your consciousness shall become pure.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal raakhahu man maeh ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet in your mind;

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilabikh jaeh ||
verses.translation: the sins of countless lifetimes shall depart.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap japahu avaraa naam japaavahu ||
verses.translation: Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it as well.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਤ ਕਹਤ ਰਹਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sunat kahat rahat gat paavahu ||
verses.translation: Hearing, speaking and living it, emancipation is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saar bhoot sat har ko naau ||
verses.translation: The essential reality is the True Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sahaj subhai naanak gun gaau ||6||
verses.translation: With intuitive ease, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat teree utaras mail ||
verses.translation: Chanting His Glories, your filth shall be washed off.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: binas jai haumai bikh fail ||
verses.translation: The all-consuming poison of ego will be gone.

verses.original: ਹੋਹਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਬਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hoh achi(n)t basai sukh naal ||
verses.translation: You shall become carefree, and you shall dwell in peace.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: saas graas har naam samaal ||
verses.translation: With every breath and every morsel of food, cherish the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: chhaadd siaanap sagalee manaa ||
verses.translation: Renounce all clever tricks, O mind.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g paaveh sach dhanaa ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the true wealth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸੰਚਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har poo(n)jee sa(n)ch karahu biauhaar ||
verses.translation: So gather the Lord's Name as your capital, and trade in it.

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa sukh dharageh jaikaar ||
verses.translation: In this world you shall be at peace, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be acclaimed.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nira(n)tar eko dhekh ||
verses.translation: See the One permeating all;

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jaa kai masatak lekh ||7||
verses.translation: says Nanak, your destiny is pre-ordained. ||7||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eko jap eko saalaeh ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the One, and worship the One.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨ ਆਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ek simar eko man aaeh ||
verses.translation: Remember the One, and yearn for the One in your mind.

verses.original: ਏਕਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: ekas ke gun gaau ana(n)t ||
verses.translation: Sing the endless Glorious Praises of the One.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਿ ਏਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: man tan jaap ek bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: With mind and body, meditate on the One Lord God.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: eko ek ek har aap ||
verses.translation: The One Lord Himself is the One and Only.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahio prabh biaap ||
verses.translation: The Pervading Lord God is totally permeating all.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਏਕ ਤੇ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: anik bisathaar ek te bhe ||
verses.translation: The many expanses of the creation have all come from the One.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: ek araadh paraachhat ge ||
verses.translation: Adoring the One, past sins are removed.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar ek prabh raataa ||
verses.translation: Mind and body within are imbued with the One God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak ik jaataa ||8||19||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the One is known. ||8||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: firat firat prabh aaiaa pariaa tau saranai ||
verses.translation: After wandering and wandering, O God, I have come, and entered Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kee prabh benatee apanee bhagatee lai ||1||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer, O God: please, attach me to Your devotional service. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: asaTapadhee ||
verses.translation: Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਜਾਚਕ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaachak jan jaachai prabh dhaan ||
verses.translation: I am a beggar; I beg for this gift from You:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa dhevahu har naam ||
verses.translation: please, by Your Mercy, Lord, give me Your Name.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਗਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa kee maagau dhoor ||
verses.translation: I ask for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham meree saradhaa poor ||
verses.translation: O Supreme Lord God, please fulfill my yearning;

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa prabh ke gun gaavau ||
verses.translation: may I sing the Glorious Praises of God forever and ever.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas prabh tumeh dhiaavau ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, may I meditate on You, O God.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau laagai preet ||
verses.translation: May I enshrine affection for Your Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat karau prabh kee nit neet ||
verses.translation: May I perform devotional worship to God each and every day.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਓਟ ਏਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ek oT eko aadhaar ||
verses.translation: You are my only Shelter, my only Support.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak maagai naam prabh saar ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak asks for the most sublime, the Naam, the Name of God. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee dhirasaT mahaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: By God's Gracious Glance, there is great peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ras paavai biralaa koi ||
verses.translation: Rare are those who obtain the juice of the Lord's essence.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin chaakhiaa se jan tirapataane ||
verses.translation: Those who taste it are satisfied.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਹੀ ਡੋਲਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: pooran purakh nahee ddolaane ||
verses.translation: They are fulfilled and realized beings - they do not waver.

verses.original: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: subhar bhare prem ras ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: They are totally filled to over-flowing with the sweet delight of His Love.

verses.original: ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: aupajai chaau saadh kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Spiritual delight wells up within, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਪਰੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਨ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: pare saran aan sabh tiaag ||
verses.translation: Taking to His Sanctuary, they forsake all others.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar pragaas anadhin liv laag ||
verses.translation: Deep within, they are enlightened, and they center themselves on Him, day and night.

verses.original: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਪਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: baddabhaagee japiaa prabh soi ||
verses.translation: Most fortunate are those who meditate on God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate sukh hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, they are at peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: sevak kee manasaa pooree bhiee ||
verses.translation: The wishes of the Lord's servant are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te niramal mat liee ||
verses.translation: From the True Guru, the pure teachings are obtained.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jan kau prabh hoio dhiaal ||
verses.translation: Unto His humble servant, God has shown His kindness.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sevak keeno sadhaa nihaal ||
verses.translation: He has made His servant eternally happy.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaT mukat jan bhiaa ||
verses.translation: The bonds of His humble servant are cut away, and he is liberated.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhookh bhram giaa ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death, and doubt are gone.

verses.original: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eichh punee saradhaa sabh pooree ||
verses.translation: Desires are satisfied, and faith is fully rewarded,

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਜੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: rav rahiaa sadh sa(n)g hajooree ||
verses.translation: imbued forever with His all-pervading peace.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa saa tin leeaa milai ||
verses.translation: He is His - he merges in Union with Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagatee naam samai ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship of the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau bisarai j ghaal na bhaanai ||
verses.translation: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau bisarai j keeaa jaanai ||
verses.translation: Why forget Him, who acknowledges what we do?

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau bisarai jin sabh kichh dheeaa ||
verses.translation: Why forget Him, who has given us everything?

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau bisarai j jeevan jeeaa ||
verses.translation: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau bisarai j agan meh raakhai ||
verses.translation: Why forget Him, who preserves us in the fire of the womb?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh ko biralaa laakhai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau bisarai j bikh te kaaddai ||
verses.translation: Why forget Him, who lifts us up out of corruption?

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਟੂਟਾ ਗਾਢੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kaa TooTaa gaaddai ||
verses.translation: Those separated from Him for countless lifetimes, are re-united with Him once again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਤੁ ਇਹੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai tat ihai bujhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, this essential reality is understood.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: prabh apanaa naanak jan dhiaaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: saajan sa(n)t karahu ih kaam ||
verses.translation: O friends, O Saints, make this your work.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: aan tiaag japahu har naam ||
verses.translation: Renounce everything else, and chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar simar sukh paavahu ||
verses.translation: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap japahu avareh naam japaavahu ||
verses.translation: Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhai tareeaai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: By loving devotional worship, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhagatee tan hosee chhaar ||
verses.translation: Without devotional meditation, the body will be just ashes.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kaliaan sookh nidh naam ||
verses.translation: All joys and comforts are in the treasure of the Naam.

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: booddat jaat paae bisraam ||
verses.translation: Even the drowning can reach the place of rest and safety.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਖ ਕਾ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sagal dhookh kaa hovat naas ||
verses.translation: All sorrows shall vanish.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਨਤਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam japahu gunataas ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant the Naam, the treasure of excellence. ||5||

verses.original: ਉਪਜੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aupajee preet prem ras chaau ||
verses.translation: Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar ihee suaau ||
verses.translation: within my mind and body, this is my purpose:

verses.original: ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: netrahu pekh dharas sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man bigasai saadh charan dhoi ||
verses.translation: My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kai man tan ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: biralaa kouoo paavai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Rare is the one who obtains their company.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ek basat dheejai kar miaa ||
verses.translation: Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naam jap liaa ||
verses.translation: by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee upamaa kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: His Praises cannot be spoken;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak rahiaa sarab samai ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਖਸੰਦ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bakhasa(n)dh dheen dhiaal ||
verses.translation: God, the Forgiving Lord, is kind to the poor.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal sadhaa kirapaal ||
verses.translation: He loves His devotees, and He is always merciful to them.

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: anaath naath gobi(n)dh gupaal ||
verses.translation: The Patron of the patronless, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the world,

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sarab ghaTaa karat pratipaal ||
verses.translation: the Nourisher of all beings.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh kaaran karataar ||
verses.translation: The Primal Being, the Creator of the Creation.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa ke praan adhaar ||
verses.translation: The Support of the breath of life of His devotees.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo japai su hoi puneet ||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates on Him is sanctified,

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਹੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhai laavai man heet ||
verses.translation: focusing the mind in loving devotional worship.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਨੀਚ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: ham niraguneeaar neech ajaan ||
verses.translation: I am unworthy, lowly and ignorant.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak tumaree saran purakh bhagavaan ||7||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Supreme Lord God. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮੋਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sarab baiku(n)Th mukat mokh paae ||
verses.translation: Everything is obtained: the heavens, liberation and deliverance,

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ek nimakh har ke gun gaae ||
verses.translation: if one sings the Lord's Glories, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਬਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: anik raaj bhog baddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: So many realms of power, pleasures and great glories,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam kee kathaa man bhaiee ||
verses.translation: come to one whose mind is pleased with the Sermon of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਭੋਜਨ ਕਾਪਰ ਸੰਗੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bhojan kaapar sa(n)geet ||
verses.translation: Abundant foods, clothes and music

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa japatee har har neet ||
verses.translation: come to one whose tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਭਲੀ ਸੁ ਕਰਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: bhalee su karanee sobhaa dhanava(n)t ||
verses.translation: His actions are good, he is glorious and wealthy;

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai base pooran gur ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: the Mantra of the Perfect Guru dwells within his heart.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g prabh dheh nivaas ||
verses.translation: O God, grant me a home in the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੮॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh naanak paragaas ||8||20||
verses.translation: All pleasures, O Nanak, are so revealed. ||8||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: saragun niragun nira(n)kaar su(n)n samaadhee aap ||
verses.translation: He possesses all qualities; He transcends all qualities; He is the Formless Lord. He Himself is in Primal Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aapan keeaa naanakaa aape hee fir jaap ||1||
verses.translation: Through His Creation, O Nanak, He meditates on Himself. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: asaTapadhee ||
verses.translation: Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਜਬ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab akaar ih kachh na dhirasaTetaa ||
verses.translation: When this world had not yet appeared in any form,

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਬ ਕਹ ਤੇ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: paap pu(n)n tab keh te hotaa ||
verses.translation: who then committed sins and performed good deeds?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਧਾਰੀ ਆਪਨ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: jab dhaaree aapan su(n)n samaadh ||
verses.translation: When the Lord Himself was in Profound Samaadhi,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: tab bair birodh kis sa(n)g kamaat ||
verses.translation: then against whom were hate and jealousy directed?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਤ ॥
verses.translit: jab is kaa baran chihan na jaapat ||
verses.translation: When there was no color or shape to be seen,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ॥
verses.translit: tab harakh sog kahu kiseh biaapat ||
verses.translation: then who experienced joy and sorrow?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
verses.translit: jab aapan aap aap paarabraham ||
verses.translation: When the Supreme Lord Himself was Himself All-in-all,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਮੋਹ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: tab moh kahaa kis hovat bharam ||
verses.translation: then where was emotional attachment, and who had doubts?

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: aapan khel aap varateejaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself has staged His own drama;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak karanaihaar na dhoojaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is no other Creator. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹੋਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਵਲ ਧਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab hovat prabh keval dhanee ||
verses.translation: When there was only God the Master,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਗਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: tab ba(n)dh mukat kahu kis kau ganee ||
verses.translation: then who was called bound or liberated?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਏਕਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jab ekeh har agam apaar ||
verses.translation: When there was only the Lord, Unfathomable and Infinite,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tab narak surag kahu kaun aautaar ||
verses.translation: then who entered hell, and who entered heaven?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jab niragun prabh sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: When God was without attributes, in absolute poise,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tab siv sakat kahahu kit Thai ||
verses.translation: then where was mind and where was matter - where was Shiva and Shakti?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jab aapeh aap apanee jot dharai ||
verses.translation: When He held His Own Light unto Himself,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਡਰੁ ਕਵਨ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: tab kavan niddar kavan kat ddarai ||
verses.translation: then who was fearless, and who was afraid?

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਚਲਿਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aapan chalit aap karanaihaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Performer in His own plays;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak Thaakur agam apaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Master is Unfathomable and Infinite. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੁਖ ਆਪਨ ਆਸਨ ॥
verses.translit: abinaasee sukh aapan aasan ||
verses.translation: When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ॥
verses.translit: teh janam maran kahu kahaa binaasan ||
verses.translation: then where was birth, death and dissolution?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jab pooran karataa prabh soi ||
verses.translation: When there was only God, the Perfect Creator,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tab jam kee traas kahahu kis hoi ||
verses.translation: then who was afraid of death?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab abigat agochar prabh ekaa ||
verses.translation: When there was only the One Lord, unmanifest and incomprehensible,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਛਤ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: tab chitr gupat kis poochhat lekhaa ||
verses.translation: then who was called to account by the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਗਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: jab naath nira(n)jan agochar agaadhe ||
verses.translation: When there was only the Immaculate, Incomprehensible, Unfathomable Master,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਕਉਨ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: tab kaun chhuTe kaun ba(n)dhan baadhe ||
verses.translation: then who was emancipated, and who was held in bondage?

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਅਚਰਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: aapan aap aap hee acharajaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself, in and of Himself, is the most wonderful.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਨ ਰੂਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਪਰਜਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak aapan roop aap hee uparajaa ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself created His Own Form. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh niramal purakh purakh pat hotaa ||
verses.translation: When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh bin mail kahahu kiaa dhotaa ||
verses.translation: there was no filth, so what was there to be washed clean?

verses.original: ਜਹ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jeh nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar nirabaan ||
verses.translation: When there was only the Pure, Formless Lord in Nirvaanaa,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਨ ਕਉਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: teh kaun kau maan kaun abhimaan ||
verses.translation: then who was honored, and who was dishonored?

verses.original: ਜਹ ਸਰੂਪ ਕੇਵਲ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: jeh saroop keval jagadhees ||
verses.translation: When there was only the Form of the Lord of the Universe,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਛਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਗਤ ਕਹੁ ਕੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: teh chhal chhidhr lagat kahu kees ||
verses.translation: then who was tainted by fraud and sin?

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jot saroopee jot sa(n)g samaavai ||
verses.translation: When the Embodiment of Light was immersed in His Own Light,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਭੂਖ ਕਵਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: teh kiseh bhookh kavan tirapataavai ||
verses.translation: then who was hungry, and who was satisfied?

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan karanaihaar ||
verses.translation: He is the Cause of causes, the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak karate kaa naeh sumaar ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Creator is beyond calculation. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jab apanee sobhaa aapan sa(n)g banaiee ||
verses.translation: When His Glory was contained within Himself,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tab kavan mai baap mitr sut bhaiee ||
verses.translation: then who was mother, father, friend, child or sibling?

verses.original: ਜਹ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਆਪਹਿ ਪਰਬੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: jeh sarab kalaa aapeh parabeen ||
verses.translation: When all power and wisdom was latent within Him,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਚੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: teh bedh kateb kahaa kouoo cheen ||
verses.translation: then where were the Vedas and the scriptures, and who was there to read them?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jab aapan aap aap ur dhaarai ||
verses.translation: When He kept Himself, All-in-all, unto His Own Heart,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਸਗਨ ਅਪਸਗਨ ਕਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: tau sagan apasagan kahaa beechaarai ||
verses.translation: then who considered omens to be good or bad?

verses.original: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh aapan uooch aapan aap neraa ||
verses.translation: When He Himself was lofty, and He Himself was near at hand,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh kaun Thaakur kaun kaheeaai cheraa ||
verses.translation: then who was called master, and who was called disciple?

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: bisaman bisam rahe bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: We are wonder-struck at the wondrous wonder of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak apanee gat jaanahu aap ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He alone knows His own state. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeh achhal achhedh abhedh samaiaa ||
verses.translation: When the Undeceiveable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,

verses.original: ਊਹਾ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: uoohaa kiseh biaapat maiaa ||
verses.translation: then who was swayed by Maya?

verses.original: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aapas kau aapeh aadhes ||
verses.translation: When He paid homage to Himself,

verses.original: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: tih gun kaa naahee paraves ||
verses.translation: then the three qualities were not prevailing.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh ekeh ek ek bhagava(n)taa ||
verses.translation: When there was only the One, the One and Only Lord God,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh kaun achi(n)t kis laagai chi(n)taa ||
verses.translation: then who was not anxious, and who felt anxiety?

verses.original: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh aapan aap aap pateeaaraa ||
verses.translation: When He Himself was satisfied with Himself,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਥੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁਨਨੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh kaun kathai kaun sunanaihaaraa ||
verses.translation: then who spoke and who listened?

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bea(n)t uooch te uoochaa ||
verses.translation: He is vast and infinite, the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਹਿ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak aapas kau aapeh pahoochaa ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He alone can reach Himself. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਆਪਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh aap rachio parapa(n)ch akaar ||
verses.translation: When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,

verses.original: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tih gun meh keeno bisathaar ||
verses.translation: he made the world subject to the three dispositions.

verses.original: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਹ ਭਈ ਕਹਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: paap pu(n)n teh bhiee kahaavat ||
verses.translation: Sin and virtue then began to be spoken of.

verses.original: ਕੋਊ ਨਰਕ ਕੋਊ ਸੁਰਗ ਬੰਛਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: kouoo narak kouoo surag ba(n)chhaavat ||
verses.translation: Some have gone to hell, and some yearn for paradise.

verses.original: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: aal jaal maiaa ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: Worldly snares and entanglements of Maya,

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: haumai moh bharam bhai bhaar ||
verses.translation: egotism, attachment, doubt and loads of fear;

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh sookh maan apamaan ||
verses.translation: pain and pleasure, honor and dishonor

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੀਓ ਬਖੵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: anik prakaar keeo bakhayeaan ||
verses.translation: these came to be described in various ways.

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: aapan khel aap kar dhekhai ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates and beholds His own drama.

verses.original: ਖੇਲੁ ਸੰਕੋਚੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: khel sa(n)kochai tau naanak ekai ||7||
verses.translation: He winds up the drama, and then, O Nanak, He alone remains. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeh abigat bhagat teh aap ||
verses.translation: Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਪਸਰੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਰਤਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeh pasarai paasaar sa(n)t parataap ||
verses.translation: He unfolds the expanse of His creation for the glory of His Saint.

verses.original: ਦੁਹੂ ਪਾਖ ਕਾ ਆਪਹਿ ਧਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhuhoo paakh kaa aapeh dhanee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Master of both worlds.

verses.original: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aun kee sobhaa unahoo banee ||
verses.translation: His Praise is to Himself alone.

verses.original: ਆਪਹਿ ਕਉਤਕ ਕਰੈ ਅਨਦ ਚੋਜ ॥
verses.translit: aapeh kautak karai anadh choj ||
verses.translation: He Himself performs and plays His amusements and games.

verses.original: ਆਪਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: aapeh ras bhogan nirajog ||
verses.translation: He Himself enjoys pleasures, and yet He is unaffected and untouched.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis bhaavai tis aapan nai laavai ||
verses.translation: He attaches whomever He pleases to His Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਖਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis bhaavai tis khel khilaavai ||
verses.translation: He causes whomever He pleases to play in His play.

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਤੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: besumaar athaeh aganat atolai ||
verses.translation: He is beyond calculation, beyond measure, uncountable and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: jiau bulaavahu tiau naanak dhaas bolai ||8||21||
verses.translation: As You inspire him to speak, O Lord, so does servant Nanak speak. ||8||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t ke Thaakuraa aape varatanahaar ||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master of all beings and creatures, You Yourself are prevailing everywhere.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak eko pasariaa dhoojaa keh dhirasaTaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, The One is All-pervading; where is any other to be seen? ||1||

verses.original: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: asaTapadhee ||
verses.translation: Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਥੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਨਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap kathai aap sunanaihaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the speaker, and He Himself is the listener.

verses.original: ਆਪਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aapeh ek aap bisathaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaavai taa sirasaT upaae ||
verses.translation: When it pleases Him, He creates the world.

verses.original: ਆਪਨੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapanai bhaanai le samaae ||
verses.translation: As He pleases, He absorbs it back into Himself.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tum te bhi(n)n nahee kichh hoi ||
verses.translation: Without You, nothing can be done.

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਸੂਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapan soot sabh jagat paroi ||
verses.translation: Upon Your thread, You have strung the whole world.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau prabh jeeau aap bujhaae ||
verses.translation: One whom God Himself inspires to understand

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sach naam soiee jan paae ||
verses.translation: - that person obtains the True Name.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਤਤ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: so samadharasee tat kaa betaa ||
verses.translation: He looks impartially upon all, and he knows the essential reality.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਜੇਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sagal sirasaT kaa jetaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he conquers the whole world. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)tr sabh taa kai haath ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal anaath ko naath ||
verses.translation: He is Merciful to the meek, the Patron of the patronless.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis raakhai tis koi na maarai ||
verses.translation: No one can kill those who are protected by Him.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੂਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so mooaa jis manahu bisaarai ||
verses.translation: One who is forgotten by God, is already dead.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਜਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis taj avar kahaa ko jai ||
verses.translation: Leaving Him, where else could anyone go?

verses.original: ਸਭ ਸਿਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sir ek nira(n)jan rai ||
verses.translation: Over the heads of all is the One, the Immaculate King.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kee jugat jaa kai sabh haath ||
verses.translation: The ways and means of all beings are in His Hands.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar jaanahu saath ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, know that He is with you.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan bea(n)t apaar ||
verses.translation: He is the Ocean of excellence, infinite and endless.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sadhaa balihaar ||2||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahe dhiaal ||
verses.translation: The Perfect, Merciful Lord is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sabh uoopar hovat kirapaal ||
verses.translation: His kindness extends to all.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: apane karatab jaanai aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself knows His own ways.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee rahio biaap ||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is present everywhere.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਜੀਅਨ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: pratipaalai jeean bahu bhaat ||
verses.translation: He cherishes His living beings in so many ways.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo rachio su tiseh dhiaat ||
verses.translation: That which He has created meditates on Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis bhaavai tis le milai ||
verses.translation: Whoever pleases Him, He blends into Himself.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat kareh har ke gun gai ||
verses.translation: They perform His devotional service and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man a(n)tar bisavaiaas kar maaniaa ||
verses.translation: With heart-felt faith, they believe in Him.

verses.original: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karanahaar naanak ik jaaniaa ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they realize the One, the Creator Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jan laagaa har ekai nai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant is committed to His Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee aas na birathee jai ||
verses.translation: His hopes do not go in vain.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sevak kau sevaa ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: The servant's purpose is to serve;

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam boojh param padh paiee ||
verses.translation: obeying the Lord's Command, the supreme status is obtained.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eis te uoopar nahee beechaar ||
verses.translation: Beyond this, he has no other thought.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai man basiaa nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Within his mind, the Formless Lord abides.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan tor bhe niravair ||
verses.translation: His bonds are cut away, and he becomes free of hatred.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin poojeh gur ke pair ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he worships the Feet of the Guru.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: eeh lok sukhe'ee paralok suhele ||
verses.translation: He is at peace in this world, and happy in the next.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak har prabh aapeh mele ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord God unites him with Himself. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g mil karahu ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Join the Company of the Holy, and be happy.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavahu prabh paramaana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glories of God, the embodiment of supreme bliss.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam tat karahu beechaar ||
verses.translation: Contemplate the essence of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhrulabh dheh kaa karahu udhaar ||
verses.translation: Redeem this human body, so difficult to obtain.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat bachan har ke gun gaau ||
verses.translation: Sing the Ambrosial Words of the Lord's Glorious Praises;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਰਨ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: praan taran kaa ihai suaau ||
verses.translation: this is the way to save your mortal soul.
