verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਹੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar prabh pekhahu neraa ||
verses.translation: Behold God near at hand, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਮਿਟੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: miTai agiaan binasai a(n)dheraa ||
verses.translation: Ignorance shall depart, and darkness shall be dispelled.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun upadhes hiradhai basaavahu ||
verses.translation: Listen to the Teachings, and enshrine them in your heart.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: man ichhe naanak fal paavahu ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat dhui leh savaar ||
verses.translation: Embellish both this world and the next;

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam a(n)tar ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: enshrine the Lord's Name deep within your heart.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kee pooree dheekhiaa ||
verses.translation: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis man basai tis saach pareekhiaa ||
verses.translation: That person, within whose mind it abides, realizes the Truth.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan naam japahu liv lai ||
verses.translation: With your mind and body, chant the Naam; lovingly attune yourself to it.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh man te bhau jai ||
verses.translation: Sorrow, pain and fear shall depart from your mind.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach vaapaar karahu vaapaaree ||
verses.translation: Deal in the true trade, O trader,

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਖੇਪ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharageh nibahai khep tumaaree ||
verses.translation: and your merchandise shall be safe in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ ਰਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa Tek rakhahu man maeh ||
verses.translation: Keep the Support of the One in your mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak bahur na aaveh jaeh ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||6||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis te dhoor kahaa ko jai ||
verses.translation: Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?

verses.original: ਉਬਰੈ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: aubarai raakhanahaar dhiaai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Protector Lord, you shall be saved.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau japai sagal bhau miTai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kirapaa te praanee chhuTai ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, mortals are released.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: jis prabh raakhai tis naahee dhookh ||
verses.translation: One who is protected by God never suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: naam japat man hovat sookh ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the mind becomes peaceful.

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: chi(n)taa jai miTai aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Anxiety departs, and ego is eliminated.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan kau koi na pahuchanahaar ||
verses.translation: No one can equal that humble servant.

verses.original: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਠਾਢਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sir uoopar Thaaddaa gur sooraa ||
verses.translation: The Brave and Powerful Guru stands over his head.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak taa ke kaaraj pooraa ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, his efforts are fulfilled. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: mat pooree a(n)mrit jaa kee dhirasaT ||
verses.translation: His wisdom is perfect, and His Glance is Ambrosial.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਉਧਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan pekhat udharat sirasaT ||
verses.translation: Beholding His Vision, the universe is saved.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal jaa ke anoop ||
verses.translation: His Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: safal dharasan su(n)dhar har roop ||
verses.translation: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His Lordly Form is beautiful.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n sevaa sevak paravaan ||
verses.translation: Blessed is His service; His servant is famous.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee purakh pradhaan ||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is the most exalted Supreme Being.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis man basai su hot nihaal ||
verses.translation: That one, within whose mind He abides, is blissfully happy.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: taa kai nikaT na aavat kaal ||
verses.translation: Death does not draw near him.

verses.original: ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: amar bhe amaraa padh paiaa ||
verses.translation: One becomes immortal, and obtains the immortal status,

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak har dhiaaiaa ||8||22||
verses.translation: meditating on the Lord, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy. ||8||22||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaan a(n)jan gur dheeaa agiaan a(n)dher binaas ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and dispelled the darkness of ignorance.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa te sa(n)t bheTiaa naanak man paragaas ||1||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Grace, I have met the Saint; O Nanak, my mind is enlightened. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: asaTapadhee ||
verses.translation: Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g a(n)tar prabh ddeeThaa ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, I see God deep within my being.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam prabhoo kaa laagaa meeThaa ||
verses.translation: God's Name is sweet to me.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਿਗ੍ਰੀ ਏਕਸੁ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sagal samigree ekas ghaT maeh ||
verses.translation: All things are contained in the Heart of the One,

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਨਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik ra(n)g naanaa dhirasaTaeh ||
verses.translation: although they appear in so many various colors.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: nau nidh a(n)mrit prabh kaa naam ||
verses.translation: The nine treasures are in the Ambrosial Name of God.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee meh is kaa bisraam ||
verses.translation: Within the human body is its place of rest.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਤਹ ਨਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n samaadh anahat teh naadh ||
verses.translation: The Deepest Samaadhi, and the unstruck sound current of the Naad are there.

verses.original: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: kahan na jaiee acharaj bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: The wonder and marvel of it cannot be described.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tin dhekhiaa jis aap dhikhaae ||
verses.translation: He alone sees it, unto whom God Himself reveals it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tis jan sojhee paae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that humble being understands. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: so a(n)tar so baahar ana(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT biaap rahiaa bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: Deep within each and every heart, the Lord God is pervading.

verses.original: ਧਰਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: dharan maeh aakaas piaal ||
verses.translation: In the earth, in the Akaashic ethers, and in the nether regions of the underworld

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sarab lok pooran pratipaal ||
verses.translation: in all worlds, He is the Perfect Cherisher.

verses.original: ਬਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: ban tin parabat hai paarabraham ||
verses.translation: In the forests, fields and mountains, He is the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਤੈਸਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee aagiaa taisaa karam ||
verses.translation: As He orders, so do His creatures act.

verses.original: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee baisa(n)tar maeh ||
verses.translation: He permeates the winds and the waters.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸੇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: chaar ku(n)T dheh dhise samaeh ||
verses.translation: He is pervading in the four corners and in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis te bhi(n)n nahee ko Thaau ||
verses.translation: Without Him, there is no place at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak sukh paau ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, peace is obtained. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan si(n)mirat meh dhekh ||
verses.translation: See Him in the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.

verses.original: ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: saseear soor nakhayetr meh ek ||
verses.translation: In the moon, the sun and the stars, He is the One.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: baanee prabh kee sabh ko bolai ||
verses.translation: The Bani of God's Word is spoken by everyone.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap addol na kabahoo ddolai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is unwavering - He never wavers.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa kar khelai khel ||
verses.translation: With absolute power, He plays His play.

verses.original: ਮੋਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣਹ ਅਮੋਲ ॥
verses.translit: mol na paieeaai guneh amol ||
verses.translation: His value cannot be estimated; His virtues are invaluable.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jot meh jaa kee jot ||
verses.translation: In all light, is His Light.

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhaar rahio suaamee ot pot ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master supports the weave of the fabric of the universe.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh bharam kaa naas ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, doubt is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak tin meh eh bisaas ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this faith is firmly implanted within. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪੇਖਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kaa pekhan sabh braham ||
verses.translation: In the eye of the Saint, everything is God.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kai hiradhai sabh dharam ||
verses.translation: In the heart of the Saint, everything is Dharma.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਸੁਭ ਬਚਨ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa suneh subh bachan ||
verses.translation: The Saint hears words of goodness.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਨ ॥
verses.translit: sarab biaapee raam sa(n)g rachan ||
verses.translation: He is absorbed in the All-pervading Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਰਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: jin jaataa tis kee ieh rahat ||
verses.translation: This is the way of life of one who knows God.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: sat bachan saadhoo sabh kahat ||
verses.translation: True are all the words spoken by the Holy.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo hoi soiee sukh maanai ||
verses.translation: Whatever happens, he peacefully accepts.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavanahaar prabh jaanai ||
verses.translation: He knows God as the Doer, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀ ਓਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar base baahar bhee ohee ||
verses.translation: He dwells inside, and outside as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dharasan dhekh sabh mohee ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are fascinated. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap sat keeaa sabh sat ||
verses.translation: He Himself is True, and all that He has made is True.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਸਗਲੀ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis prabh te sagalee utapat ||
verses.translation: The entire creation came from God.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis bhaavai taa kare bisathaar ||
verses.translation: As it pleases Him, He creates the expanse.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis bhaavai taa eka(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: As it pleases Him, He becomes the One and Only again.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਲਖੀ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anik kalaa lakhee neh jai ||
verses.translation: His powers are so numerous, they cannot be known.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis bhaavai tis le milai ||
verses.translation: As it pleases Him, He merges us into Himself again.

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਵਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kavan nikaT kavan kaheeaai dhoor ||
verses.translation: Who is near, and who is far away?

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap aap bharapoor ||
verses.translation: He Himself is Himself pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)taragat jis aap janaae ||
verses.translation: One whom God causes to know that He is within the heart

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak tis jan aap bujhaae ||5||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, He causes that person to understand Him. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab bhoot aap varataaraa ||
verses.translation: In all forms, He Himself is pervading.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨੈਨ ਆਪਿ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nain aap pekhanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through all eyes, He Himself is watching.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal samagree jaa kaa tanaa ||
verses.translation: All the creation is His Body.

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਜਸੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਸੁਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aapan jas aap hee sunaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself listens to His Own Praise.

verses.original: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan ik khel banaiaa ||
verses.translation: The One has created the drama of coming and going.

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aagiaakaaree keenee maiaa ||
verses.translation: He made Maya subservient to His Will.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kai madh alipato rahai ||
verses.translation: In the midst of all, He remains unattached.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kahanaa su aape kahai ||
verses.translation: Whatever is said, He Himself says.

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆ ਆਵੈ ਆਗਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aagiaa aavai aagiaa jai ||
verses.translation: By His Will we come, and by His Will we go.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak jaa bhaavai taa le samai ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when it pleases Him, then He absorbs us into Himself. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੁਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis te hoi su naahee buraa ||
verses.translation: If it comes from Him, it cannot be bad.

verses.original: ਓਰੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: orai kahahu kinai kachh karaa ||
verses.translation: Other than Him, who can do anything?

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: aap bhalaa karatoot at neekee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is good; His actions are the very best.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape jaanai apane jee kee ||
verses.translation: He Himself knows His Own Being.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap saach dhaaree sabh saach ||
verses.translation: He Himself is True, and all that He has established is True.

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: ot pot aapan sa(n)g raach ||
verses.translation: Through and through, He is blended with His creation.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee gat mit kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: His state and extent cannot be described.

verses.original: ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoosar hoi ta sojhee pai ||
verses.translation: If there were another like Him, then only he could understand Him.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa keeaa sabh paravaan ||
verses.translation: His actions are all approved and accepted.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak ih jaan ||7||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, this is known. ||7||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jaanai tis sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: One who knows Him, obtains everlasting peace.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap milai le prabh soi ||
verses.translation: God blends that one into Himself.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਧਨਵੰਤੁ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: oh dhanava(n)t kulava(n)t pativa(n)t ||
verses.translation: He is wealth and prosperous, and of noble birth.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan mukat jis ridhai bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Lord God abides in his heart.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n dha(n)n jan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed, blessed is the coming of that humble being;

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis prasaadh sabh jagat taraiaa ||
verses.translation: by his grace, the whole world is saved.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਆਵਨ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: jan aavan kaa ihai suaau ||
verses.translation: This is his purpose in life;

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jan kai sa(n)g chit aavai naau ||
verses.translation: in the Company of this humble servant, the Lord's Name comes to mind.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap mukat mukat karai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is liberated, and He liberates the universe.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak tis jan kau sadhaa namasakaar ||8||23||
verses.translation: O Nanak, to that humble servant, I bow in reverence forever. ||8||23||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa prabh aaraadhiaa pooraa jaa kaa naau ||
verses.translation: I worship and adore the Perfect Lord God. Perfect is His Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pooraa paiaa poore ke gun gaau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have obtained the Perfect One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: asaTapadhee ||
verses.translation: Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kaa sun upadhes ||
verses.translation: Listen to the Teachings of the Perfect Guru;

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham nikaT kar pekh ||
verses.translation: see the Supreme Lord God near you.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas simarahu gobi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: man a(n)tar kee utarai chi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: and the anxiety within your mind shall depart.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਅਨਿਤ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: aas anit tiaagahu tara(n)g ||
verses.translation: Abandon the waves of fleeting desire,

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee dhoor man ma(n)g ||
verses.translation: and pray for the dust of the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd benatee karahu ||
verses.translation: Renounce your selfishness and conceit and offer your prayers.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g agan saagar tarahu ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the ocean of fire.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan ke bhar leh bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Fill your stores with the wealth of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gur poore namasakaar ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak bows in humility and reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਖੇਮ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: khem kusal sahaj aana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Happiness, intuitive peace, poise and bliss

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g bhaj paramaana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: in the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of supreme bliss.

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: narak nivaar udhaarahu jeeau ||
verses.translation: You shall be spared from hell - save your soul!

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gun gobi(n)dh a(n)mirat ras peeau ||
verses.translation: Drink in the ambrosial essence of the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਹੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਏਕ ॥
verses.translit: chit chitavahu naarain ek ||
verses.translation: Focus your consciousness on the One, the All-pervading Lord

verses.original: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: ek roop jaa ke ra(n)g anek ||
verses.translation: He has One Form, but He has many manifestations.

verses.original: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: gopaal dhaamodhar dheen dhiaal ||
verses.translation: Sustainer of the Universe, Lord of the world, Kind to the poor,

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh bha(n)jan pooran kirapaal ||
verses.translation: Destroyer of sorrow, perfectly Merciful.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar naam baara(n) baar ||
verses.translation: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Naam, again and again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jeea kaa ihai adhaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it is the Support of the soul. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਤਮ ਸਲੋਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ॥
verses.translit: autam salok saadh ke bachan ||
verses.translation: The most sublime hymns are the Words of the Holy.

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲੀਕ ਲਾਲ ਏਹਿ ਰਤਨ ॥
verses.translit: amuleek laal eh ratan ||
verses.translation: These are priceless rubies and gems.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਹੋਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sunat kamaavat hot udhaar ||
verses.translation: One who listens and acts on them is saved.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਲੋਕਹ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aap tarai lokeh nisataar ||
verses.translation: He himself swims across, and saves others as well.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: safal jeevan safal taa kaa sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: His life is prosperous, and his company is fruitful;

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai man laagaa har ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: his mind is imbued with the love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai sabadh anaahadh vaajai ||
verses.translation: Hail, hail to him, for whom the sound current of the Shabad vibrates.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun anadh kare prabh gaajai ||
verses.translation: Hearing it again and again, he is in bliss, proclaiming God's Praises.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਕੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: pragaTe gupaal mahaa(n)t kai maathe ||
verses.translation: The Lord radiates from the foreheads of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak udhare tin kai saathe ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak is saved in their company. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: saran jog sun saranee aae ||
verses.translation: Hearing that He can give Sanctuary, I have come seeking His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh aap milaae ||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਬੈਰ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਰੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: miT ge bair bhe sabh ren ||
verses.translation: Hatred is gone, and I have become the dust of all.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਲੈਨ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam saadhasa(n)g lain ||
verses.translation: I have received the Ambrosial Naam in the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: suprasa(n)n bhe gurdhev ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is perfectly pleased;

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hoiee sevak kee sev ||
verses.translation: the service of His servant has been rewarded.

verses.original: ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: aal ja(n)jaal bikaar te rahate ||
verses.translation: I have been released from worldly entanglements and corruption,

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam sun rasanaa kahate ||
verses.translation: hearing the Lord's Name and chanting it with my tongue.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar prasaadh dhiaa prabh dhaaree ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, God has bestowed His Mercy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak nibahee khep hamaaree ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my merchandise has arrived save and sound. ||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee usatat karahu sa(n)t meet ||
verses.translation: Sing the Praises of God, O Saints, O friends,

verses.original: ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਏਕਾਗਰ ਚੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: saavadhaan ekaagar cheet ||
verses.translation: with total concentration and one-pointedness of mind.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ਸਹਜ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sukhamanee sahaj gobi(n)dh gun naam ||
verses.translation: Sukhmani is the peaceful ease, the Glory of God, the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jis man basai su hot nidhaan ||
verses.translation: When it abides in the mind, one becomes wealthy.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab ichhaa taa kee pooran hoi ||
verses.translation: All desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: pradhaan purakh pragaT sabh loi ||
verses.translation: One becomes the most respected person, famous all over the world.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਪਾਏ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uooch paae asathaan ||
verses.translation: He obtains the highest place of all.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bahur na hovai aavan jaan ||
verses.translation: He does not come and go in reincarnation any longer.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan khaaT chalai jan soi ||
verses.translation: One who departs, after earning the wealth of the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jiseh paraapat hoi ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, realizes it. ||5||

verses.original: ਖੇਮ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: khem saa(n)t ridh nav nidh ||
verses.translation: Comfort, peace and tranquility, wealth and the nine treasures;

verses.original: ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਤਹ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: budh giaan sarab teh sidh ||
verses.translation: wisdom, knowledge, and all spiritual powers;

verses.original: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bidhiaa tap jog prabh dhiaan ||
verses.translation: learning, penance, Yoga and meditation on God;

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਊਤਮ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaan sresaT uootam isanaan ||
verses.translation: The most sublime wisdom and purifying baths;

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath kamal pragaas ||
verses.translation: the four cardinal blessings, the opening of the heart-lotus;

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kai madh sagal te udhaas ||
verses.translation: in the midst of all, and yet detached from all;

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਤਤ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar chatur tat kaa betaa ||
verses.translation: beauty, intelligence, and the realization of reality;

verses.original: ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: samadharasee ek dhirasaTetaa ||
verses.translation: to look impartially upon all, and to see only the One

verses.original: ਇਹ ਫਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਨੇ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eeh fal tis jan kai mukh bhane || gur naanak naam bachan man sune ||6||
verses.translation: - these blessings come to one who, through Guru Nanak, chants the Naam with his mouth, and hears the Word with his ears. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih nidhaan japai man koi ||
verses.translation: One who chants this treasure in his mind

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jug meh taa kee gat hoi ||
verses.translation: in every age, he attains salvation.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gun gobi(n)dh naam dhun baanee ||
verses.translation: In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਬਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: simirat saasatr bedh bakhaanee ||
verses.translation: The Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas speak of it.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਤਾਂਤ ਕੇਵਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sagal mataa(n)t keval har naam ||
verses.translation: The essence of all religion is the Lord's Name alone.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh bhagat kai man bisraam ||
verses.translation: It abides in the minds of the devotees of God.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: koT apraadh saadhasa(n)g miTai ||
verses.translation: Millions of sins are erased, in the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kirapaa te jam te chhuTai ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saint, one escapes the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai masatak karam prabh paae ||
verses.translation: Those, who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads,

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਆਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: saadh saran naanak te aae ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, enter the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis man basai sunai lai preet ||
verses.translation: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet ||
verses.translation: that humble person consciously remembers the Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran taa kaa dhookh nivaarai ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death are removed.

verses.original: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhulabh dheh tatakaal udhaarai ||
verses.translation: The human body, so difficult to obtain, is instantly redeemed.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: niramal sobhaa a(n)mirat taa kee baanee ||
verses.translation: Spotlessly pure is his reputation, and ambrosial is his speech.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: ek naam man maeh samaanee ||
verses.translation: The One Name permeates his mind.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh rog binase bhai bharam ||
verses.translation: Sorrow, sickness, fear and doubt depart.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: saadh naam niramal taa ke karam ||
verses.translation: He is called a Holy person; his actions are immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uooch taa kee sobhaa banee ||
verses.translation: His glory becomes the highest of all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਗੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ॥੮॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak ieh gun naam sukhamanee ||8||24||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by these Glorious Virtues, this is named Sukhmani, Peace of mind. ||8||24||

verses.original: ਥਿਤੀ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: thitee gauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days: Gauree, Fifth Mehla,

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal pooriaa suaamee sirajanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land, and the sky.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik bhaa(n)t hoi pasariaa naanak eka(n)kaar ||1||
verses.translation: In so many ways, the One, the Universal Creator has diffused Himself, O Nanak. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: ekam eka(n)kaar prabh karau ba(n)dhanaa dhiaai ||
verses.translation: The first day of the lunar cycle: Bow in humility and meditate on the One, the Universal Creator Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun gobi(n)dh gupaal prabh saran parau har rai ||
verses.translation: Praise God, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World; seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੁਖ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee aas kaliaan sukh jaa te sabh kachh hoi ||
verses.translation: Place your hopes in Him, for salvation and peace; all things come from Him.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaar ku(n)T dheh dhis bhramio tis bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: I wandered around the four corners of the world and in the ten directions, but I saw nothing except Him.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan simirat sune bahu bidh karau beechaar ||
verses.translation: I listened to the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, and I pondered over them in so many ways.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: patit udhaaran bhai haran sukh saagar nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: The Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaataa bhugataa dhenahaar tis bin avar na jai ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver, the Enjoyer, the Bestower - there is no place at all without Him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo chaaheh soiee milai naanak har gun gai ||1||
verses.translation: You shall obtain all that you desire, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh jas gaieeaai har neet ||
verses.translation: Sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, each and every day.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil bhajeeaai saadhasa(n)g mere meet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and vibrate, meditate on Him, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਵਾਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: karau ba(n)dhanaa anik vaar saran parau har rai ||
verses.translation: Bow in humility to the Lord, over and over again, and enter the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhram kaTeeaai naanak saadhasa(n)g dhuteeaa bhaau miTai ||2||
verses.translation: Doubt is eradicated, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, and the love of duality is eliminated. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: dhuteeaa dhuramat dhoor kar gur sevaa kar neet ||
verses.translation: The second day of the lunar cycle: Get rid of your evil-mindedness, and serve the Guru continually.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: raam ratan man tan basai taj kaam karodh lobh meet ||
verses.translation: The jewel of the Lord's Name shall come to dwell in your mind and body, when you renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, O my friend.

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: maran miTai jeevan milai binaseh sagal kales ||
verses.translation: Conquer death and obtain eternal life; all your troubles will depart.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: aap tajahu gobi(n)dh bhajahu bhaau bhagat paraves ||
verses.translation: Renounce your self-conceit and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe; loving devotion to Him shall permeate your being.

verses.original: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: laabh milai toTaa hirai har dharageh pativa(n)t ||
verses.translation: You shall earn profit and suffer no loss, and in the Court of the Lord you shall be honored.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan sa(n)chavai saach saeh bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: Those who gather in the riches of the Lord's Name are truly wealthy, and very blessed.

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat har bhajahu saadhoo sa(n)g pareet ||
verses.translation: So, when standing up and sitting down, vibrate upon the Lord, and cherish the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੁਟਿ ਗਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਸੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhuramat chhuT giee paarabraham base cheet ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, evil-mindedness is eradicated, when the Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: teen biaapeh jagat kau tureeaa paavai koi ||
verses.translation: The world is in the grip of the three qualities; only a few attain the fourth state of absorption.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t niramal bhe jin man vasiaa soi ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Saints are pure and immaculate; the Lord abides within their minds. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖੈ ਫਲ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: tirateeaa trai gun bikhai fal kab utam kab neech ||
verses.translation: The third day of the lunar cycle: Those who are bound by the three qualities gather poison as their fruit; now they are good, and now they are bad.

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਉ ਘਣੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੀਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: narak surag bhramatau ghano sadhaa sa(n)ghaarai meech ||
verses.translation: They wander endlessly in heaven and hell, until death annihilates them.

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog sahasaa sa(n)saar hau hau karat bihai ||
verses.translation: In pleasure and pain and worldly cynicism, they pass their lives acting in ego.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin ke'ee tiseh na jaananee chitaveh anik upai ||
verses.translation: They do not know the One who created them; they think up all sorts of schemes and plans.

verses.original: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਸ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: aadh biaadh upaadh ras kabahu na tooTai taap ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are distracted by pleasure and pain, and their fever never departs.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਨੀ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham pooran dhanee neh boojhai parataap ||
verses.translation: They do not realize the glorious radiance of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਬੂਡਤ ਘਣੋ ਮਹਾ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: moh bharam booddat ghano mahaa narak meh vaas ||
verses.translation: So many are being drowned in emotional attachment and doubt; they dwell in the most horrible hell.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh raakh leh naanak teree aas ||3||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Mercy, God, and save me! Nanak places his hopes in You. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਜਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: chatur siaanaa sughaR soi jin tajiaa abhimaan ||
verses.translation: One who renounces egotistical pride is intelligent, wise and refined.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath asaT sidh bhaj naanak har naam ||4||
verses.translation: The four cardinal blessings, and the eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas are obtained, O Nanak, by meditating, vibrating on the Lord's Name. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਚਤੁਰਥਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੋਧਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaturath chaare bedh sun sodhio tat beechaar ||
verses.translation: The fourth day of the lunar cycle: Listening to the four Vedas, and contemplating the essence of reality, I have come to realize

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਖੇਮ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarab khem kaliaan nidh raam naam jap saar ||
verses.translation: that the treasure of all joy and comfort is found in sublime meditation on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: narak nivaarai dhukh harai tooTeh anik kales ||
verses.translation: One is saved from hell, suffering is destroyed, countless pains depart,

verses.original: ਮੀਚੁ ਹੁਟੈ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: meech huTai jam te chhuTai har keeratan paraves ||
verses.translation: death is overcome, and one escapes the Messenger of Death, by absorption in the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhau binasai a(n)mrit rasai ra(n)g rate nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Fear departs, and one savors the Ambrosial Nectar, imbued with the Love of the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh dhaaridh apavitrataa naaseh naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: Pain, poverty and impurity are removed, with the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar mun jan khojate sukh saagar gopaal ||
verses.translation: The angels, the seers and the silent sages search for the Ocean of peace, the Sustainer of the world.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: man niramal mukh uoojalaa hoi naanak saadh ravaal ||4||
verses.translation: The mind becomes pure, and one's face is radiant, O Nanak, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ਰਾਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch bikaar man meh base raache maiaa sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The five evil passions dwell in the mind of one who is engrossed in Maya.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g hoi niramalaa naanak prabh kai ra(n)g ||5||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, one becomes pure, O Nanak, imbued with the Love of God. ||5||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪੰਚਮਿ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)cham pa(n)ch pradhaan te jeh jaanio parapa(n)ch ||
verses.translation: The fifth day of the lunar cycle: They are the self-elect, the most distinguished, who know the true nature of the world.

verses.original: ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣੋ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਲਬੰਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: kusam baas bahu ra(n)g ghano sabh mithiaa balaba(n)ch ||
verses.translation: The many colors and scents of flowers - all worldly deceptions are transitory and false.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: neh jaapai neh boojheeaai neh kachh karat beechaar ||
verses.translation: People do not see, and they do not understand; they do not reflect upon anything.

verses.original: ਸੁਆਦ ਮੋਹ ਰਸ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: suaadh moh ras bedhio agiaan rachio sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The world is pierced through with attachment to tastes and pleasures, engrossed in ignorance.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਣ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran bahu jon bhraman keene karam anek ||
verses.translation: Those who perform empty religious rituals will be born, only to die again. They wander through endless incarnations.

verses.original: ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: rachanahaar neh simario man na beechaar bibek ||
verses.translation: They do not meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord; their minds do not understand.

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
verses.translit: bhaau bhagat bhagavaan sa(n)g maiaa lipat na ra(n)ch ||
verses.translation: By loving devotion to the Lord God, you shall not be polluted by Maya at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਨ ਰਚਹਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak birale paie'eeh jo na racheh parapa(n)ch ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how rare are those, who are not engrossed in worldly entanglements. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਊਚੌ ਕਹਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: khaT saasatr uoochau kaheh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: The six Shaastras proclaim Him to be the greatest; He has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bhagat soheh gun gaavate naanak prabh kai dhuaar ||6||
verses.translation: The devotees look beauteous, O Nanak, when they sing the Glories of God at His Door. ||6||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਖਸਟਮਿ ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: khasaTam khaT saasatr kaheh si(n)mirat katheh anek ||
verses.translation: The sixth day of the lunar cycle: The six Shaastras say, and countless Simritees assert,

verses.original: ਊਤਮੁ ਊਚੌ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਖ ॥
verses.translit: uootam uoochau paarabraham gun a(n)t na jaaneh sekh ||
verses.translation: that the Supreme Lord God is the most sublime and lofty. Even the thousand-tongued serpent does not know the limits of His Glories.

verses.original: ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਕ ਬਿਆਸ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: naaradh mun jan suk biaas jas gaavat gobi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Naarad, the humble beings, Suk and Vyaasa sing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਰਸ ਗੀਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੀਧੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਚੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: ras geedhe har siau beedhe bhagat rache bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: They are imbued with the Lord's essence; united with Him; they are absorbed in devotional worship of the Lord God.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਪਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: moh maan bhram binasio paiee saran dhiaal ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment, pride and doubt are eliminated, when one takes to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal man tan base dharasan dhekh nihaal ||
verses.translation: His Lotus Feet abide within my mind and body and I am enraptured, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: laabh milai toTaa hirai saadhasa(n)g liv lai ||
verses.translation: People reap their profits, and suffer no loss, when they embrace love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਖਾਟਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: khaaT khajaanaa gun nidh hare naanak naam dhiaai ||6||
verses.translation: They gather in the treasure of the Lord, the Ocean of Excellence, O Nanak, by meditating on the Naam. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਥਹਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal har jas katheh boleh sat subhai ||
verses.translation: In the gathering of the Saints, chant the Praises of the Lord, and speak the Truth with love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak man sa(n)tokheeaai ekas siau liv lai ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the mind becomes contented, enshrining love for the One Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਪਤਮਿ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sapatam sa(n)chahu naam dhan TooT na jaeh bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: The seventh day of the lunar cycle: Gather the wealth of the Naam; this is a treasure which shall never be exhausted.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)gat meh paieeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, He is obtained; He has no end or limitations.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap tajahu gobi(n)dh bhajahu saran parahu har rai ||
verses.translation: Renounce your selfishness and conceit, and meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe; take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਹਰੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh harai bhavajal tarai man chi(n)dhiaa fal pai ||
verses.translation: Your pains shall depart - swim across the terrifying world-ocean, and obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar man har japai safal janam paravaan ||
verses.translation: One who meditates on the Lord twenty-four hours a day - fruitful and blessed is his coming into the world.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar sadhaa sa(n)g karanaihaar pachhaan ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, realize that the Creator Lord is always with you.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: so saajan so sakhaa meet jo har kee mat dhei ||
verses.translation: He is your friend, your companion, your very best friend, who imparts the Teachings of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak tis balihaaranai har har naam japei ||7||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to one who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਤਜੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar gun gaie'eeh taje'eeh avar ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord twenty-four hours a day; renounce other entanglements.

verses.original: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jamaka(n)kar joh na sakiee naanak prabhoo dhiaal ||8||
verses.translation: The Minister of Death cannot even see that person, O Nanak, unto whom God is merciful. ||8||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: asaTamee asaT sidh nav nidh ||
verses.translation: The eighth day of the lunar cycle: The eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas, the nine treasures,

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: sagal padhaarath pooran budh ||
verses.translation: all precious things, perfect intellect,

verses.original: ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: kaval pragaas sadhaa aana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: the opening of the heart-lotus, eternal bliss,

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਰੋਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: niramal reet nirodhar ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: pure lifestyle, the infallible Mantra,

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sagal dharam pavitr isanaan ||
verses.translation: all Dharmic virtues, sacred purifying baths,

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਊਚ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh uooch bisekh giaan ||
verses.translation: the most lofty and sublime spiritual wisdom

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har bhajan poore gur sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: these are obtained by meditating, vibrating upon the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jap tareeaai naanak naam har ra(n)g ||8||
verses.translation: You shall be saved, O Nanak, by lovingly chanting the Lord's Name. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naarain neh simario mohio suaadh bikaar ||
verses.translation: He does not remember the Lord in meditation; he is fascinated by the pleasures of corruption.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam bisaariaai narak surag avataar ||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, forgetting the Naam, he is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||9||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਅਪਵੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: naumee nave chhidhr apaveet ||
verses.translation: The ninth day of the lunar cycle: The nine holes of the body are defiled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har naam na japeh karat bipareet ||
verses.translation: People do not chant the Lord's Name; instead, they practice evil.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਮਹਿ ਬਕਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਨਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: par tria rameh bakeh saadh ni(n)dh ||
verses.translation: They commit adultery, slander the Saints,

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: karan na sunahee har jas bi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: and do not listen to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Praise.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਉਦਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hireh par dharab udhar kai taiee ||
verses.translation: They steal others' wealth for the sake of their own bellies,

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: agan na nivarai tirasanaa na bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: but the fire is not extinguished, and their thirst is not quenched.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਹ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: har sevaa bin eh fal laage ||
verses.translation: Without serving the Lord, these are their rewards.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh bisarat mar jameh abhaage ||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, forgetting God, the unfortunate people are born, only to die. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਦਸ ਦਿਸ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhas dhis khojat mai firio jat dhekhau tat soi ||
verses.translation: I have wandered, searching in the ten directions - wherever I look, there I see Him.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: man bas aavai naanakaa je pooran kirapaa hoi ||10||
verses.translation: The mind comes to be controlled, O Nanak, if He grants His Perfect Grace. ||10||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਦਸਮੀ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhasamee dhas dhuaar bas keene ||
verses.translation: The tenth day of the lunar cycle: Overpower the ten sensory and motor organs;

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: man sa(n)tokh naam jap leene ||
verses.translation: your mind will be content, as you chant the Naam.

verses.original: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਜਸੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: karanee suneeaai jas gopaal ||
verses.translation: With your ears, hear the Praises of the Lord of the World;

verses.original: ਨੈਨੀ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: nainee pekhat saadh dhiaal ||
verses.translation: with your eyes, behold the kind, Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa gun gaavai bea(n)t ||
verses.translation: With your tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: man meh chitavai pooran bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: In your mind, remember the Perfect Lord God.

verses.original: ਹਸਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: hasat charan sa(n)t Tahal kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: With your hands and feet, work for the Saints.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak ih sa(n)jam prabh kirapaa paieeaai ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this way of life is obtained by God's Grace. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: eko ek bakhaaneeaai biralaa jaanai savaiaadh ||
verses.translation: Describe the Lord as the One, the One and Only. How rare are those who know the taste of this essence.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: gun gobi(n)dh na jaaneeaai naanak sabh bisamaadh ||11||
verses.translation: The Glories of the Lord of the Universe cannot be known. O Nanak, He is totally amazing and wonderful! ||11||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: ekaadhasee nikaT pekhahu har raam ||
verses.translation: The eleventh day of the lunar cycle: Behold the Lord, the Lord, near at hand.

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhree bas kar sunahu har naam ||
verses.translation: Subdue the desires of your sexual organs, and listen to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man sa(n)tokh sarab jeea dhiaa ||
verses.translation: Let your mind be content, and be kind to all beings.

verses.original: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਰਤੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ein bidh barat sa(n)pooran bhiaa ||
verses.translation: In this way, your fast will be successful.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat man raakhai ik Thai ||
verses.translation: Keep your wandering mind restrained in one place.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan sudh japat har nai ||
verses.translation: Your mind and body shall become pure, chanting the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh poor rahe paarabraham ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is pervading amongst all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਟਲ ਏਹੁ ਧਰਮ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak har keeratan kar aTal eh dharam ||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this alone is the eternal faith of Dharma. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat haree sevaa karee bheTe saadh kirapaal ||
verses.translation: Evil-mindedness is eliminated, by meeting with and serving the compassionate Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh siau mil rahe binase sagal ja(n)jaal ||12||
verses.translation: Nanak is merged with God; all his entanglements have come to an end. ||12||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhuaadhasee dhaan naam isanaan ||
verses.translation: The twelfth day of the lunar cycle: Dedicate yourself to giving charity, chanting the Naam and purification.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat karahu taj maan ||
verses.translation: Worship the Lord with devotion, and get rid of your pride.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mirat paan karahu saadhasa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tirapataasai keeratan prabh ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The mind is satisfied by lovingly singing the Kirtan of God's Praises.

verses.original: ਕੋਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਸੰਤੋਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: komal baanee sabh kau sa(n)tokhai ||
verses.translation: The Sweet Words of His Bani soothe everyone.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਪੋਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch bhoo aatamaa har naam ras pokhai ||
verses.translation: The soul, the subtle essence of the five elements, cherishes the Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਏਹ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore te eh nihachau paieeaai ||
verses.translation: This faith is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak raam ramat fir jon na aaieeaai ||12||
verses.translation: O Nanak, dwelling upon the Lord, you shall not enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: teen gunaa meh biaapiaa pooran hot na kaam ||
verses.translation: Engrossed in the three qualities, one's efforts do not succeed.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: patit udhaaran man basai naanak chhooTai naam ||13||
verses.translation: When the Saving Grace of sinners dwells in the mind, O Nanak, then one is saved by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਉਦਸੀ ਤੀਨਿ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: traudhasee teen taap sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The thirteenth day of the lunar cycle: The world is in the fever of the three qualities.

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨਰਕ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aavat jaat narak avataar ||
verses.translation: It comes and goes, and is reincarnated in hell.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: har har bhajan na man meh aaio ||
verses.translation: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, does not enter into the minds of the people.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar prabh nimakh na gaio ||
verses.translation: They do not sing the Praises of God, the Ocean of peace, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog kaa dheh kar baadhio ||
verses.translation: This body is the embodiment of pleasure and pain.

verses.original: ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਸਾਧਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: dheeragh rog maiaa aasaadhio ||
verses.translation: It suffers from the chronic and incurable disease of Maya.

verses.original: ਦਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: dhineh bikaar karat sram paio ||
verses.translation: By day, people practice corruption, wearing themselves out.

verses.original: ਨੈਨੀ ਨੀਦ ਸੁਪਨ ਬਰੜਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: nainee needh supan baraRaio ||
verses.translation: And then with sleep in their eyes, they mutter in dreams.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਏਹ ਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: har bisarat hovat eh haal ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Lord, this is their condition.

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: saran naanak prabh purakh dhiaal ||13||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the kind and compassionate Primal Being. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: chaar ku(n)T chaudheh bhavan sagal biaapat raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord is pervading in all the four directions and the fourteen worlds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਊਨ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak uoon na dhekheeaai pooran taa ke kaam ||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He is not seen to be lacking anything; His works are perfectly complete. ||14||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਚਉਦਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: chaudheh chaar ku(n)T prabh aap ||
verses.translation: The fourteenth day of the lunar cycle: God Himself is in all four directions.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: sagal bhavan pooran parataap ||
verses.translation: On all worlds, His radiant glory is perfect.

verses.original: ਦਸੇ ਦਿਸਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhase dhisaa raviaa prabh ek ||
verses.translation: The One God is diffused in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharan akaas sabh meh prabh pekh ||
verses.translation: Behold God in all the earth and sky.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਬਨ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal ban parabat paataal ||
verses.translation: In the water, on the land, in the forests and mountains, and in the nether regions of the underworld,

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਤਹ ਬਸਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: paramesavair teh baseh dhiaal ||
verses.translation: the Merciful Transcendent Lord is abiding.

verses.original: ਸੂਖਮ ਅਸਥੂਲ ਸਗਲ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: sookham asathool sagal bhagavaan ||
verses.translation: The Lord God is in all mind and matter, subtle and manifest.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh braham pachhaan ||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes God. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: aatam jeetaa gurmatee gun gaae gobi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The soul is conquered, through the Guru's Teachings, singing the Glories of God.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadhee bhai miTe naanak binasee chi(n)dh ||15||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, fear is dispelled, O Nanak, and anxiety is ended. ||15||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅਮਾਵਸ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੀ ਭਏ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: amaavas aatam sukhee bhe sa(n)tokh dheeaa gurdhev ||
verses.translation: The day of the new moon: My soul is at peace; the Divine Guru has blessed me with contentment.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal saa(n)t sahaj laagaa prabh kee sev ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, in intuitive peace and poise; I have dedicated myself to serving God.

verses.original: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਫਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: TooTe ba(n)dhan bahu bikaar safal pooran taa ke kaam || dhuramat miTee haumai chhuTee simarat har ko naam ||
verses.translation: One who meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord - his bonds are broken, all his sins are erased, and his works are brought to perfect fruition; his evil-mindedness disappears, and his ego is subdued.

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: saran gahee paarabraham kee miTiaa aavaa gavan ||
verses.translation: Taking to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, his comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: aap tariaa kuTa(n)b siau gun gubi(n)dh prabh ravan ||
verses.translation: He saves himself, along with his family, chanting the Praises of God, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kee Tahal kamaavanee japeeaai prabh kaa naam ||
verses.translation: I serve the Lord, and I chant the Name of God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: gur poore te paiaa naanak sukh bisraam ||15||
verses.translation: From the Perfect Guru, Nanak has obtained peace and comfortable ease. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਤਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: pooran kabahu na ddolataa pooraa keeaa prabh aap ||
verses.translation: The perfect person never wavers; God Himself made him perfect.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: dhin dhin chaRai savaiaa naanak hot na ghaaT ||16||
verses.translation: Day by day, he prospers; O Nanak, he shall not fail. ||16||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨਮਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: pooranamaa pooran prabh ek karan kaaran samarath ||
verses.translation: The day of the full moon: God alone is Perfect; He is the All-powerful Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t dhiaal purakh sabh uoopar jaa kaa hath ||
verses.translation: The Lord is kind and compassionate to all beings and creatures; His Protecting Hand is over all.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan gobi(n)dh gur keeaa jaa kaa hoi ||
verses.translation: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Lord of the Universe; through the Guru, He acts.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee prabh sujaan alakh nira(n)jan soi ||
verses.translation: God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is All-knowing, Unseen and Immaculately Pure.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesaro sabh bidh jaananahaar ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is the Knower of all ways and means.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sahaiee saran jog aaTh pahar namasakaar ||
verses.translation: He is the Support of His Saints, with the Power to give Sanctuary. Twenty-four hours a day, I bow in reverence to Him.

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathaa neh boojheeaai simarahu har ke charan ||
verses.translation: His Unspoken Speech cannot be understood; I meditate on the Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: patit udhaaran anaath naath naanak prabh kee saran ||16||
verses.translation: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Master of the masterless; Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh binase sahasaa gio saran gahee har rai ||
verses.translation: My pain is gone, and my sorrows have departed, since I took to the Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhe fal paiaa naanak har gun gai ||17||
verses.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||17||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: koiee gaavai ko sunai koiee karai beechaar ||
verses.translation: Some sing, some listen, and some contemplate;

verses.original: ਕੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਕੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ko upadhesai ko dhiraRai tis kaa hoi udhaar ||
verses.translation: some preach, and some implant the Name within; this is how they are saved.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kilabikh kaaTai hoi niramalaa janam janam mal jai ||
verses.translation: Their sinful mistakes are erased, and they become pure; the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਨਹ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat mukh uoojalaa neh pohai tis mai ||
verses.translation: In this world and the next, their faces shall be radiant; they shall not be touched by Maya.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: so surataa so baisano so giaanee dhanava(n)t ||
verses.translation: They are intuitively wise, and they are Vaishnaavs, worshippers of Vishnu; they are spiritually wise, wealthy and prosperous.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: so sooraa kulava(n)t soi jin bhajiaa bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: They are spiritual heros, of noble birth, who vibrate upon the Lord God.

verses.original: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਬੈਸੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: khatree braahaman soodh bais udharai simar cha(n)ddaal ||
verses.translation: The Kh'shatriyas, the Brahmins, the low-caste Soodras, the Vaisha workers and the outcast pariahs are all saved,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jin jaanio prabh aapanaa naanak tiseh ravaal ||17||
verses.translation: meditating on the Lord. Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who know his God. ||17||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kee vaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Vaar In Gauree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਮਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh dhiaal hai jis no samat sabh koi ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is kind and compassionate; all are alike to Him.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਮਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਤੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ek dhirasaT kar dhekhadhaa man bhaavanee te sidh hoi ||
verses.translation: He looks upon all impartially; with pure faith in the mind, He is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vich a(n)mrit hai har utam har padh soi ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar is within the True Guru; He is exalted and sublime, of Godly status.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kirapaa te har dhiaaieeaai gurmukh paavai koi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, one meditates on the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain Him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maiaa sabh bikh hai nit jag toTaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Egotism and Maya are total poison; in these, people continually suffer loss in this world.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa har dhan khaTiaa gurmukh sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh earns the profit of the wealth of the Lord's Name, contemplating the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mail bikh utarai har a(n)mrit har ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: The poisonous filth of egotism is removed, when one enshrines the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within the heart.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kaaraj tin ke sidh heh jin gurmukh kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: All the Gurmukh's affairs are brought to perfect completion; the Lord has showered him with His Mercy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jo dhur mile se mil rahe har mele sirajanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who meets the Primal Lord remains blended with the Lord, the Creator Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too sachaa saahib sach hai sach sachaa gosaiee ||
verses.translation: You are True, O True Lord and Master. You are the Truest of the True, O Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸਭ ਧਿਆਇਦੀ ਸਭ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudhuno sabh dhiaaidhee sabh lagai teree paiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone meditates on You; everyone falls at Your Feet.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: teree sifat suaaliau saroop hai jin keetee tis paar laghaiee ||
verses.translation: Your Praises are graceful and beautiful; You save those who speak them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukhaa no fal paidhaa sach naam samaiee ||
verses.translation: You reward the Gurmukhs, who are absorbed in the True Name.

verses.original: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vadde mere saahibaa vaddee teree vaddiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: O my Great Lord and Master, great is Your glorious greatness. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai hor salaahanaa sabh bolan fikaa saadh ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, all other praise and speech is insipid and tasteless.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh aha(n)kaar salaahadhe haumai mamataa vaadh ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs praise their own egos; their attachment to egotism is useless.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਖਪਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin saalaahan se mareh khap jaavai sabh apavaadh ||
verses.translation: Those whom they praise, die; they all waste away in conflict.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮਾਨਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gurmukh ubare jap har har paramaanaadh ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur har prabh dhas naam dhiaaiee man haree ||
verses.translation: O True Guru, tell me of my Lord God, that I may meditate on the Naam within my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam pavit har mukh bolee sabh dhukh paraharee ||2||
