verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is sacred and pure; chanting it, all my pain has been taken away. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: too aape aap nira(n)kaar hai nira(n)jan har raiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Formless Lord, the Immaculate Lord, our Sovereign King.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jinee too ik man sach dhiaaiaa tin kaa sabh dhukh gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord with one-pointed mind, are rid of all their pain.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: teraa sareek ko naahee jis no lavai lai sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: You have no equal, next to whom I might sit and speak of You.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd dhaataa toohai nira(n)janaa toohai sach merai man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: You are the only Giver as great as Yourself. You are Immaculate; O True Lord, you are pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sache mere saahibaa sache sach naiaa ||2||
verses.translation: O my True Lord and Master, Your Name is the Truest of the True. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man a(n)tar haumai rog hai bhram bhoole manmukh dhurajanaa ||
verses.translation: Deep within the mind is the disease of ego; the self-willed manmukhs, the evil beings, are deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak rog gavai mil satigur saadhoo sajanaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this disease is eradicated, only when one meets the True Guru, our Holy Friend. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rataa ra(n)g siau gurmukh har gunataas ||
verses.translation: The mind and body of the Gurmukh are imbued with the Love of the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har saranaagatee har mele gur saabaas ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord. Hail to the Guru, who has united me with the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਵੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: too karataa purakh aga(n)m hai kis naal too vaReeaai ||
verses.translation: You are the Personification of Creativity, the Inaccessible Lord. With whom should I compare You?

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਪੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd hoi su aakheeaai tudh jehaa toohai paReeaai ||
verses.translation: If there was anyone else as great as You, I would name him; You alone are like Yourself.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: too ghaT ghaT ik varatadhaa gurmukh paragaReeaai ||
verses.translation: You are the One, permeating each and every heart; You are revealed to the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਤੂ ਚੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: too sachaa sabhas dhaa khasam hai sabh dhoo too chaReeaai ||
verses.translation: You are the True Lord and Master of all; You are the Highest of all.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਇਸੀ ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੜੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too kareh su sache hoisee taa kait kaReeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, O True Lord - that is what happens, so why should we grieve? ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan prem pira(n)m kaa aThe pahar laga(n)n ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of my Beloved, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kirapaa dhaar prabh satigur sukh vasa(n)n ||1||
verses.translation: Shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God, that he may dwell in peace with the True Guru. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੋਹੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin a(n)dhar preet pira(n)m kee jiau bolan tivai soha(n)n ||
verses.translation: Those whose inner beings are filled with the Love of their Beloved, look beautiful as they speak.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak har aape jaanadhaa jin laiee preet pira(n)n ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself knows all; the Beloved Lord has infused His Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਹੈ ਭੁਲਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too karataa aap abhul hai bhulan vich naahee ||
verses.translation: O Creator Lord, You Yourself are infallible; You never make mistakes.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਭਲਾ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too kareh su sache bhalaa hai gur sabadh bujhaahee ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do is good, O True Lord; this understanding is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too karan kaaran samarath hai dhoojaa ko naahee ||
verses.translation: You are the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: too saahib agam dhiaal hai sabh tudh dhiaahee ||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master, You are inaccessible and merciful. Everyone meditates on You.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਛਡਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabh jeea tere too sabhas dhaa too sabh chhaddaahee ||4||
verses.translation: All beings are Yours; You belong to all. You deliver all. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੰਦੇਸਰਾ ਅਖੀ ਤਾਰ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: sun saajan prem sa(n)dhesaraa akhee taar laga(n)n ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my Friend, to my message of love; my eyes are fixed upon You.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur tuThai sajan meliaa jan naanak sukh sava(n)n ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru was pleased - He united servant Nanak with his friend, and now he sleeps in peace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa dhiaal hai jis no dhiaa sadhaa hoi ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Merciful Giver; He is always compassionate.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur a(n)dharahu niravair hai sabh dhekhai braham ik soi ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has no hatred within Him; He beholds the One God everywhere.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਤਿਸਟਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: niravairaa naal j vair chalaidhe tin vichahu tisaTiaa na koi ||
verses.translation: Anyone who directs hate against the One who has no hate, shall never be satisfied within.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sabhanaa dhaa bhalaa manaidhaa tis dhaa buraa kiau hoi ||
verses.translation: The True Guru wishes everyone well; how can anything bad happen to Him?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਇਛਦਾ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur no jehaa ko ichhadhaa tehaa fal paae koi ||
verses.translation: As one feels towards the True Guru, so are the rewards he receives.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜਿਦੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਗੁਝਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak karataa sabh kichh jaanadhaa jidhoo kichh gujhaa na hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Creator knows everything; nothing can be hidden from Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis no saahib vaddaa kare soiee vadd jaanee ||
verses.translation: One who has been made great by his Lord and Master - know him to be great!

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis saahib bhaavai tis bakhas le so saahib man bhaanee ||
verses.translation: By His Pleasure, the Lord and Master forgives those who are pleasing to His Mind.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਓਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਮੂੜ ਅਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: je ko os dhee rees kare so mooR ajaanee ||
verses.translation: One who tries to compete with Him is a senseless fool.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis no satigur mele su gun ravai gun aakh vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: One who is united with the Lord by the True Guru, sings His Praises and speaks His Glories.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa sach hai bujh sach samaanee ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord is True; one who understands Him is absorbed in Truth. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har sat nira(n)jan amar hai nirabhau niravair nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord is true, immaculate and eternal; He has no fear, hatred or form.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਲਥਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin japiaa ik man ik chit tin lathaa haumai bhaar ||
verses.translation: Those who chant and meditate on Him, who single-mindedly focus their consciousness on Him, are rid of the burden of their ego.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin gurmukh har aaraadhiaa tin sa(n)t janaa jaikaar ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord - hail to those Saintly beings!

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: koiee ni(n)dhaa kare poore satiguroo kee tis no fiT fiT kahai sabh sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: If someone slanders the Perfect True Guru, he will be rebuked and reproached by the whole world.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vich aap varatadhaa har aape rakhanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself abides within the True Guru; He Himself is His Protector.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n guroo gun gaavadhaa tis no sadhaa sadhaa namasakaar ||
verses.translation: Blessed, Blessed is the Guru, who sings the Glories of God. Unto Him, I bow forever and ever in deepest reverence.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak tin kau vaariaa jin japiaa sirajanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have meditated on the Creator Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape dharatee saajeean aape aakaas ||
verses.translation: He Himself made the earth; He Himself made the sky.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: vich aape ja(n)t upaian mukh aape dhei giraas ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the beings there, and He Himself places food in their mouths.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aape aap varatadhaa aape hee gunataas ||
verses.translation: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself is the Treasure of Excellence.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟੇ ਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaai too sabh kilavikh kaTe taas ||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He shall take away all your sinful mistakes. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: too sachaa saahib sach hai sach sache bhaavai ||
verses.translation: You, O True Lord and Master, are True; the Truth is pleasing to the True One.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh sach salaahadhe tin jam ka(n)kar neR na aavai ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who praise You, O True Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਦਰਿ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke mukh dhar ujale jin har hiradhai sachaa bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord; the Lord is pleasing to their hearts.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਪਿਛਾਹਾ ਸਟੀਅਨਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kooRiaar pichhaahaa saTeean kooR hiradhai kapaT mahaa dhukh paavai ||
verses.translation: The false ones are left behind; because of the falsehood and deceit in their hearts, they suffer in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀਆ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: muh kaale kooRiaareeaa kooRiaar kooRo hoi jaavai ||6||
verses.translation: Black are the faces of the false; the false remain just false. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਰਮ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dharatee dharam hai tis vich jehaa ko beeje tehaa fal paae ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the field of Dharma; as one plants the seeds there, so are the fruits obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhee a(n)mrit beejiaa tin a(n)mirat fal har paae ||
verses.translation: The GurSikhs plant ambrosial nectar, and obtain the Lord as their ambrosial fruit.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਓਇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੀ ਪੈਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: onaa halat palat mukh ujale oi har dharageh sachee painaae ||
verses.translation: Their faces are radiant in this world and the next; in the Court of the Lord, they are robed with honor.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਨਿਤ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਓਹੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eikan(h)aa a(n)dhar khoT nit khoT kamaaveh oh jehaa beeje tehaa fal khaae ||
verses.translation: Some have cruelty in their hearts - they constantly act in cruelty; as they plant, so are the fruits which they eat.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਆਵਗੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਉਘੜਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa satigur saraaf nadhar kar dhekhai suaavageer sabh ughaR aae ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru, the Tester, observes with His Glance, the selfish ones are all exposed.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜੇਹਾ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਓਇ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹੇ ਦਯਿ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: oi jehaa chitaveh nit tehaa pain oi teho jehe dhay vajaae ||
verses.translation: As one thinks, so does he receive, and so does the Lord make him known.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਹੀ ਸਿਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhuhee siree khasam aape varatai nit kar kar dhekhai chalat sabaae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is pervading at both ends; He continually acts, and beholds His own play. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik man ik varatadhaa jit lagai so thai pai ||
verses.translation: The mortal is of one mind - whatever he dedicates it to, in that he is successful.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਨੇਰੀਆ ਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee galaa kare ghanereeaa j ghar vath hovai saiee khai ||
verses.translation: Some talk a lot, but they eat only that which is in their own homes.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur sojhee naa pavai aha(n)kaar na vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained, and egotism does not depart from within.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨੋ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਹਥੁ ਤਡਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)kaareeaa no dhukh bhukh hai hath taddeh ghar ghar ma(n)gai ||
verses.translation: Suffering and hunger cling to the egotistical people; they hold out their hands and beg from door to door.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ ਗੁਝੀ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kooR Thagee gujhee naa rahai mula(n)maa paaj leh jai ||
verses.translation: Their falsehood and fraud cannot remain concealed; their false appearances fall off in the end.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis hovai poorab likhiaa tis satigur milai prabh aai ||
verses.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny comes to meet God through the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਵਰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau lohaa paaras bheTeeaai mil sa(n)gat suvaran hoi jai ||
verses.translation: Just as iron is transmuted into gold by the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, so are people transformed by joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke prabh too dhanee jiau bhaavai tivai chalai ||2||
verses.translation: O God, You are the Master of servant Nanak; as it pleases You, You lead him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jin har hiradhai seviaa tin har aap milaae ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Lord with all his heart - the Lord Himself unites him with Himself.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gun kee saajh tin siau karee sabh avagan sabadh jalaae ||
verses.translation: He enters into a partnership with virtue and merit, and burns off all his demerits with the fire of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਿ ਪਲਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aaugan vikan palaree jis dheh su sache paae ||
verses.translation: Demerits are purchased cheap, like straw; he alone gathers merit, who is so blessed by the True Lord.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane jin aaugan meT gun paragaTeeaae ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has erased my demerits, and revealed my virtuous merits.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee vadde kee gurmukh aalaae ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh chants the glorious greatness of the great Lord God. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vich vaddee vaddiaaiee jo anadhin har har naam dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: Great is the greatness within the True Guru, who meditates night and day on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam ramat such sa(n)jam har naame hee tirapataavai ||
verses.translation: The repetition of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is his purity and self-restraint; with the Name of the Lord, He is satisfied.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਰਖ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har naam taan har naam dheebaan har naamo rakh karaavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is His power, and the Lord's Name is His Royal Court; the Lord's Name protects Him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਪੂਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo chit lai pooje gur moorat so man ichhe fal paavai ||
verses.translation: One who centers his consciousness and worships the Guru, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਾਰ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo ni(n)dhaa kare satigur poore kee tis karataa maar dhivaavai ||
verses.translation: But one who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall be killed and destroyed by the Creator.

verses.original: ਫੇਰਿ ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਓਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: fer oh velaa os hath na aavai oh aapanaa beejiaa aape khaavai ||
verses.translation: This opportunity shall not come into his hands again; he must eat what he himself has planted.

verses.original: ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਖੜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਇ ਗਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: narak ghor muh kaalai khaRiaa jiau tasakar pai galaavai ||
verses.translation: He shall be taken to the most horrible hell, with his face blackened like a thief, and a noose around his neck.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਬਰੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: fir satigur kee saranee pavai taa ubarai jaa har har naam dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: But if he should again take to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, then he shall be saved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਾਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har baataa aakh sunaae naanak har karate evai bhaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks and proclaims the Lord's Story; as it pleases the Creator, so does he speak. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੰਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੁਠਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kaa hukam na ma(n)nai oh manmukh agiaan muThaa bikh maiaa ||
verses.translation: One who does not obey the Hukam, the Command of the Perfect Guru - that self-willed manmukh is plundered by his ignorance and poisoned by Maya.

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕਰਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਅਣਹੋਦੇ ਝਗੜੇ ਦਯਿ ਓਸ ਦੈ ਗਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: os a(n)dhar kooR kooRo kar bujhai anahodhe jhagaRe dhay os dhai gal paiaa ||
verses.translation: Within him is falsehood, and he sees everyone else as false; the Lord has tied these useless conflicts around his neck.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਗਲ ਫਰੋਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: oh gal farosee kare bahuteree os dhaa boliaa kisai na bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He babbles on and on, but the words he speaks please no one.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੰਢੈ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਨ ਦੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਓਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੋੜੇ ਓਸੁ ਭੀ ਲਛਣੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: oh ghar ghar ha(n)ddai jiau ra(n)n dhuohaagan os naal muh joRe os bhee lachhan laiaa ||
verses.translation: He wanders from house to house like an abandoned woman; whoever associates with him is stained by the mark of evil as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਪਾਸੁ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi su alipato varatai os dhaa paas chhadd gur paas beh jaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who become Gurmukh avoid him; they forsake his company and sit near the Guru.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਓਨਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo gur gope aapanaa su bhalaa naahee pa(n)chahu on laahaa mool sabh gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: O chosen people, O self-elect, one who does not publicly affirm his Guru is not a good person; he loses all his profits and capital.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਆਗਮੁ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pahilaa aagam nigam naanak aakh sunaae poore gur kaa bachan upar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: People used to chant and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Nanak, but now the Words of the Perfect Guru have come to be the most exalted of all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa vaddiaaiee bhaavai gur poore kee manmukhaa oh velaa hath na aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is pleasing to the GurSikh; the self-willed manmukhs have lost this opportunity. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਟਿਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach sachaa sabh dhoo vaddaa hai so le jis satigur Tike ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is truly the greatest of all; he alone obtains Him, who is anointed by the Guru.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur j sach dhiaaidhaa sach sachaa satigur ike ||
verses.translation: He is the True Guru, who meditates on the True Lord. The True Lord and the True Guru are truly One.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਕੀਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਛਿਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: soiee satigur purakh hai jin pa(n)je dhoot keete vas chhike ||
verses.translation: He is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has totally conquered his five passions.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: j bin satigur seve aap ganaidhe tin a(n)dhar kooR fiT fiT muh fike ||
verses.translation: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who praises himself, is filled with falsehood within. Cursed, cursed is his ugly face.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਚੁਕੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: oi bole kisai na bhaavanee muh kaale satigur te chuke ||8||
verses.translation: His words are not pleasing to anyone; his face is blackened, and he is separated from the True Guru. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh kaa sabh khet hai har aap kirasaanee laiaa ||
verses.translation: Everyone is the field of the Lord God; the Lord Himself cultivates this field.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਜਮਾਈਅਨੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bakhas jamaieean manmukhee mool gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh grows the crop of forgiveness, while the self-willed manmukh loses even his roots.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਭਲੇ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko beeje aapane bhale no har bhaavai so khet jamaiaa ||
verses.translation: They all plant for their own good, but the Lord causes to grow only that field with which He is pleased.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhee har a(n)mrit beejiaa har a(n)mirat naam fal a(n)mrit paiaa ||
verses.translation: The GurSikh plants the seed of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and obtains the Lord's Ambrosial Naam as his Ambrosial Fruit.

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਚੂਹਾ ਕਿਰਸ ਨਿਤ ਕੁਰਕਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jam choohaa kiras nit kurakadhaa har karatai maar kaddaiaa ||
verses.translation: The mouse of Death is continually gnawing away at the crop, but the Creator Lord has beaten it off and driven it away.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਬਖਸ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kirasaanee ja(n)mee bhaau kar har bohal bakhas jamaiaa ||
verses.translation: The farm was successful, by the Love of the Lord, and the crop was produced by God's Grace.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਿਓਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin kaa kaaRaa a(n)dhesaa sabh laahion jinee satigur purakh dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has removed all the burning and anxiety of those, who have meditated on the True Guru, the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam araadhiaa aap tariaa sabh jagat taraiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, one who worships and adores the Naam, the Name of the Lord, swims across, and saves the whole world as well. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਰਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੇ ਗਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: saaraa dhin laalach aTiaa manmukh hore galaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is occupied with greed all day long, although he may claim otherwise.

verses.original: ਰਾਤੀ ਊਘੈ ਦਬਿਆ ਨਵੇ ਸੋਤ ਸਭਿ ਢਿਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: raatee uooghai dhabiaa nave sot sabh ddilaa ||
verses.translation: At night, he is overcome by fatigue, and all his nine holes are weakened.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਦੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੋਰਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਭਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukhaa dhai sir joraa amar hai nit dheveh bhalaa ||
verses.translation: Over the head of the manmukh is the order of the woman; to her, he ever holds out his promises of goodness.

verses.original: ਜੋਰਾ ਦਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਅਪਵਿਤ ਅਮੇਧ ਖਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: joraa dhaa aakhiaa purakh kamaavadhe se apavit amedh khalaa ||
verses.translation: Those men who act according to the orders of women are impure, filthy and foolish.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਨਰ ਸੇ ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਚਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam viaape kusudh nar se joraa puchh chalaa ||
verses.translation: Those impure men are engrossed in sexual desire; they consult their women and walk accordingly.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਖਿਐ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai aakhiaai jo chalai so sat purakh bhal bhalaa ||
verses.translation: One who walks as the True Guru tells him to, is the true man, the best of the best.

verses.original: ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਖੇਲ ਸਭਿ ਖਿਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: joraa purakh sabh aap upaian har khel sabh khilaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself created all women and men; the Lord Himself plays every play.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh teree banat banaavanee naanak bhal bhalaa ||2||
verses.translation: You created the entire creation; O Nanak, it is the best of the best. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੁਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: too veparavaahu athaahu hai atul kiau tuleeaai ||
verses.translation: You are carefree, unfathomable and immeasurable; how can You be measured?

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee j tudh dhiaaidhe jin satigur mileeaai ||
verses.translation: Those who have met the True Guru and who meditate on You are very fortunate.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਬਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee baanee sat saroop hai gurbaanee baneeaai ||
verses.translation: The Word of the True Guru's Bani is the embodiment of Truth; through Gurbani, one becomes perfect.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੀਸੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਚੁ ਪਿਚੁ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੇ ਝੜਿ ਪੜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee reesai hor kach pich boladhe se kooRiaar kooRe jhaR paReeaai ||
verses.translation: Jealously emulating the True Guru, some others may speak of good and bad, but the false are destroyed by their falsehood.

verses.original: ਓਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਝਖਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਕੜੀਐ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: on(h)aa a(n)dhar hor mukh hor hai bikh maiaa no jhakh maradhe kaReeaai ||9||
verses.translation: Deep within them is one thing, and in their mouths is another; they suck in the poison of Maya, and then they painfully waste away. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa niramalee niramal jan hoi su sevaa ghaale ||
verses.translation: Service to the True Guru is immaculate and pure; those humble beings who are pure perform this service.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਓਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੈ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੇ ਜਜਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin a(n)dhar kapaT vikaar jhooTh oi aape sachai vakh kadde jajamaale ||
verses.translation: Those who have deceit, corruption and falsehood within - the True Lord Himself casts them out like lepers.

verses.original: ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸਿਖ ਬਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਘਾਲਨਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਨ ਲਭਨੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਥਾਇ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sachiaar sikh beh satigur paas ghaalan kooRiaar na labhanee kitai thai bhaale ||
verses.translation: The truthful Sikhs sit by the True Guru's side and serve Him. The false ones search, but find no place of rest.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੁਹ ਭਲੇਰੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਯਿ ਗਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa satigur kaa aakhiaa sukhaavai naahee tinaa muh bhalere fireh dhay gaale ||
verses.translation: Those who are not pleased with the Words of the True Guru - their faces are cursed, and they wander around, condemned by God.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੇ ਕਿਚਰਕੁ ਵੇਰਾਈਅਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin a(n)dhar preet nahee har keree se kicharak veraieean manmukh betaale ||
verses.translation: Those who do not have the Love of the Lord within their hearts - how long can those demonic, self-willed manmukhs be consoled?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਥਾਇ ਰਖੈ ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਥੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur no milai su aapanaa man thai rakhai oh aap varatai aapanee vath naale ||
verses.translation: One who meets the True Guru, keeps his mind in its own place; he spends only his own assets.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੈ ਠਗਵਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ikanaa gur mel sukh dhevai ik aape vakh kaddai Thagavaale ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, some are united with the Guru; to some, the Lord grants peace, while others - deceitful cheats - suffer in isolation. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਦਯਿ ਆਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa a(n)dhar naam nidhaan har tin ke kaaj dhay aadhe raas ||
verses.translation: Those who have the treasure of the Lord's Name deep within their hearts - the Lord resolves their affairs.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin chookee muhataajee lokan kee har prabh a(n)g kar baiThaa paas ||
verses.translation: They are no longer subservient to other people; the Lord God sits by them, at their side.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਲਿ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) karataa val taa sabh ko val sabh dharasan dhekh kareh saabaas ||
verses.translation: When the Creator is on their side, then everyone is on their side. Beholding their vision, everyone applauds them.

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: saahu paatisaahu sabh har kaa keeaa sabh jan kau aai kareh raharaas ||
verses.translation: Kings and emperors are all created by the Lord; they all come and bow in reverence to the Lord's humble servant.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਵਡਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee vaddee vaddiaaiee har vaddaa sev atul sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Great is the greatness of the Perfect Guru. Serving the Great Lord, I have obtained immeasurable peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਬਖਸੇ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai dhaan dheeaa har nihachal nit bakhase chaRai savaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has bestowed this eternal gift upon the Perfect Guru; His blessings increase day by day.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koiee ni(n)dhak vaddiaaiee dhekh na sakai so karatai aap pachaiaa ||
verses.translation: The slanderer, who cannot endure His greatness, is destroyed by the Creator Himself.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gun bolai karate ke bhagataa no sadhaa rakhadhaa aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator, who protects His devotees forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too saahib agam dhiaal hai vadd dhaataa dhaanaa ||
verses.translation: You, O Lord and Master, are inaccessible and merciful; You are the Great Giver, All-knowing.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋ ਦਿਸਿ ਨਾ ਆਵਈ ਤੂਹੈਂ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd mai hor ko dhis naa aaviee toohai(n) sughaR merai man bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: I can see no other as great as You; O Lord of Wisdom, You are pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: moh kuTa(n)b dhis aavadhaa sabh chalanahaaraa aavan jaanaa ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to your family and everything you see is temporary, coming and going.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜਾ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo bin sache horat chit laidhe se kooRiaar kooRaa tin maanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who attach their consciousness to anything except the True Lord are false, and false is their pride.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak sach dhiaai too bin sache pach pach mue ajaanaa ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the True Lord; without the True Lord, the ignorant rot away and putrefy to death. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਿਚੈ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਆਖਿਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ago dhe sat bhaau na dhichai pichho dhe aakhiaa ka(n)m na aavai ||
verses.translation: At first, he did not show respect to the Guru; later, he offered excuses, but it is no use.

verses.original: ਅਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: adh vich firai manmukh vechaaraa galee kiau sukh paavai ||
verses.translation: The wretched, self-willed manmukhs wander around and are stuck mid-way; how can they find peace by mere words?

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)dhar preet nahee satigur kee su kooRee aavai kooRee jaavai ||
verses.translation: Those who have no love for the True Guru within their hearts come with falsehood, and leave with falsehood.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je kirapaa kare meraa har prabh karataa taa(n) satigur paarabraham nadharee aavai ||
verses.translation: When my Lord God, the Creator, grants His Grace, then they come to see the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: taa apiau peevai sabadh gur keraa sabh kaaRaa a(n)dhesaa bharam chukaavai ||
verses.translation: Then, they drink in the Nectar, the Word of the Guru's Shabad; all burning, anxiety, and doubts are eliminated.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee jan naanak anadhin har gun gaavai ||1||
verses.translation: They remain in ecstasy forever, day and night; O servant Nanak, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਅਖਾਏ ਸੁ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur kaa jo sikh akhaae su bhalake uTh har naam dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: One who calls himself a Sikh of the Guru, the True Guru, shall rise in the early morning hours and meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਭਲਕੇ ਪਰਭਾਤੀ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: audham kare bhalake parabhaatee isanaan kare a(n)mirat sar naavai ||
verses.translation: Upon arising early in the morning, he is to bathe, and cleanse himself in the pool of nectar.

verses.original: ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aupadhes guroo har har jap jaapai sabh kilavikh paap dhokh leh jaavai ||
verses.translation: Following the Instructions of the Guru, he is to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. All sins, misdeeds and negativity shall be erased.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਚੜੈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: fir chaRai dhivas gurbaanee gaavai bahadhiaa uThadhiaa har naam dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: Then, at the rising of the sun, he is to sing Gurbani; whether sitting down or standing up, he is to meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo saas giraas dhiaae meraa har har so gursikh guroo man bhaavai ||
verses.translation: One who meditates on my Lord, Har, Har, with every breath and every morsel of food - that GurSikh becomes pleasing to the Guru's Mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no dhiaal hovai meraa suaamee tis gursikh guroo upadhes sunaavai ||
verses.translation: That person, unto whom my Lord and Master is kind and compassionate - upon that GurSikh, the Guru's Teachings are bestowed.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੂੜਿ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dhooR ma(n)gai tis gursikh kee jo aap japai avareh naam japaavai ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of that GurSikh, who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਥੋੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh sach dhiaaidhe se virale thoRe ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord - they are very rare.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਕਰੋੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo man chit ik araadhadhe tin kee barakat khaeh asa(n)kh karoRe ||
verses.translation: Those who worship and adore the One Lord in their conscious minds - through their generosity, countless millions are fed.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸਭ ਧਿਆਇਦੀ ਸੇ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲੋੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: tudhuno sabh dhiaaidhee se thai pe jo saahib loRe ||
verses.translation: All meditate on You, but they alone are accepted, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਖਾਦੇ ਪੈਨਦੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਕੋੜ੍ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo bin satigur seve khaadhe painadhe se mue mar ja(n)me koRhe ||
verses.translation: Those who eat and dress without serving the True Guru die; after death, those wretched lepers are consigned to reincarnation.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਕਢਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਘੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi haajar miThaa boladhe baahar vis kaddeh mukh ghole ||
verses.translation: In His Sublime Presence, they talk sweetly, but behind His back, they exude poison from their mouths.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਦਯਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: man khoTe dhay vichhoRe ||11||
verses.translation: The evil-minded are consigned to separation from the Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਲੁ ਜੂਈ ਭਰਿਆ ਨੀਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਖਿਧੋਲੜਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਵੇਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੈ ਨੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mal jooiee bhariaa neelaa kaalaa khidholaRaa tin vemukh vemukhai no paiaa ||
verses.translation: The faithless baymukh sent out his faithless servant, wearing a blue-black coat, filled with filth and vermin.

verses.original: ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕੋਈ ਬਹਣਿ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਗੂਹ ਪੜਿ ਸਗਵੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਇ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paas na dheiee koiee bahan jagat meh gooh paR sagavee mal lai manmukh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: No one in the world will sit near him; the self-willed manmukh fell into manure, and returned with even more filth covering him.

verses.original: ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਨੋ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਓਥੈ ਭੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਦੁਹਾ ਵੇਮੁਖਾ ਦਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paraiee jo ni(n)dhaa chugalee no vemukh kar kai bhejiaa othai bhee muh kaalaa dhuhaa vemukhaa dhaa karaiaa ||
verses.translation: The faithless baymukh was sent to slander and back-bite others, but when he went there, the faces of both he and his faithless master were blackened instead.

verses.original: ਤੜ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸਭਤੁ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਈ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਸਣੈ ਨਫਰੈ ਪਉਲੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਫਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਉਠਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: taR suniaa sabhat jagat vich bhaiee vemukh sanai nafarai paulee paudhee faavaa hoi kai uTh ghar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: It was immediately heard throughout the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, that this faithless man, along with his servant, was kicked and beaten with shoes; in humiliation, they got up and returned to their homes.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਕੁੜਮੀ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਰਲਣਾ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਹੁਟੀ ਭਤੀਜਂੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: agai sa(n)gatee kuRamee vemukh ralanaa na milai taa vahuTee bhateeja(n)ee fir aan ghar paiaa ||
verses.translation: The faithless baymukh was not allowed to mingle with others; his wife and niece then brought him home to lie down.

verses.original: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਨਿਤ ਭੁਖਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat dhovai ge nit bhukhaa kooke tihaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has lost both this world and the next; he cries out continually, in hunger and thirst.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਬਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan suaamee karataa purakh hai jin niaau sach beh aap karaiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Creator, the Primal Being, our Lord and Master; He Himself sits and dispenses true justice.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo ni(n)dhaa kare satigur poore kee so saachai maar pachaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru is punished and destroyed by the True Lord.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eh akhar tin aakhiaa jin jagat sabh upaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: This Word is spoken by the One who created the whole universe. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨੰਗਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਨਫਰੁ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਰਜਿ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saahib jis kaa na(n)gaa bhukhaa hovai tis dhaa nafar kithahu raj khaae ||
verses.translation: One who has a poor beggar for a master - how can he be well-fed?

verses.original: ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਫਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਆਵੈ ਅਣਹੋਦੀ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: j saahib kai ghar vath hovai su nafarai hath aavai anahodhee kithahu paae ||
verses.translation: If there is something in his master's house, he can get it; but how can he get what is not there?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਉਖੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhee sevaa keetee fir lekhaa ma(n)geeaai saa sevaa aaukhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: Serving him, who will be called to answer for his account? That service is painful and useless.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sevaa karahu har gur safal dharasan kee fir lekhaa ma(n)gai na koiee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, serve the Guru, the Lord Incarnate; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is profitable, and in the end, you shall not be called to account. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਹੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak veechaareh sa(n)t jan chaar vedh kaha(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Saints consider, and the four Vedas proclaim,

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਮੁਖੈ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਚਨ ਹੋਵੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat mukhai te boladhe se vachan hova(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: that whatever the Lord's devotees utter with their mouths, shall come to pass.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰਾ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: pragaT pahaaraa jaapadhaa sabh lok suna(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: He is manifest in His cosmic workshop. All people hear of this.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਹੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh na pain mugadh nar sa(n)t naal khaha(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: The stubborn men who fight with the Saints shall never find peace.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਓਨਾ ਗੁਣੈ ਨੋ ਓਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੜੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi lochan onaa gunai no oi aha(n)kaar saRa(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they only burn in their egos.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾ ਭਾਗ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi vichaare kiaa kareh jaa bhaag dhur ma(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: What can those wretched ones do, since, from the very beginning, their destiny is cursed with evil.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo maare tin paarabraham se kisai na sa(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God are of no use to anyone.

verses.original: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਇ ਪਚੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: vair kareh niravair naal dharam niaai pacha(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Those who hate the One who has no hatred - according to the true justice of Dharma, they shall perish.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਸਰਾਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo sa(n)t saraapiaa se fireh bhava(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Those who are cursed by the Saints will continue wandering aimlessly.

verses.original: ਪੇਡੁ ਮੁੰਢਾਹੂੰ ਕਟਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡਾਲ ਸੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: pedd mu(n)ddaahoo(n) kaTiaa tis ddaal suka(n)dhe ||12||
verses.translation: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar har guroo dhiaaidhaa vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Great is the greatness of the Guru, who meditates on the Lord within.

verses.original: ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਘਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tus dhitee poorai satiguroo ghaTai naahee ik til kisai dhee ghaTaiee ||
verses.translation: By His Pleasure, the Lord has bestowed this upon the Perfect True Guru; it is not diminished one bit by anyone's efforts.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਭ ਲੋੁਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sach saahib satiguroo kai val hai taa(n) jhakh jhakh marai sabh luokaiee ||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master is on the side of the True Guru; and so, all those who oppose Him waste away to death in anger, envy and conflict.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhakaa ke muh kaale kare har karatai aap vadhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Creator, blackens the faces of the slanderers, and increases the glory of the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau ni(n)dhak ni(n)dh kareh tiau tiau nit nit chaRai savaiee ||
verses.translation: As the slanderers spread their slander, so does the Guru's glory increase day by day.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਣਿ ਸਭ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har aaraadhiaa tin pairee aan sabh paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak worships the Lord, who makes everyone fall at His Feet. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਗਣਤ ਜਿ ਰਖੈ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur setee ganat j rakhai halat palat sabh tis kaa giaa ||
verses.translation: One who enters into a calculated relationship with the True Guru loses everything, this world and the next.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਝਹੀਆ ਪਾਏ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟੇ ਝਖਦਾ ਝਖਦਾ ਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nit jhaheeaa paae jhagoo suTe jhakhadhaa jhakhadhaa jhaR piaa ||
verses.translation: He grinds his teeth continually and foams at the mouth; screaming in anger, he perishes.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਉਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nit upaav karai maiaa dhan kaaran agalaa dhan bhee udd giaa ||
verses.translation: He continually chases after Maya and wealth, but even his own wealth flies away.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਖਟੇ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa oh khaTe kiaa oh khaavai jis a(n)dhar sahasaa dhukh piaa ||
verses.translation: What shall he earn, and what shall he eat? Within his heart, there is only cynicism and pain.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਏ ਸਭੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਜਗਤੈ ਕਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: niravairai naal j vair rachaae sabh paap jagatai kaa tin sir liaa ||
verses.translation: One who hates the One who has no hatred, shall bear the load of all the sins of the world on his head.

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਅੰਬੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: os agai pichhai ddoiee naahee jis a(n)dhar ni(n)dhaa muh a(n)b piaa ||
verses.translation: He shall find no shelter here or hereafter; his mouth blisters with the slander in his heart.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਨੋ ਓਹੁ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਖੇਹੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: je suine no oh hath paae taa khehoo setee ral giaa ||
verses.translation: If gold comes into his hands, it turns to dust.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: je gur kee saranee fir oh aavai taa pichhale aaugan bakhas liaa ||
verses.translation: But if he should come again to the Sanctuary of the Guru, then even his past sins shall be forgiven.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak anadhin naam dhiaaiaa har simarat kilavikh paap giaa ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, night and day. Remembering the Lord in meditation, wickedness and sins are erased. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੂ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: toohai sachaa sach too sabh dhoo upar too dheebaan ||
verses.translation: You are the Truest of the True; Your Regal Court is the most exalted of all.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh sach dhiaaidhe sach sevan sache teraa maan ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord, serve the Truth; O True Lord, they take pride in You.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: onaa a(n)dhar sach mukh ujale sach bolan sache teraa taan ||
verses.translation: Within them is the Truth; their faces are radiant, and they speak the Truth. O True Lord, You are their strength.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: se bhagat jinee gurmukh saalaahiaa sach sabadh neesaan ||
verses.translation: Those who, as Gurmukh, praise You are Your devotees; they have the insignia and the banner of the Shabad, the True Word of God.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sach j sache sevadhe tin vaaree sadh kurabaan ||13||
verses.translation: I am truly a sacrifice, forever devoted to those who serve the True Lord. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਈ ਹੁਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhur maare poorai satiguroo seiee hun satigur maare ||
verses.translation: Those who were cursed by the Perfect True Guru, from the very beginning, are even now cursed by the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਮੇਲਣ ਨੋ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: je melan no bahuteraa locheeaai na dheiee milan karataare ||
verses.translation: Even though they may have a great longing to associate with the Guru, the Creator does not allow it.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat ddoiee naa lahan vich sa(n)gat gur veechaare ||
verses.translation: They shall not find shelter in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; in the Sangat, the Guru has proclaimed this.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੁਣਿ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee jai milai hun onaa no tis maare jam ja(n)dhaare ||
verses.translation: Whoever goes out to meet them now, will be destroyed by the tyrant, the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਬਾਬੈ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਸੇ ਫਿਟੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਗਦਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur baabai fiTake se fiTe gur a(n)gadh keete kooRiaare ||
verses.translation: Those who were condemned by Guru Nanak were declared counterfeit by Guru Angad as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੀਜੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਹਥਿ ਏਨਾ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur teejee peeRee veechaariaa kiaa hath enaa vechaare ||
verses.translation: The Guru of the third generation thought, ""What lies in the hands of these poor people?""

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਚਉਥੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur chauthee peeRee Tikiaa tin ni(n)dhak dhusaT sabh taare ||
verses.translation: The Guru of the fourth generation saved all these slanderers and evil-doers.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਪੁਤੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee put sikh sevaa kare satiguroo kee tis kaaraj sabh savaare ||
verses.translation: If any son or Sikh serves the True Guru, then all of his affairs will be resolved.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਖੜਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo ichhai so fal paisee put dhan lakhamee khaR mele har nisataare ||
verses.translation: He obtains the fruits of his desires - children, wealth, property, union with the Lord and emancipation.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh nidhaan satiguroo vich jis a(n)dhar har ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: All treasures are in the True Guru, who has enshrined the Lord within the heart.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: so paae pooraa satiguroo jis likhiaa likhat lilaare ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such blessed destiny is pre-ordained.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak maagai dhooR tin jo gursikh mit piaare ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs who love the Lord, their Friend. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਣਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau aap dhei vaddiaaiee jagat bhee aape aan tin kau pairee paae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself bestows glorious greatness; He Himself causes the world to come and fall at their feet.

verses.original: ਡਰੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪ ਦੂ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਲਾ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ddareeaai taa(n) je kichh aap dhoo keechai sabh karataa aapanee kalaa vadhaae ||
verses.translation: We should only be afraid, if we try to do things by ourselves; the Creator is increasing His Power in every way.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਜੋਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhahu bhaiee eh akhaaRaa har preetam sache kaa jin aapanai jor sabh aan nivaae ||
verses.translation: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny: this is the Arena of the Beloved True Lord; His power brings everyone to bow in humility.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਖ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapaniaa bhagataa kee rakh kare har suaamee ni(n)dhakaa dhusaTaa ke muh kaale karaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord, our Lord and Master, preserves and protects His devotees; He blackens the faces of the slanderers and evil-doers.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee vaddiaaiee nit chaRai savaiee har keerat bhagat nit aap karaae ||
verses.translation: The glorious greatness of the True Guru increases day by day; the Lord inspires His devotees to continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam japahu gursikhahu har karataa satigur gharee vasaae ||
verses.translation: O GurSikhs, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, night and day; through the True Guru, the Creator Lord will come to dwell within the home of your inner being.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕਢਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee baanee sat sat kar jaanahu gursikhahu har karataa aap muhahu kaddaae ||
verses.translation: O GurSikhs, know that the Bani, the Word of the True Guru, is true, absolutely true. The Creator Lord Himself causes the Guru to chant it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਉਜਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa ke muh ujale kare har piaaraa gur kaa jaikaar sa(n)saar sabhat karaae ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Lord makes the faces of His GurSikhs radiant; He makes the whole world applaud and acclaim the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kaa dhaas hai har dhaasan kee har paij rakhaae ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; the Lord Himself preserves the honor of His slave. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too sachaa saahib aap hai sach saeh hamaare ||
verses.translation: O My True Lord and Master, You Yourself are my True Lord King.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach poojee naam dhiraRai prabh vanajaare thaare ||
verses.translation: Please, implant within me the true treasure of Your Name; O God, I am Your merchant.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਹ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach seveh sach vana(n)j laih gun katheh niraare ||
verses.translation: I serve the True One, and deal in the True One; I chant Your Wondrous Praises.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sevak bhai se jan mile gur sabadh savaare ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who serve the Lord with love meet Him; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: too sachaa saahib alakh hai gur sabadh lakhaare ||14||
verses.translation: O my True Lord and Master, You are unknowable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are known. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)dhar taat paraiee hovai tis dhaa kadhe na hovee bhalaa ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with jealousy of others, never comes to any good.

verses.original: ਓਸ ਦੈ ਆਖਿਐ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਓਜਾੜੀ ਪੂਕਾਰੇ ਖਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: os dhai aakhiaai koiee na lagai nit ojaaRee pookaare khalaa ||
verses.translation: No one pays any attention to what he says; he is just a fool, crying out endlessly in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਚੁਗਲੋ ਵਜੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)dhar chugalee chugalo vajai keetaa karatiaa os dhaa sabh giaa ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with malicious gossip, is known as a malicious gossip; everything he does is in vain.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਅਣਹੋਦੀ ਪਰਾਈ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nit chugalee kare anahodhee paraiee muh kadd na sakai os dhaa kaalaa bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he continually gossips about others; his face has been blackened, and he cannot show it to anyone.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharatee sareer kalijug vich jehaa ko beeje tehaa ko khaae ||
verses.translation: The body is the field of action, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; as you plant, so shall you harvest.

verses.original: ਗਲਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਵਿਸੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: galaa upar tapaavas na hoiee vis khaadhee tatakaal mar jaae ||
verses.translation: Justice is not passed on mere words; if someone eats poison, he dies.

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee vekhahu niaau sach karate kaa jehaa koiee kare tehaa koiee paae ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, behold the justice of the True Creator; as people act, so they are rewarded.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau sabh sojhee paiee har dhar keeaa baataa aakh sunaae ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord has bestowed total understanding upon servant Nanak; he speaks and proclaims the words of the Lord's Court. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਦੈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: hodhai paratakh guroo jo vichhuRe tin kau dhar ddoiee naahee ||
verses.translation: Those who separate themselves from the Guru, in spite of His Constant Presence - they find no place of rest in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਕੇ ਥੁਕ ਥੁਕ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: koiee jai milai tin ni(n)dhakaa muh fike thuk thuk muh paahee ||
verses.translation: If someone goes to meet with those dull-faced slanderers, he will find their faces covered with spit.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਸੇ ਸਭ ਜਗਤਿ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਭੰਭਲ ਭੂਸੇ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo satigur fiTake se sabh jagat fiTake nit bha(n)bhal bhoose khaahee ||
verses.translation: Those who are cursed by the True Guru, are cursed by all the world. They wander around endlessly.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਢਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin gur gopiaa aapanaa se laidhe ddahaa firaahee ||
verses.translation: Those who do not publicly affirm their Guru wander around, moaning and groaning.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖ ਕੂਕਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee bhukh kadhe na utarai nit bhukhaa bhukh kookaahee ||
verses.translation: Their hunger shall never depart; afflicted by constant hunger, they cry out in pain.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਦਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਕੋ ਨਾ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਉਲੇ ਹਉਲਿ ਮਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: onaa dhaa aakhiaa ko naa sunai nit haule haul maraahee ||
verses.translation: No one hears what they have to say; they live in constant fear and terror, until they finally die.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਨੀ ਓਨਾ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee vaddiaaiee vekh na sakanee onaa agai pichhai thaau naahee ||
verses.translation: They cannot bear the glorious greatness of the True Guru, and they find no place of rest, here or hereafter.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਰਹਦੀ ਖੁਹਦੀ ਸਭ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo satigur maare tin jai mileh rahadhee khuhadhee sabh pat gavaahee ||
verses.translation: Those who go out to meet with those who have been cursed by the True Guru, lose all remnants of their honor.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਅਗੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਜਿ ਓਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਸਟੁ ਉਠਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: oi agai kusaTee gur ke fiTake j os milai tis kusaT uThaahee ||
verses.translation: They have already become like lepers; cursed by the Guru, whoever meets them is also afflicted with leprosy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: har tin kaa dharasan naa karahu jo dhoojai bhai chit laahee ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I pray that I may not even catch sight of those, who focus their consciousness on the love of duality.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਾਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhur karatai aap likh paiaa tis naal kih chaaraa naahee ||
verses.translation: That which the Creator pre-ordained from the very beginning - there can be no escape from that.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਤੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam araadh too tis apaR ko na sakaahee ||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no one can equal it.

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਵਾਈ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naavai kee vaddiaaiee vaddee hai nit savaiee chaRai chaRaahee ||2||
verses.translation: Great is the greatness of His Name; it increases, day by day. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿ ਹੋਂਦੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹਿ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: j ho(n)dhai guroo beh Tikiaa tis jan kee vaddiaaiee vaddee hoiee ||
verses.translation: Great is the greatness of that humble being, whom the Guru Himself anointed in His Presence.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਵਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਇਆ ਜਸੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau jagat niviaa sabh pairee piaa jas varatiaa loiee ||
verses.translation: All the world comes and bows to him, falling at his feet. His praises spread throughout the world.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd namasakaar kareh jis kai masatak hath dhariaa gur poorai so pooraa hoiee ||
verses.translation: The galaxies and solar systems bow in reverence to him; the Perfect Guru has placed His hand upon his head, and he has become perfect.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee vaddiaaiee nit chaRai savaiee apaR ko na sakoiee ||
verses.translation: The glorious greatness of the Guru increases day by day; no one can equal it.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਬਹਿ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har karatai aap beh Tikiaa aape paij rakhai prabh soiee ||3||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, the Creator Lord Himself established him; God preserves his honor. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa koT apaar hai a(n)dhar haTanaale ||
verses.translation: The human body is a great fortress, with its shops and streets within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saudhaa jo kare har vasat samaale ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh who comes to trade gathers the cargo of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਹੀਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan har vanajeeaai heere paravaale ||
verses.translation: He deals in the treasure of the Lord's Name, the jewels and the diamonds.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਜਿ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਧਨੁ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਸੇ ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: vin kaiaa j hor thai dhan khojadhe se mooR betaale ||
verses.translation: Those who search for this treasure outside of the body, in other places, are foolish demons.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਝਾੜ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: se ujhaR bharam bhavaie'eeh jiau jhaaR mirag bhaale ||15||
verses.translation: They wander around in the wilderness of doubt, like the deer who searches for the musk in the bushes. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo ni(n)dhaa kare satigur poore kee su aaukhaa jag meh hoiaa ||
verses.translation: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall have difficulty in this world.

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਖੂਹੁ ਹੈ ਓਥੈ ਪਕੜਿ ਓਹੁ ਢੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: narak ghor dhukh khooh hai othai pakaR oh ddoiaa ||
verses.translation: He is caught and thrown into the most horrible hell, the well of pain and suffering.

verses.original: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਓਹੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਰੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kook pukaar ko na sune oh aaukhaa hoi hoi roiaa ||
verses.translation: No one listens to his shrieks and cries; he cries out in pain and misery.

verses.original: ਓਨਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: on halat palat sabh gavaiaa laahaa mool sabh khoiaa ||
verses.translation: He totally loses this world and the next; he has lost all of his investment and profit.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਤੇਲੀ ਸੰਦਾ ਬਲਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: oh telee sa(n)dhaa baladh kar nit bhalake uTh prabh joiaa ||
verses.translation: He is like the ox at the oil-press; each morning when he rises, God places the yoke upon him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਦੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਗੁਝਾ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har vekhai sunai nit sabh kichh tidhoo kichh gujhaa na hoiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord always sees and hears everything; nothing can be concealed from Him.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਬੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa beeje so lunai jehaa purab kinai boiaa ||
verses.translation: As you plant, so shall you harvest, according to what you planted in the past.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis kirapaa kare prabh aapanee tis satigur ke charan dhoiaa ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by God's Grace washes the feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਕਾਠ ਸੰਗੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur pichhai tar giaa jiau lohaa kaaTh sa(n)goiaa ||
verses.translation: He is carried across by the Guru, the True Guru, like iron which is carried across by wood.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaai too jap har har naam sukh hoiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, peace is obtained. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaageeaa sohaaganee jinaa gurmukh miliaa har rai ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate is the soul-bride, who, as Gurmukh, meets the Lord, her King.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jot pragaaseeaa naanak naam samai ||2||
verses.translation: Her inner being is illiminated with His Divine Light; O Nanak, she is absorbed in His Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih sareer sabh dharam hai jis a(n)dhar sache kee vich jot ||
verses.translation: This body is the home of Dharma; the Divine Light of the True Lord is within it.

verses.original: ਗੁਹਜ ਰਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੁਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਢੈ ਖੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: guhaj ratan vich luk rahe koiee gurmukh sevak kaddai khot ||
verses.translation: Hidden within it are the jewels of mystery; how rare is that Gurmukh, that selfless servant, who digs them out.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਇਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa taa(n) ik raviaa iko ot pot ||
verses.translation: When someone realizes the All-pervading Soul, then he sees the One and Only Lord permeating, through and through.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhekhiaa ik ma(n)niaa iko suniaa sravan sarot ||
verses.translation: He sees the One, he believes in the One, and with his ears, he listens only to the One.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਤਿ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam salaeh too sach sache sevaa teree hot ||16||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is your service to the Lord, the Truest of the True. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ras tin kai ridhai heh jin har vasiaa man maeh ||
verses.translation: All joy is in the hearts of those, within whose minds the Lord abides.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har dharageh te mukh ujale tin kau sabh dhekhan jaeh ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord, their faces are radiant, and everyone goes to see them.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin nirabhau naam dhiaaiaa tin kau bhau koiee naeh ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Name of the Fearless Lord have no fear.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har utam tinee sareviaa jin kau dhur likhiaa aaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-destined destiny remember the Sublime Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: te har dharageh painaie'eeh jin har vuThaa man maeh ||
verses.translation: Those, within whose minds the Lord abides, are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi aap tare sabh kuTa(n)b siau tin pichhai sabh jagat chhaddaeh ||
verses.translation: They are carried across, along with all their family, and the whole world is saved along with them.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har mel jan tin vekh vekh ham jeevaeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, please unite servant Nanak with Your humble servants; beholding them, beholding them, I live. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: saa dharatee bhiee hareeaavalee jithai meraa satigur baiThaa aai ||
verses.translation: That land, where my True Guru comes and sits, becomes green and fertile.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜੰਤ ਭਏ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: se ja(n)t bhe hareeaavale jinee meraa satigur dhekhiaa jai ||
verses.translation: Those beings who go and behold my True Guru are rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਣਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n pitaa dhan dha(n)n kul dhan dhanu su jananee jin guroo janiaa mai ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the father; blessed, blessed is the family; blessed, blessed is the mother, who gave birth to the Guru.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n guroo jin naam araadhiaa aap tariaa jinee ddiThaa tinaa le chhaddai ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who worships and adores the Naam; He saves Himself, and emancipates those who see Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har satigur melahu dhiaa kar jan naanak dhovai pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Lord, be kind, and unite me with the True Guru, that servant Nanak may wash His feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach sachaa satigur amar hai jis a(n)dhar har ur dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: Truest of the True is the Immortal True Guru; He has enshrined the Lord deep within His heart.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach sachaa satigur purakh hai jin kaam karodh bikh maariaa ||
verses.translation: Truest of the True is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has conquered sexual desire, anger and corruption.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਡਿਠਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ddiThaa pooraa satiguroo taa(n) a(n)dharahu man saadhaariaa ||
verses.translation: When I see the Perfect True Guru, then deep within, my mind is comforted and consoled.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਿ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane sadhaa sadhaa ghum vaariaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru; I am devoted and dedicated to Him, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jitaa manmukh haariaa ||17||
