verses.translation: A Gurmukh wins the battle of life whereas a self-willed manmukh loses it. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਓਨੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa satigur melion mukh gurmukh naam dhiaaisee ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru; then, as Gurmukh, we chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on it.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਘਰੀ ਵਸਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: so kare j satigur bhaavasee gur pooraa gharee vasaisee ||
verses.translation: We do that which pleases the True Guru; the Perfect Guru comes to dwell in the home of the heart.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin a(n)dhar naam nidhaan hai tin kaa bhau sabh gavaisee ||
verses.translation: Those who have the treasure of the Naam deep within - all their fears are removed.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਰਖਣ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin rakhan kau har aap hoi hor ketee jhakh jhakh jaisee ||
verses.translation: They are protected by the Lord Himself; others struggle and fight against them, but they only come to death.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਛੋਡਾਇਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaai too har halat palat chhoddaisee ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam; the Lord shall deliver you, here and hereafter. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa kai man bhaavadhee gur satigur kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The glorious greatness of the Guru, the True Guru, is pleasing to the GurSikh's mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har raakhahu paij satiguroo kee nit chaRai savaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord preserves the honor of the True Guru, which increases day by day.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur kai man paarabraham hai paarabraham chhaddaiee ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is in the Mind of the Guru, the True Guru; the Supreme Lord God saves Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur taan dheebaan har tin sabh aan nivaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Power and Support of the Guru, the True Guru; all come to bow before Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਠਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jinee ddiThaa meraa satigur bhaau kar tin ke sabh paap gavaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who have gazed lovingly upon my True Guru - all their sins are taken away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har dharageh te mukh ujale bahu sobhaa paiee ||
verses.translation: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and they obtain great glory.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhooR tin jo gur ke sikh mere bhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: hau aakh salaahee sifat sach sach sache kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: I chant the Praises and Glories of the True One. True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saalaahee sach salaeh sach sach keemat kinai na paiee ||
verses.translation: I praise the True Lord, and the Praises of the True Lord. His worth cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sach sachaa ras jinee chakhiaa se tirapat rahe aaghaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who have tasted the true essence of the True Lord, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eih har ras seiee jaanadhe jiau goo(n)gai miThiaaiee khaiee ||
verses.translation: They know this essence of the Lord, but they say nothing, like the mute who tastes the sweet candy, and says nothing.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har prabh seviaa man vajee vaadhaiee ||18||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru serves the Lord God; His vibration vibrates and resounds in the mind. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਮਰਥਲ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੂਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa a(n)dhar umarathal seiee jaanan sooleeaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have a festering boil within - they alone know its pain.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੋਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har jaaneh seiee birahu hau tin viTahu sadh ghum gholeeaa ||
verses.translation: Those who know the pain of separation from the Lord - I am forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਤਲ ਰੋਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har melahu sajan purakh meraa sir tin viTahu tal roleeaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please lead me to meet the Guru, the Primal Being, my Friend; my head shall roll in the dust under His feet.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਗੁਲਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਗੋਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo sikh gur kaar kamaaveh hau gulam tinaa kaa goleeaa ||
verses.translation: I am the slave of the slaves of those GurSikhs who serve Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਭਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g chaloolai jo rate tin bhinee har ra(n)g choleeaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love - their robes are drenched in the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮੋਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa naanak mel gur peh sir vechiaa moleeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Grant Your Grace, and lead Nanak to meet the Guru; I have sold my head to Him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aauganee bhariaa sareer hai kiau sa(n)tahu niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: The body is full of mistakes and misdeeds; how can it become pure, O Saints?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਵੇਹਾਝੀਅਹਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh gun vehaajhe'eeh mal haumai kaddai dhoi ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh purchases virtues, which wash off the sin of egotism.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach vana(n)jeh ra(n)g siau sach saudhaa hoi ||
verses.translation: True is the trade which purchases the True Lord with love.

verses.original: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: toTaa mool na aaviee laahaa har bhaavai soi ||
verses.translation: No loss will come from this, and the profit comes by the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak tin sach vana(n)jiaa jinaa dhur likhiaa paraapat hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone purchase the Truth, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: saalaahee sach saalaahanaa sach sachaa purakh niraale ||
verses.translation: I praise the True One, who alone is worthy of praise. The True Primal Being is True - this is His unique quality.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach sevee sach man vasai sach sachaa har rakhavaale ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Lord, the Truth comes to dwell in the mind. The Lord, the Truest of the True, is my Protector.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੇ ਸਚ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach sachaa jinee araadhiaa se jai rale sach naale ||
verses.translation: Those who worship and adore the Truest of the True, shall go and merge with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach sachaa jinee na seviaa se manmukh mooR betaale ||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the Truest of the True - those self-willed manmukhs are foolish demons.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਆਲੁ ਪਤਾਲੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੀਤੈ ਮਦਿ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: oh aal pataal muhahu boladhe jiau peetai madh matavaale ||19||
verses.translation: With their mouths, they babble on about this and that, like the drunkard who has drunk his wine. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਰਾਗਿ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਜੇ ਖਸਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee raag sulakhanee je khasamai chit karei ||
verses.translation: Gauree Raga is auspicious, if, through it, one comes to think of his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai chalai satiguroo kai aaisaa seegaar karei ||
verses.translation: He should walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; this should be his decoration.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh bhataar hai sadhaa sadhaa raavei ||
verses.translation: The True Word of the Shabad is our spouse; ravish and enjoy it, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਉਬਲੀ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਗਹਗਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau ubalee majeeThai ra(n)g gahagahaa tiau sache no jeeau dhei ||
verses.translation: Like the deep crimson color of the madder plant - such is the dye which shall color you, when you dedicate your soul to the True One.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਅਤਿ ਰਤੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g chaloolai at ratee sache siau lagaa neh ||
verses.translation: One who loves the True Lord is totally imbued with the Lord's Love, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ ਗੁਝੀ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ ਪਲੇਟਿ ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR Thagee gujhee naa rahai kooR mula(n)maa paleT dhareh ||
verses.translation: Falsehood and deception may be covered with false coatings, but they cannot remain hidden.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੀ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooRee karan vaddaieeaa kooRe siau lagaa neh ||
verses.translation: False is the uttering of praises, by those who love falsehood.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa aap hai aape nadhar karei ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He alone is True; He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat meh har usatat hai sa(n)g saadhoo mile piaariaa ||
verses.translation: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Lord's Praises are sung. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Beloved Lord is met.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਹਹਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: oi purakh praanee dha(n)n jan heh upadhes kareh paraupakaariaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that mortal being, who shares the Teachings for the good of others.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਜਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiraRaaveh har naam sunaaveh har naame jag nisataariaa ||
verses.translation: He implants the Name of the Lord, and he preaches the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, the world is saved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੋਚੈ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਜਗਤਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur vekhan kau sabh koiee lochai nav kha(n)dd jagat namasakaariaa ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs to see the Guru; the world, and the nine continents, bow down to Him.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape aap rakhiaa satigur vich gur aape tudh savaariaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself have established the True Guru; You Yourself have adorned the Guru.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: too aape poojeh pooj karaaveh satigur kau sirajanahaariaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself worship and adore the True Guru; You inspire others to worship Him as well, O Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਜਮਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: koiee vichhuR jai satiguroo paasahu tis kaalaa muh jam maariaa ||
verses.translation: If someone separates himself from the True Guru, his face is blackened, and he is destroyed by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis agai pichhai ddoiee naahee gursikhee man veechaariaa ||
verses.translation: He shall find no shelter, here or hereafter; the GurSikhs have realized this in their minds.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo no mile seiee jan ubare jin hiradhai naam samaariaa ||
verses.translation: That humble being who meets the True Guru is saved; he cherishes the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his heart.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੁਤਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke gursikh putahahu har japiahu har nisataariaa ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak says: O GurSikhs, O my sons, meditate on the Lord; only the Lord shall save you. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: haumai jagat bhulaiaa dhuramat bikhiaa bikaar ||
verses.translation: Egotism has led the world astray, along with evil-mindedness and the poison of corruption.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta nadhar hoi manmukh a(n)dh a(n)dhiaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, we are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, while the self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਏ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak aape mel le jis no sabadh laae piaar ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord absorbs into Himself those whom He inspires to love the Word of His Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਿਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach sache kee sifat salaeh hai so kare jis a(n)dhar bhijai ||
verses.translation: True are the Praises and the Glories of the True One; he alone speaks them, whose mind is softened within.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕੰਧੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਛਿਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jinee ik man ik araadhiaa tin kaa ka(n)dh na kabahoo chhijai ||
verses.translation: Those who worship the One Lord with single-minded devotion - their bodies shall never perish.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਿਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan purakh saabaas hai jin sach rasanaa a(n)mrit pijai ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed and acclaimed is that person, who tastes with his tongue the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਿਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach sachaa jin man bhaavadhaa se man sachee dharageh lijai ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is pleased with the Truest of the True is accepted in the True Court.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਚਿਆਰੀਆ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿਜੈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n janam sachiaareeaa mukh ujal sach karijai ||20||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the birth of those true beings; the True Lord brightens their faces. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਜਾਇ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat jai niveh gur aagai man khoTe kooR kooRiaare ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics go and bow before the Guru, but their minds are corrupt and false, totally false.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਉਠਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਬਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਘੁਸਰਿ ਬਗੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa gur kahai uThahu mere bhaiee beh jaeh ghusar bagulaare ||
verses.translation: When the Guru says, ""Rise up, my Siblings of Destiny"", they sit down, crowded in like cranes.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢੇ ਲਧੋਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa a(n)dhar satigur varatai chun kadde ladhovaare ||
verses.translation: The True Guru prevails among His GurSikhs; they pick out and expel the wanderers.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਬਹਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਛਪਾਇਨਿ ਨ ਰਲਨੀ ਖੋਟੇਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi agai pichhai beh muh chhapain na ralanee khoTeaare ||
verses.translation: Sitting here and there, they hide their faces; being counterfeit, they cannot mix with the genuine.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਦਾ ਭਖੁ ਸੁ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਕੂੜੁ ਲਹਨਿ ਭੇਡਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: onaa dhaa bhakhu su othai naahee jai kooR lahan bheddaare ||
verses.translation: There is no food for them there; the false go into the filth like sheep.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਨਰੁ ਖਾਵਾਈਐ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਉਗਲਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: je saakat nar khaavaieeaai locheeaai bikh kaddai mukh ugalaare ||
verses.translation: If you try to feed the faithless cynic, he will spit out poison from his mouth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੇਤੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਓਇ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har saakat setee sa(n)g na kareeahu oi maare sirajanahaare ||
verses.translation: O Lord, let me not be in the company of the faithless cynic, who is cursed by the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis kaa ih khel soiee kar vekhai jan naanak naam samaare ||1||
verses.translation: This drama belongs to the Lord; He performs it, and He watches over it. Servant Nanak cherishes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh aga(n)m hai jis a(n)dhar har ur dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is inaccessible; He has enshrined the Lord's Name within His heart.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਲਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo no apaR koi na sakiee jis val sirajanahaariaa ||
verses.translation: No one can equal the True Guru; the Creator Lord is on His side.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਖੜਗੁ ਸੰਜੋਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo kaa khaRag sa(n)joau har bhagat hai jit kaal ka(n)Tak maar viddaariaa ||
verses.translation: Devotional worship of the Lord is the sword and armor of the True Guru; He has killed and cast out Death, the torturer.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo kaa rakhanahaaraa har aap hai satiguroo kai pichhai har sabh ubaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is the Protector of the True Guru. The Lord saves all those who follow in the footsteps of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo ma(n)dhaa chitavai poore satiguroo kaa so aap upaavanahaarai maariaa ||
verses.translation: One who thinks evil of the Perfect True Guru - the Creator Lord Himself destroys him.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਗਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eh gal hovai har dharageh sache kee jan naanak agam veechaariaa ||2||
verses.translation: These words will be confirmed as true in the Court of the Lord; servant Nanak reveals this mystery. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਾ ਉਠੇ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਚਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach sutiaa jinee araadhiaa jaa uThe taa sach chave ||
verses.translation: Those who dwell upon the True Lord while asleep, utter the True Name when they are awake.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: se virale jug meh jaane'eeh jo gurmukh sach rave ||
verses.translation: How rare in the world are those Gurmukhs who dwell upon the True Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree tin kau j anadhin sach lave ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the True Name, night and day.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin man tan sachaa bhaavadhaa se sachee dharageh gave ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is pleasing to their minds and bodies; they go to the Court of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਵੇ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bolai sach naam sach sachaa sadhaa nave ||21||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak chants the True Name; truly, the True Lord is forever brand new. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਸਵਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਗਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa savanaa kiaa jaaganaa gurmukh te paravaan ||
verses.translation: Who is asleep, and who is awake? Those who are Gurmukh are approved.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa saas giraas na visarai se poore purakh paradhaan ||
verses.translation: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each and every breath and morsel of food, are the perfect and famous persons.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: karamee satigur paieeaai anadhin lagai dhiaan ||
verses.translation: By His Grace they find the True Guru; night and day, they meditate.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee sa(n)gat mil rahaa dharageh paiee maan ||
verses.translation: I join the society of those persons, and in so doing, I am honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਉਦੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਉਠਦੇ ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: saudhe vaahu vaahu uchareh uThadhe bhee vaahu karen ||
verses.translation: While asleep, they chant, ""Waaho! Waaho!"", and while awake, they chant, ""Waaho!"" as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak te mukh ujale j nit uTh sa(n)maalen ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, radiant are the faces of those, who rise up early each day, and dwell upon the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveeaai aapanaa paieeaai naam apaar ||
verses.translation: Serving his True Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਭਉਜਲਿ ਡੁਬਦਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaujal ddubadhiaa kadd le har dhaat kare dhaataar ||
verses.translation: The drowning person is lifted up and out of the terrifying world-ocean; the Great Giver gives the gift of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n se saeh hai j naam kareh vaapaar ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those bankers who trade the Naam.

verses.original: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸਿਖ ਆਵਦੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vanajaare sikh aavadhe sabadh laghaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Sikhs, the traders come, and through the Word of His Shabad, they are carried across.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਤਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak jin kau kirapaa bhiee tin seviaa sirajanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, they alone serve the Creator Lord, who are blessed by His Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ ਹਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach sache ke jan bhagat heh sach sachaa jinee araadhiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who truly worship and adore the True Lord, are truly the humble devotees of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin gurmukh khoj dda(n)ddoliaa tin a(n)dharahu hee sach laadhiaa ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who search and seek, find the True One within themselves.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach saahib sach jinee seviaa kaal ka(n)Tak maar tinee saadhiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who truly serve their True Lord and Master, overwhelm and conquer Death, the torturer.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਲਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach sachaa sabh dhoo vaddaa hai sach sevan se sach ralaadhiaa ||
verses.translation: The True One is truly the greatest of all; those who serve the True One are blended with the True One.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਫਲਾਧਿਆ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: sach sache no saabaas hai sach sachaa sev falaadhiaa ||22||
verses.translation: Blessed and acclaimed is the Truest of the True; serving the Truest of the True, one blossoms forth in fruition. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh praanee mugadh hai naamaheen bharamai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is foolish; he wanders around without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur manooaa naa Tikai fir fir joonee pai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, his mind is not held steady, and he is reincarnated, over and over again.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh aap dhiaal hoh taa(n) satigur miliaa aai ||
verses.translation: But when the Lord God Himself becomes merciful to him, then the True Guru comes to meet him.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam salaeh too janam maran dhukh jai ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam; the pains of birth and death shall come to an end. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur saalaahee aapanaa bahu bidh ra(n)g subhai ||
verses.translation: I praise my Guru in so many ways, with joyful love and affection.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਖਿਆ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur setee man rataa rakhiaa banat banai ||
verses.translation: My mind is imbued with the True Guru; He has preserved the make of its making.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa saalaeh na rajiee har preetam chit lai ||
verses.translation: My tongue is not satisfied by praising Him; He has linked my consciousness with the Lord, my Beloved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naavai kee man bhukh hai man tirapatai har ras khai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my mind hungers for the Name of the Lord; my mind is satisfied, tasting the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਣਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach sachaa kudharat jaaneeaai dhin raatee jin banaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is truly known for His all-powerful creative nature; He fashioned the days and the nights.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: so sach salaahee sadhaa sadhaa sach sache keeaa vaddiaaieeaa ||
verses.translation: I praise that True Lord, forever and ever; True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: saalaahee sach salaeh sach sach keemat kinai na paieeaa ||
verses.translation: True are the Praises of the Praiseworthy True Lord; the value of the True Lord cannot be appraised.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਾ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa miliaa pooraa satiguroo taa haajar nadharee aaieeaa ||
verses.translation: When someone meets the Perfect True Guru, then His Sublime Presence comes to be seen.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: sach gurmukh jinee salaahiaa tinaa bhukhaa sabh gavaieeaa ||23||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who praise the True Lord - all their hunger is gone. ||23||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜੇਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਧਾ ਲੋੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan khoj khojedhiaa so prabh ladhaa loR ||
verses.translation: Searching and examining my mind and body, I have found that God, whom I longed for.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਟੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਜੋੜਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: visaT guroo mai paiaa jin har prabh dhitaa joR ||1||
verses.translation: I have found the Guru, the Divine Intermediary, who has united me with the Lord God. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਅਤਿ ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaadhaaree at a(n)naa bolaa ||
verses.translation: One who is attached to Maya is totally blind and deaf.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਬਹੁ ਰੋਲ ਘਚੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh na suniee bahu rol ghacholaa ||
verses.translation: He does not listen to the Word of the Shabad; he makes a great uproar and tumult.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaapai sabadh liv lai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs chant and meditate on the Shabad, and lovingly center their consciousness on it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har naam sun ma(n)ne har naam samai ||
verses.translation: They hear and believe in the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai su kare karaiaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases God, He causes that to be done.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਜਦਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vajadhaa ja(n)t vajaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, human beings are the instruments which vibrate as God plays them. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜੋ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: too karataa sabh kichh jaanadhaa jo jeeaa a(n)dhar varatai ||
verses.translation: You, O Creator, know everything which occurs within our beings.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਣਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: too karataa aap aganat hai sabh jag vich ganatai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself, O Creator, are incalculable, while the entire world is within the realm of calculation.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh keetaa teraa varatadhaa sabh teree banatai ||
verses.translation: Everything happens according to Your Will; You created all.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਚਲਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: too ghaT ghaT ik varatadhaa sach saahib chalatai ||
verses.translation: You are the One, pervading in each and every heart; O True Lord and Master, this is Your play.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਰਤੈ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: satigur no mile su har mile naahee kisai paratai ||24||
verses.translation: One who meets the True Guru meets the Lord; no one can turn him away. ||24||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: eih manooaa dhiraR kar rakheeaai gurmukh laieeaai chit ||
verses.translation: Hold this mind steady and stable; become Gurmukh and focus your consciousness.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: kiau saas giraas visaareeaai bahadhiaa uThadhiaa nit ||
verses.translation: How could you ever forget Him, with each breath and morsel of food, sitting down or standing up?

verses.original: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: maran jeevan kee chi(n)taa giee ih jeeaRaa har prabh vas ||
verses.translation: My anxiety about birth and death has ended; this soul is under the control of the Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਖਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too jan naanak naam bakhas ||1||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, then save servant Nanak, and bless him with Your Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਪੀਛੈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh aha(n)kaaree mahal na jaanai khin aagai khin peechhai ||
verses.translation: The egotistical, self-willed manmukh does not know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; one moment he is here, and the next moment he is there.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਮਹਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa bulaieeaai mahal na aavai kiau kar dharageh seejhai ||
verses.translation: He is always invited, but he does not go to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. How shall he be accepted in the Court of the Lord?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa mahal viralaa jaanai sadhaa rahai kar joR ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who know the Mansion of the True Guru; they stand with their palms pressed together.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਬਹੋੜਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aapanee kirapaa kare har meraa naanak le bahoR ||2||
verses.translation: If my Lord grants His Grace, O Nanak, He restores them to Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: saa sevaa keetee safal hai jit satigur kaa man ma(n)ne ||
verses.translation: Fruitful and rewarding is that service, which is pleasing to the Guru's Mind.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਸੰਮਲ ਭੰਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa satigur kaa man ma(n)niaa taa paap kasa(n)mal bha(n)ne ||
verses.translation: When the Mind of the True Guru is pleased, then sins and misdeeds run away.

verses.original: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸਿਖੀ ਕੰਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: aupadhes j dhitaa satiguroo so suniaa sikhee ka(n)ne ||
verses.translation: The Sikhs listen to the Teachings imparted by the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin satigur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)niaa tin chaRee chavagan va(n)ne ||
verses.translation: Those who surrender to the True Guru's Will are imbued with the four-fold Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨੇ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: eeh chaal niraalee gurmukhee gur dheekhiaa sun man bhi(n)ne ||25||
verses.translation: This is the unique and distinct life-style of the Gurmukhs: listening to the Guru's Teachings, their minds blossom forth. ||25||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin gur gopiaa aapanaa tis Thaur na Thaau ||
verses.translation: Those who do not affirm their Guru shall have no home or place of rest.

verses.original: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat dhovai ge dharageh naahee thaau ||
verses.translation: They lose both this world and the next; they have no place in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਗਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: oh velaa hath na aaviee fir satigur lageh pai ||
verses.translation: This opportunity to bow at the Feet of the True Guru shall never come again.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਣਤੈ ਘੁਸੀਐ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee ganatai ghuseeaai dhukhe dhukh vihai ||
verses.translation: If they miss out on being counted by the True Guru, they shall pass their lives in pain and misery.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh niravair hai aape le jis lai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance; He unites with Himself those with whom He is pleased.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਓਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dharasan jinaa vekhaalion tinaa dharageh le chhaddai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, are emancipated in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh agiaan dhuramat aha(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is ignorant, evil-minded and egotistical.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੂਐ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar karodh jooaai mat haaree ||
verses.translation: He is filled with anger within, and he loses his mind in the gamble.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kusat oh paap kamaavai ||
verses.translation: He commits the sins of fraud and unrighteousness.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa oh sunai kiaa aakh sunaavai ||
verses.translation: What can he hear, and what can he tell others?

verses.original: ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਖੁਇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)naa bolaa khui ujhaR pai ||
verses.translation: He is blind and deaf; he loses his way, and wanders lost in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dhaa aavai jai ||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation;

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe thai na pai ||
verses.translation: without meeting the True Guru, he finds no place of rest.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak poorab likhiaa kamai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਬਹਹਿ ਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin ke chit kaThor heh se baheh na satigur paas ||
verses.translation: Those who have hearts as hard as stone, do not sit near the True Guru.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਚਿਤ ਉਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: othai sach varatadhaa kooRiaaraa chit udhaas ||
verses.translation: Truth prevails there; the false ones do not attune their consciousness to it.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਝਤਿ ਕਢਦੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi val chhal kar jhat kaddadhe fir jai baheh kooRiaaraa paas ||
verses.translation: By hook or by crook, they pass their time, and then they go back to sit with the false ones again.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਗਡਈ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: vich sache kooR na gaddiee man vekhahu ko nirajaas ||
verses.translation: Falsehood does not mix with the Truth; O people, check it out and see.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੇ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸਿਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: kooRiaar kooRiaaree jai rale sachiaar sikh baiThe satigur paas ||26||
verses.translation: The false go and mingle with the false, while the truthful Sikhs sit by the side of the True Guru. ||26||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਹਦੇ ਖੁਹਦੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਹਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: rahadhe khuhadhe ni(n)dhak maarian kar aape aahar ||
verses.translation: By their own efforts, the slanderers have destroyed all remnants of themselves.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਜਾਹਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sahaiee naanakaa varatai sabh jaahar ||1||
verses.translation: The Support of the Saints, O Nanak, is manifest, pervading everywhere. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਮੁੰਢ ਤੇ ਕਿਥੈ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਹਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)ddahu bhule mu(n)dd te kithai pain hath ||
verses.translation: Those who went astray from the Primal Being in the very beginning - where can they find refuge?

verses.original: ਤਿੰਨੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ti(n)nai maare naanakaa j karan kaaran samarath ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are struck down by the All-powerful, the Cause of causes. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee 5 ||
verses.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੈ ਫਾਹੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਤੁਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: lai faahe raatee tureh prabh jaanai praanee ||
verses.translation: They take the noose in their hands, and go out at night to strangle others, but God knows everything, O mortal.

verses.original: ਤਕਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਈਆ ਲੁਕਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਠਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: takeh naar paraieeaa luk a(n)dhar Thaanee ||
verses.translation: They spy on other men's women, concealed in their hiding places.

verses.original: ਸੰਨੑੀ ਦੇਨਿੑ ਵਿਖੰਮ ਥਾਇ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਦੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)n(h)ee dheni(h) vikha(n)m thai miThaa madh maanee ||
verses.translation: They break into well-protected places, and revel in sweet wine.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: karamee aapo aapanee aape pachhutaanee ||
verses.translation: But they shall come to regret their actions - they create their own karma.

verses.original: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: ajaraieel faresataa til peeRe ghaanee ||27||
verses.translation: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall crush them like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||27||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕੇ ਸੇਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sevak sache saeh ke seiee paravaan ||
verses.translation: The servants of the True King are acceptable and approved.

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੇ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa sevan naanakaa se pach pach mue ajaan ||1||
verses.translation: Those ignorant ones who serve duality, O Nanak, rot, waste away and die. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur likhiaa lekh prabh meTanaa na jai ||
verses.translation: That destiny which was pre-ordained by God from the very beginning cannot be erased.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan vakharo naanak sadhaa dhiaai ||2||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Name is Nanak's capital; he meditates on it forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee 5 ||
verses.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਰਾਇਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਨਾਠੂੰਗੜਾ ਪੈਰ ਕਿਥੈ ਰਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: naarain liaa naaThoo(n)gaRaa pair kithai rakhai ||
verses.translation: One who has received a kick from the Lord God - where can he place his foot?

verses.original: ਕਰਦਾ ਪਾਪ ਅਮਿਤਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਵਿਸੋ ਚਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: karadhaa paap amitiaa nit viso chakhai ||
verses.translation: He commits countless sins, and continually eats poison.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhaa karadhaa pach muaa vich dhehee bhakhai ||
verses.translation: Slandering others, he wastes away and dies; within his body, he burns.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: sachai saahib maariaa kaun tis no rakhai ||
verses.translation: One who has been struck down by the True Lord and Master - who can save him now?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲਖੈ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak tis saranaagatee jo purakh alakhai ||28||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Unseen Lord, the Primal Being. ||28||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: narak ghor bahu dhukh ghane akirataghanaa kaa thaan ||
verses.translation: In the most horrible hell, there is terrible pain and suffering. It is the place of the ungrateful.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਏ ਹਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin prabh maare naanakaa hoi hoi mue haraam ||1||
verses.translation: They are struck down by God, O Nanak, and they die a most miserable death. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਵਖਧ ਸਭੇ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: avakhadh sabhe keetian ni(n)dhak kaa dhaaroo naeh ||
verses.translation: All kinds of medicines may be prepared, but there is no cure for the slanderer.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap bhulaae naanakaa pach pach jonee paeh ||2||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads, O Nanak, putrefy and rot in reincarnation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee 5 ||
verses.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: tus dhitaa poorai satiguroo har dhan sach akhuT ||
verses.translation: By His Pleasure, the True Guru has blessed me with the inexhaustible wealth of the Name of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੁਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh a(n)dhese miT ge jam kaa bhau chhuT ||
verses.translation: All my anxiety is ended; I am rid of the fear of death.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤੁਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh buriaaieeaa(n) sa(n)g saadhoo tuT ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and other evils have been subdued in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਹੁਇ ਮਰਸਨਿ ਬੁਟੁ ॥
verses.translit: vin sache dhoojaa sevadhe hui marasan buT ||
verses.translation: Those who serve another, instead of the True Lord, die unfulfilled in the end.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਟੁ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: naanak kau gur bakhasiaa naamai sa(n)g juT ||29||
verses.translation: The Guru has blessed Nanak with forgiveness; he is united with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||29||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਪਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਦ੍ਰਹੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਨਿਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਜਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tapaa na hovai a(n)dhrahu lobhee nit maiaa no firai jajamaaliaa ||
verses.translation: He is not a penitent, who is greedy within his heart, and who constantly chases after Maya like a leper.

verses.original: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਸਦਿਆ ਸਤੈ ਦੀ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਲਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਣਿ ਤਪੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ago dhe sadhiaa satai dhee bhikhiaa le naahee pichho dhe pachhutai kai aan tapai put vich bahaaliaa ||
verses.translation: When this penitent was first invited, he refused our charity; but later he repented and sent his son, who was seated in the congregation.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਲੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਹਸਣ ਲਗੇ ਤਪਾ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch log sabh hasan lage tapaa lobh lahar hai gaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The village elders all laughed, saying that the waves of greed have destroyed this penitent.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਥੋੜਾ ਧਨੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਤਪਾ ਭਿਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਧਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਪੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jithai thoRaa dhan vekhai tithai tapaa bhiTai naahee dhan bahutai ddiThai tapai dharam haariaa ||
verses.translation: If he sees only a little wealth, he does not bother to go there; but when he sees a lot of wealth, the penitent forsakes his vows.

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee eh tapaa na hovee bagulaa hai beh saadh janaa veechaariaa ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, he is not a penitent - he is only a stork. Sitting together, the Holy Congregation has so decided.

verses.original: ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਤਪਾ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਏਤੁ ਦੋਖੈ ਤਪਾ ਦਯਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sat purakh kee tapaa ni(n)dhaa karai sa(n)saarai kee usatatee vich hovai et dhokhai tapaa dhay maariaa ||
verses.translation: The penitent slanders the True Primal Being, and sings the praises of the material world. For this sin, he is cursed by the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਜਿ ਤਪੇ ਨੋ ਫਲੁ ਲਗਾ ਸਭੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਪੇ ਕਾ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa purakhaa(n) kee ni(n)dhaa kaa vekh j tape no fal lagaa sabh giaa tape kaa ghaaliaa ||
verses.translation: Behold the fruit the penitent gathers, for slandering the Great Primal Being; all his labors have gone in vain.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਪੰਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਪਾ ਸਦਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: baahar bahai pa(n)chaa vich tapaa sadhaae ||
verses.translation: When he sits outside among the elders, he is called a penitent;

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਪਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar bahai tapaa paap kamaae ||
verses.translation: but when he sits within the congregation, the penitent commits sin.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਨੋ ਉਘਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)dharalaa paap pa(n)chaa no ughaa kar vekhaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has exposed the penitent's secret sin to the elders.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰਾ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਛਡਿਆ ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਨੋ ਤਿਥੈ ਖੜਿ ਪਾਇਹੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਮਹਾ ਮਹਾਂ ਹਤਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai jamaka(n)karaa no aakh chhaddiaa es tape no tithai khaR paih jithai mahaa mahaa(n) hatiaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma said to the Messenger of Death, ""Take this penitent and put him with the worst of the worst murderers.""

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਦੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਲਗਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹੈ ਫਿਟਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: fir es tape dhai muh koiee lagahu naahee eh satigur hai fiTakaariaa ||
verses.translation: No one is to look at the face of this penitent again. He has been cursed by the True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har kai dhar varatiaa su naanak aakh sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks and reveals what has taken place in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੁ ਦਯਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so boojhai ju dhay savaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: He alone understands, who is blessed and adorned by the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa(n) har aaraadhiaa har kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The devotees of the Lord worship and adore the Lord, and the glorious greatness of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har keeratan bhagat nit gaa(n)vadhe har naam sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises; the Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਨੋ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa(n) no nit naavai dhee vaddiaaiee bakhaseean nit chaRai savaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord ever bestows upon His devotees the glorious greatness of His Name, which increases day by day.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਨੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਬਹਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa(n) no thir gharee bahaalian apanee paij rakhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord inspires His devotees to sit, steady and stable, in the home of their inner being. He preserves their honor.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕਾਂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhakaa(n) paasahu har lekhaa ma(n)gasee bahu dhei sajaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord summons the slanderers to answer for their accounts, and He punishes them severely.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਅਪਣੈ ਜੀਇ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਤੇਹੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa ni(n)dhak apanai jeei kamaavadhe teho fal paiee ||
verses.translation: As the slanderers think of acting, so are the fruits they obtain.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸਰਪਰ ਉਘੜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਬਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar kamaanaa sarapar ughaRai bhaavai koiee beh dharatee vich kamaiee ||
verses.translation: Actions done in secrecy are sure to come to light, even if one does it underground.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dhekh vigasiaa har kee vaddiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in joy, beholding the glorious greatness of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa(n) kaa raakhaa har aap hai kiaa paapee kareeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is the Protector of His devotees; what can the sinner do to them?

verses.original: ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੂੜ ਗੁਮਾਨੀਆ ਵਿਸੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: gumaan kareh mooR gumaaneeaa vis khaadhee mareeaai ||
verses.translation: The proud fool acts in pride, and eating his own poison, he dies.

verses.original: ਆਇ ਲਗੇ ਨੀ ਦਿਹ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਜਿਉ ਪਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੁਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aai lage nee dheh thoRaRe jiau pakaa khet luneeaai ||
verses.translation: His few days have come to an end, and he is cut down like the crop at harvest.

verses.original: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jehe karam kamaavadhe teveho bhaneeaai ||
verses.translation: According to one's actions, so is one spoken of.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾ ਧਣੀਐ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kaa khasam vaddaa hai sabhanaa dhaa dhaneeaai ||30||
verses.translation: Glorious and great is the Lord and Master of servant Nanak; He is the Master of all. ||30||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh moolahu bhuliaa vich lab lobh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all; they are caught in greed and egotism.

verses.original: ਝਗੜਾ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਦਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhagaRaa karadhiaa anadhin gudharai sabadh na kareh veechaar ||
verses.translation: They pass their nights and days in conflict and struggle; they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸੁਧਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sudh mat karatai sabh hir liee bolan sabh vikaar ||
verses.translation: The Creator has taken away all their understanding and purity; all their speech is evil and corrupt.

verses.original: ਦਿਤੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਅਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhitai kitai na sa(n)tokhe'eeh a(n)tar tisanaa bahu agiaan a(n)dhayeaar ||
verses.translation: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within their hearts there is great desire, ignorance and darkness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨਾਲੋ ਤੁਟੀ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak manmukhaa naalo tuTee bhalee jin maiaa moh piaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it is good to break away from the self-willed manmukhs, who have love and attachment to Maya. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa a(n)dhar dhoojaa bhaau hai tin(h)aa gurmukh preet na hoi ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of duality, do not love the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: oh aavai jai bhavaieeaai supanai sukh na koi ||
verses.translation: They come and go, and wander in reincarnation; even in their dreams, they find no peace.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kamaavai kooR ucharai kooR lagiaa kooR hoi ||
verses.translation: They practice falsehood and they speak falsehood; attached to falsehood, they become false.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sabh dhukh hai dhukh binasai dhukh roi ||
verses.translation: The love of Maya is total pain; in pain they perish, and in pain they cry out.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਲਿਵੈ ਜੋੜੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaat livai joR na aaviee je lochai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there can be no union between the love of worldliness and the love of the Lord, no matter how much everyone may desire it.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਇਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin kau potai pu(n)n piaa tinaa gur sabadhee sukh hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Those who have the treasure of virtuous deeds find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਹੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak veechaareh sa(n)t mun janaa(n) chaar vedh kaha(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Saints and the silent sages think, and the four Vedas proclaim,

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਮੁਖੈ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਚਨ ਹੋਵੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat mukhai te boladhe se vachan hova(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: that whatever the Lord's devotees speak comes to pass.

verses.original: ਪਰਗਟ ਪਾਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: paragaT paahaarai jaapadhe sabh lok suna(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: He is revealed in His cosmic workshop; all people hear of it.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਹੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh na pain mugadh nar sa(n)t naal khaha(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: The foolish people, who fight with the Saints, find no peace.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਓਨਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਨੋ ਓਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੜੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi lochan onaa gunaa no oi aha(n)kaar saRa(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they are burning with egotism.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਭਾਗ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi vechaare kiaa kareh jaa(n) bhaag dhur ma(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: What can those wretched ones do? Their evil destiny was pre-ordained.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo maare tin paarabraham se kisai na sa(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God do not belong to anyone.

verses.original: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਰਮਿ ਨਿਆਇ ਪਚੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: vair karan niravair naal dharam niaai pacha(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Those who hate the One who has no hatred, are destroyed by righteous justice.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਸਰਾਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo sa(n)t saraapiaa se fireh bhava(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Those who are cursed by the Saints wander around lost.

verses.original: ਪੇਡੁ ਮੁੰਢਾਹੂ ਕਟਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡਾਲ ਸੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: pedd mu(n)ddaahoo kaTiaa tis ddaal suka(n)dhe ||31||
verses.translation: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||31||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur naanak har naam dhiraRaiaa bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath ||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; He is All-powerful, to create and destroy.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਤੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਲਥੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh sadhaa samaaleh mitr too dhukh sabaiaa lath ||1||
verses.translation: Remember God forever, my friend, and all your suffering will disappear. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖੁਧਿਆਵੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਲਾਜ ਕੁਲਾਜ ਕੁਬੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: khudhiaava(n)t na jaaniee laaj kulaaj kubol ||
verses.translation: The hungry person does not care about honor, dishonor or harsh words.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak maa(n)gai naam har kar kirapaa sa(n)jog ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the Name of the Lord; please grant Your Grace, and unite me with Yourself. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੇਵੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦਾ ਤੇਵੇਹੇ ਫਲਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: jevehe karam kamaavadhaa tevehe falate ||
verses.translation: According to the deeds which one does, so are the fruits one obtains.

verses.original: ਚਬੇ ਤਤਾ ਲੋਹ ਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਘੈ ਪਲਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: chabe tataa loh saar vich sa(n)ghai palate ||
verses.translation: If someone chews on red-hot iron, his throat will be burned.

verses.original: ਘਤਿ ਗਲਾਵਾਂ ਚਾਲਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੂਤਿ ਅਮਲ ਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghat galaavaa(n) chaaliaa tin dhoot amal te ||
verses.translation: The halter is put around his neck and he is led away, because of the evil deeds he has done.

verses.original: ਕਾਈ ਆਸ ਨ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiee aas na pu(n)neeaa nit par mal hirate ||
verses.translation: None of his desires are fulfilled; he continually steals the filth of others.

verses.original: ਕੀਆ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: keeaa na jaanai akirataghan vich jonee firate ||
verses.translation: The ungrateful wretch does not appreciate what he has been given; he wanders lost in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਧਿਰਾਂ ਨਿਖੁਟੀਅਸੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈਅਸੁ ਧਰ ਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe dhiraa(n) nikhuTeeas hir lieeas dhar te ||
verses.translation: He loses all support, when the Support of the Lord is taken away from him.

verses.original: ਵਿਝਣ ਕਲਹ ਨ ਦੇਵਦਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਇਆ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: vijhan kaleh na dhevadhaa taa(n) liaa karate ||
verses.translation: He does not let the embers of strife die down, and so the Creator destroys him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਹੰਮੇਉ ਝੜਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਪੜਤੇ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: jo jo karate aha(n)meau jhaR dharatee paRate ||32||
verses.translation: Those who indulge in egotism crumble and fall to the ground. ||32||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh giaan bibek budh hoi ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is blessed with spiritual wisdom and a discerning intellect.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavai hiradhai haar paroi ||
verses.translation: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and weaves this garland into his heart.

verses.original: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pavit paavan param beechaaree ||
verses.translation: He becomes the purest of the pure, a being of supreme understanding.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਓਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: j os milai tis paar utaaree ||
verses.translation: Whoever he meets, he saves and carries across.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar har naam baasanaa samaanee ||
verses.translation: The fragrance of the Lord's Name permeates his being deep within.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਾ ਉਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har dhar sobhaa mahaa utam baanee ||
verses.translation: He is honored in the Court of the Lord, and his speech is the most sublime.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: j purakh sunai su hoi nihaal ||
verses.translation: Those who hear him are delighted.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur miliaai paiaa naam dhan maal ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one obtains the wealth and property of the Naam. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur ke jeea kee saar na jaapai k poorai satigur bhaavai ||
verses.translation: The sublime state of the True Guru is not known; no one knows what pleases the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਖਾਂ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa(n) a(n)dhar satiguroo varatai jo sikhaa(n) no lochai so gur khusee aavai ||
verses.translation: Deep within the hearts of His GurSikhs, the True Guru is pervading. The Guru is pleased with those who long for His Sikhs.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਸੁ ਜਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur aakhai su kaar kamaavan su jap kamaaveh gursikhaa(n) kee ghaal sachaa thai paavai ||
verses.translation: As the True Guru directs them, they do their work and chant their prayers. The True Lord accepts the service of His GurSikhs.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਲੋੜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: vin satigur ke hukamai j gursikhaa(n) paasahu ka(n)m karaiaa loRe tis gursikh fir neR na aavai ||
verses.translation: But those who want the GurSikhs to work for them, without the Order of the True Guru - the Guru's Sikhs shall not come near them again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ਘਾਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur agai ko jeeau lai ghaalai tis agai gursikh kaar kamaavai ||
verses.translation: One who works diligently for the Guru, the True Guru - the GurSikhs work for him.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਠਗੀ ਆਵੈ ਠਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: j Thagee aavai Thagee uTh jai tis neRai gursikh mool na aavai ||
verses.translation: One who comes to deceive, who rises up and goes out to deceive - the GurSikhs shall never come near him.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: braham beechaar naanak aakh sunaavai ||
verses.translation: Nanak proclaims and announces this wisdom of God.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋ ਜੰਤੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: j vin satigur ke man ma(n)ne ka(n)m karaae so ja(n)t mahaa dhukh paavai ||2||
verses.translation: One who is not pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru may do his deeds, but that being will only suffer in terrible pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਤੁਹਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sachaa saahib at vaddaa tuh jevadd too(n) vadd vadde ||
verses.translation: O True Lord and Master, You are so very great. As great as You are, You are the greatest of the great.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਛਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) meleh so tudh milai too(n) aape bakhas laih lekhaa chhadde ||
verses.translation: He alone is united with You, whom You unite with Yourself. You Yourself bless and forgive us, and tear up our accounts.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਗਡ ਗਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too(n) aap milaidhaa so satigur seve man gadd gadde ||
verses.translation: One whom You unite with Yourself, whole-heartedly serves the True Guru.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਚੰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) sachaa saahib sach too sabh jeeau pi(n)dd cha(n)m teraa hadde ||
verses.translation: You are the True One, the True Lord and Master; my soul, body, flesh and bones are all Yours.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ॥੩੩॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too(n) sachiaa naanak man aas teree vadd vadde ||33||1|| sudh ||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, then save me, True Lord. Nanak places the hopes of his mind in You alone, O greatest of the great! ||33||1|| Sudh||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰਾਇ ਕਮਾਲਦੀ ਮੋਜਦੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਗਾਵਣੀ
verses.translit: gauRee kee vaar mahalaa panjavaa rai kamaaladhee mojadhee kee vaar kee dhun upar gaavanee
verses.translation: Gauree Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehla: Sung To The Tune Of Vaar Of Raa-I Kamaaldee-Mojadee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਸੋ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam jo jan japai so aaiaa paravaan ||
verses.translation: Auspicious and approved is the birth of that humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan kai balihaaranai jin bhajiaa prabh nirabaan ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that humble being who vibrates and meditates on God, the Lord of Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh kaTiaa har bheTiaa purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, upon meeting the All-knowing Lord, the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sa(n)g saagar tare jan naanak sachaa taan ||1||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, he crosses over the world-ocean; O servant Nanak, he has the strength and support of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhalake uTh paraahunaa merai ghar aavau ||
verses.translation: I rise up in the early morning hours, and the Holy Guest comes into my home.

verses.original: ਪਾਉ ਪਖਾਲਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: paau pakhaalaa tis ke man tan nit bhaavau ||
verses.translation: I wash His feet; He is always pleasing to my mind and body.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam sune naam sa(n)grahai naame liv laavau ||
verses.translation: I hear the Naam, and I gather in the Naam; I am lovingly attuned to the Naam.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: girahu dhan sabh pavitr hoi har ke gun gaavau ||
verses.translation: My home and wealth are totally sanctified as I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har naam vaapaaree naanakaa vaddabhaagee paavau ||2||
verses.translation: The Trader in the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is found by great good fortune. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa sach teraa bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You is good; True is the Pleasure of Your Will.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too sabh meh ek varatadhaa sabh maeh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are the One, pervading in all; You are contained in all.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੀਅ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa jeea a(n)dhar jaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are diffused throughout and permeating all places and interspaces; You are known to be deep within the hearts of all beings.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g mil paieeaai man sache bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and submitting to His Will, the True Lord is found.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee sadh sadh kurabaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak takes to the Sanctuary of God; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚੇਤਾ ਈ ਤਾਂ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: chetaa iee taa(n) chet saahib sachaa so dhanee ||
verses.translation: If you are conscious, then be conscious of the True Lord, Your Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਚੜਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur sev chaR bohith bhaujal paar pau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, come aboard upon the boat of the service of the True Guru, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਊ ਸੰਦੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: vaauoo sa(n)dhe kapaRe pahireh garab gavaar ||
verses.translation: He wears his body, like clothes of wind - what a proud fool he is!

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਨੀ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਹੋਏ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naal na chalanee jal bal hoe chhaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they will not go with him in the end; they shall be burnt to ashes. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਗੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਰਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: seiee ubare jagai vich jo sachai rakhe ||
verses.translation: They alone are delivered from the world, who are preserved and protected by the True Lord.

verses.original: ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: muh ddiThai tin kai jeeveeaai har a(n)mrit chakhe ||
verses.translation: I live by beholding the faces of those who taste the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧਾ ਭਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh sa(n)g saadhaa bhakhe ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are burnt away, in the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee har aap parakhe ||
verses.translation: God grants His Grace, and the Lord Himself tests them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਲਖੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak chalat na jaapanee ko sakai na lakhe ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, His play is not known; no one can understand it. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵੈ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak soiee dhinas suhaavaRaa jit prabh aavai chit ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that day is beautiful, when God comes to mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਭਲੇਰੀ ਰੁਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jit dhin visarai paarabraham fiT bhaleree rut ||1||
verses.translation: Cursed is that day, no matter how pleasant the season, when the Supreme Lord God is forgotten. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak mitraiee tis siau sabh kichh jis kai haath ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, become friends with the One, who holds everything in His hands.

verses.original: ਕੁਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਨ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kumitraa seiee kaa(n)dde'eeh ik vikh na chaleh saath ||2||
verses.translation: They are accounted as false friends, who do not go with you, for even one step. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan hai mil peevahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; meet together and drink it in, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat sukh paieeaai sabh tikhaa bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, peace is found, and all thirst is quenched.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਭੁਖ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar sevaa paarabraham gur bhukh rahai na kaiee ||
verses.translation: So serve the Supreme Lord God and the Guru, and you shall never be hungry again.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੁੰਨਿਆ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath pu(n)niaa amaraa padh paiee ||
verses.translation: All your desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain the status of immortality.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd toohai paarabraham naanak saranaiee ||3||
verses.translation: You alone are as great as Yourself, O Supreme Lord God; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਡਿਠੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ ਊਣ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ddiThaRo habh Thai uoon na kaiee jai ||
verses.translation: I have seen all places; there is no place without Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਆਉ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ladhaa tin suaau jinaa satigur bheTiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru find the object of life. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਾਮਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਤਿਉ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਜਗ ਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaamanee chamatakaar tiau varataaraa jag khe ||
verses.translation: Like the flash of lightning, worldly affairs last only for a moment.

verses.original: ਵਥੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੰਦੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vath suhaavee sai naanak naau japa(n)dho tis dhanee ||2||
verses.translation: The only thing which is pleasing, O Nanak, is that which inspires one to meditate on the Name of the Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: simirat saasatr sodh sabh kinai keem na jaanee ||
verses.translation: People have searched all the Simritees and Shaastras, but no one knows the Lord's value.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan bheTai saadhasa(n)g so har ra(n)g maanee ||
verses.translation: That being, who joins the Saadh Sangat enjoys the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਹ ਰਤਨਾ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach naam karataa purakh eh ratanaa khaanee ||
verses.translation: True is the Naam, the Name of the Creator, the Primal Being. It is the mine of precious jewels.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: masatak hovai likhiaa har simar paraanee ||
verses.translation: That mortal, who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meditates in remembrance on the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੋਸਾ ਦਿਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tosaa dhichai sach naam naanak mihamaanee ||4||
verses.translation: O Lord, please bless Nanak, Your humble guest, with the supplies of the True Name. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar chi(n)taa nainee sukhee mool na utarai bhukh ||
verses.translation: He harbors anxiety within himself, but to the eyes, he appears to be happy; his hunger never departs.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੋ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam bin kisai na latho dhukh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's sorrows have ever departed. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਠੜੇ ਸੇਈ ਸਾਥ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਲਦਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: muThaRe seiee saath jinee sach na ladhiaa ||
verses.translation: Those caravans which did not load the Truth have been plundered.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak se saabaas jinee gur mil ik pachhaaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, and acknowledge the One Lord, are congratulated. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੈਸਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ॥
