verses.translit: jithai baisan saadh jan so thaan suha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Beautiful is that place, where the Holy people dwell.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: oi sevan sa(n)mrith aapanaa binasai sabh ma(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: They serve their All-powerful Lord, and they give up all their evil ways.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦੁ ਕਹੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: patit udhaaran paarabraham sa(n)t bedh kaha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: The Saints and the Vedas proclaim, that the Supreme Lord God is the Saving Grace of sinners.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਵਰਤੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal teraa biradh hai jug jug varata(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Lover of Your devotees - this is Your natural way, in each and every age.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jaachai ek naam man tan bhaava(n)dhaa ||5||
verses.translation: Nanak asks for the One Name, which is pleasing to his mind and body. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਿੜੀ ਚੁਹਕੀ ਪਹੁ ਫੁਟੀ ਵਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: chiRee chuhakee pahu fuTee vagan bahut tara(n)g ||
verses.translation: The sparrows are chirping, and dawn has come; the wind stirs up the waves.

verses.original: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਚੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: acharaj roop sa(n)tan rache naanak naameh ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: Such a wondrous thing the Saints have fashioned, O Nanak, in the Love of the Naam. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਤਹੀ ਜਹ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ma(n)dhar khuseeaa tahee jeh too aaveh chit ||
verses.translation: Homes, palaces and pleasures are there, where You, O Lord, come to mind.

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਮਿਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa keeaa vaddiaaieeaa naanak sabh kumit ||2||
verses.translation: All worldly grandeur, O Nanak, is like false and evil friends. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan sachee raas hai kinai viralai jaataa ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord is the true capital; how rare are those who understand this.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tisai paraapat bhairahu jis dhei bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: He alone receives it, O Siblings of Destiny, unto whom the Architect of Destiny gives it.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan bheetar mauliaa har ra(n)g jan raataa ||
verses.translation: His servant is imbued with the Love of the Lord; his body and mind blossom forth.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖਹ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g gun gaiaa sabh dhokheh khaataa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and all of his sufferings are removed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak soiee jeeviaa jin ik pachhaataa ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone lives, who acknowledges the One Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖਖੜੀਆ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ਲਗੜੀਆ ਅਕ ਕੰਠਿ ॥
verses.translit: khakhaReeaa suhaaveeaa lagaReeaa ak ka(n)Th ||
verses.translation: The fruit of the swallow-wort plant looks beautiful, attached to the branch of the tree;

verses.original: ਬਿਰਹ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਸੈ ਗੰਠਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bireh vichhoRaa dhanee siau naanak sahasai ga(n)Th ||1||
verses.translation: but when it is separated from the stem of its Master, O Nanak, it breaks apart into thousands of fragments. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਸਾਰੇਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਗਏ ਮਰਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: visaaredhe mar ge mar bh na sakeh mool ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Lord die, but they cannot die a complete death.

verses.original: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vemukh hoe raam te jiau tasakar upar sool ||2||
verses.translation: Those who turn their backs on the Lord suffer, like the thief impaled on the gallows. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sukh nidhaan prabh ek hai abinaasee suniaa ||
verses.translation: The One God is the treasure of peace; I have heard that He is eternal and imperishable.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal pooriaa ghaT ghaT har bhaniaa ||
verses.translation: He is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Lord is said to be permeating each and every heart.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤੀ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: uooch neech sabh ik samaan keeT hasatee baniaa ||
verses.translation: He looks alike upon the high and the low, the ant and the elephant.

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਿਪੋ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਜਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: meet sakhaa sut ba(n)dhipo sabh tis dhe janiaa ||
verses.translation: Friends, companions, children and relatives are all created by Him.

verses.original: ਤੁਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tus naanak dhevai jis naam tin har ra(n)g maniaa ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Naam, enjoys the Lord's love and affection. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa saas giraas na visarai har naamaa(n) man ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each breath and morsel of food, whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Lord's Name

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n s seiee naanakaa pooran soiee sa(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: - they alone are blessed; O Nanak, they are the perfect Saints. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਖਾਵਣ ਸੰਦੜੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: aThe pahar bhaudhaa firai khaavan sa(n)dhaRai sool ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he wanders around, driven by his hunger for food.

verses.original: ਦੋਜਕਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhojak paudhaa kiau rahai jaa chit na hoi rasool ||2||
verses.translation: How can he escape from falling into hell, when he does not remember the Prophet? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: tisai sarevahu praaneeho jis dhai naau palai ||
verses.translation: Serve Him, O mortals, who has the Lord's Name in His lap.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਰਹਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਿਆ ਅਗੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai rahahu suheliaa agai naal chalai ||
verses.translation: You shall dwell in peace and ease in this world; in the world hereafter, it shall go with you.

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਸਚ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਗਡਿ ਥੰਮੁ ਅਹਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ba(n)dhahu sach dharam kaa gadd tha(n)m ahalai ||
verses.translation: So build your home of true righteousness, with the unshakable pillars of Dharma.

verses.original: ਓਟ ਲੈਹੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਝਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: oT laih naarainai dheen dhuneeaa jhalai ||
verses.translation: Take the Support of the Lord, who gives support in the spiritual and material worlds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਕੜੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਲੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak pakaRe charan har tis dharageh malai ||8||
verses.translation: Nanak grasps the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he humbly bows in His Court. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਚਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaachak ma(n)gai dhaan dheh piaariaa ||
verses.translation: The beggar begs for charity: give to me, O my Beloved!

verses.original: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਤ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhevanahaar dhaataar mai nit chitaariaa ||
verses.translation: O Great Giver, O Giving Lord, my consciousness is continually centered on You.

verses.original: ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੂਲਿ ਅਤੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: nikhuT na jaiee mool atul bha(n)ddaariaa ||
verses.translation: The immeasurable warehouses of the Lord can never be emptied out.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadh apaar tin sabh kichh saariaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Word of the Shabad is infinite; it has arranged everything perfectly. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: sikhahu sabadh piaariho janam maran kee Tek ||
verses.translation: O Sikhs, love the Word of the Shabad; in life and death, it is our only support.

verses.original: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਏਕ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mukh uoojal sadhaa sukhee naanak simarat ek ||2||
verses.translation: Your face shall be radiant, and you shall find a lasting peace, O Nanak, remembering the One Lord in meditation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: othai a(n)mrit va(n)ddeeaai sukheeaa har karane ||
verses.translation: There, the Ambrosial Nectar is distributed; the Lord is the Bringer of peace.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jam kai pa(n)th na paie'eeh fir naahee marane ||
verses.translation: They are not placed upon the path of Death, and they shall not have to die again.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no aaiaa prem ras tisai hee jarane ||
verses.translation: One who comes to savor the Lord's Love experiences it.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਅਮਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਝਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: baanee uchareh saadh jan amiau chaleh jharane ||
verses.translation: The Holy beings chant the Bani of the Word, like nectar flowing from a spring.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਣੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: pekh dharasan naanak jeeviaa man a(n)dhar dharane ||9||
verses.translation: Nanak lives by beholding the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those who have implanted the Lord's Name within their minds. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੂਖਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur poorai seviaai dhookhaa kaa hoi naas ||
verses.translation: Serving the Perfect True Guru, suffering ends.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam araadhiaai kaaraj aavai raas ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam in adoration, one's affairs come to be resolved. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat sa(n)kaT chhuTeh anadh ma(n)gal bisraam ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, misfortune departs, and one comes to abide in peace and bliss.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak japeeaai sadhaa har nimakh na bisarau naam ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord - do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee sobhaa kiaa ganee jinee har har ladhaa ||
verses.translation: How can I estimate the glory of those, who have found the Lord, Har, Har?

verses.original: ਸਾਧਾ ਸਰਣੀ ਜੋ ਪਵੈ ਸੋ ਛੁਟੈ ਬਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhaa saranee jo pavai so chhuTai badhaa ||
verses.translation: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is released from bondage.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀਐ ਜੋਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਦਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai abinaaseeaai jon garabh na dhadhaa ||
verses.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord does not burn in the womb of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur bheTiaa paarabraham har paR bujh samadhaa ||
verses.translation: One who meets the Guru and the Supreme Lord God, who reads and understands, enters the state of Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਧਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak paiaa so dhanee har agam agadhaa ||10||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained that Lord Master, who is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਵਤਾ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam na karahee aapanaa fireh avataa loi ||
verses.translation: People do not perform their duties, but instead, they wander around aimlessly.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nai visaariaai sukh kinehaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if they forget the Name, how can they ever find peace? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਕਉੜਤਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bikhai kauRatan sagal maeh jagat rahee lapaTai ||
verses.translation: The bitter poison of corruption is everywhere; it clings to the substance of the world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jan veechaariaa meeThaa har kaa naau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the humble being has realized that the Name of the Lord alone is sweet. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: eeh neesaanee saadh kee jis bheTat tareeaai ||
verses.translation: This is the distinguishing sign of the Holy Saint, that by meeting with him, one is saved.

verses.original: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jamaka(n)kar neR na aaviee fir bahuR na mareeaai ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not come near him; he never has to die again.

verses.original: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhav saagar sa(n)saar bikh so paar utareeaai ||
verses.translation: He crosses over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁੰਫਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਲੁ ਪਰਹਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gu(n)fahu man maal har sabh mal parahareeaai ||
verses.translation: So weave the garland of the Lord's Glorious Praises into your mind, and all your filth shall be washed away.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਰਹਰੀਐ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak preetam mil rahe paarabraham narahareeaai ||11||
verses.translation: Nanak remains blended with his Beloved, the Supreme Lord God. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aae se paravaan hai jin har vuThaa chit ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, approved is the birth of those, within whose consciousness the Lord abides.

verses.original: ਗਾਲੑੀ ਅਲ ਪਲਾਲੀਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਮਿਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gaal(h)ee al palaaleeaa ka(n)m na aaveh mit ||1||
verses.translation: Useless talk and babbling is useless, my friend. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਗਮ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh dhirasaTee aaiaa pooran agam bisamaadh ||
verses.translation: I have come to see the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Inaccessible, Wonderful Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam dhan keetaa poore gur parasaadh ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak has made the Lord's Name his wealth, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧੋਹੁ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਖਸਮ ਨਾਲਿ ਲਬਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoh na chalee khasam naal lab moh vigute ||
verses.translation: Deception does not work with our Lord and Master; through their greed and emotional attachment, people are ruined.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਬ ਕਰਨਿ ਭਲੇਰਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: karatab karan bhaleriaa madh maiaa sute ||
verses.translation: They do their evil deeds, and sleep in the intoxication of Maya.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: fir fir joon bhavaieean jam maarag mute ||
verses.translation: Time and time again, they are consigned to reincarnation, and abandoned on the path of Death.

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa pain aapanaa dhukh setee jute ||
verses.translation: They receive the consequences of their own actions, and are yoked to their pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸਭ ਮੰਦੀ ਰੁਤੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nai visaariaai sabh ma(n)dhee rute ||12||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if one forgets the Name, all the seasons are evil. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਠੰਦਿਆ ਬਹੰਦਿਆ ਸਵੰਦਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: auTha(n)dhiaa baha(n)dhiaa sava(n)dhiaa sukh soi ||
verses.translation: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, be at peace;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaahiaai man tan seetal hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are cooled and soothed. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: laalach aTiaa nit firai suaarath kare na koi ||
verses.translation: Filled with greed, he constantly wanders around; he does not do any good deeds.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis gur bheTai naanakaa tis man vasiaa soi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord abides within the mind of one who meets with the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਕਉੜੀਆ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਉ ਮਿਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe vasatoo kauReeaa sache naau miThaa ||
verses.translation: All material things are bitter; the True Name alone is sweet.

verses.original: ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਧੀ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadh aaiaa tin har janaa(n) chakh saadhee ddiThaa ||
verses.translation: Those humble servants of the Lord who taste it, come to savor its flavor.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jis likhiaa man tisai vuThaa ||
verses.translation: It comes to dwell within the mind of those who are so pre-destined by the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਯਾ ਕੁਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik nira(n)jan rav rahiaa bhaau dhuyaa kuThaa ||
verses.translation: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere; He destroys the love of duality.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: har naanak ma(n)gai joR kar prabh dhevai tuThaa ||13||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the Lord's Name, with his palms pressed together; by His Pleasure, God has granted it. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਚੜੀ ਸਾ ਸਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਜਾਚੰਦੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
verses.translit: jaachaRee saa saar jo jaacha(n)dhee hekaRo ||
verses.translation: The most excellent begging is begging for the One Lord.

verses.original: ਗਾਲੑੀ ਬਿਆ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਣੀ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gaal(h)ee biaa vikaar naanak dhanee vihooneeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Other talk is corrupt, O Nanak, except that of the Lord Master. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨੀਹਿ ਜਿ ਵਿਧਾ ਮੰਨੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਵਿਰਲੋ ਥਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: neeh j vidhaa ma(n)n pachhaanoo viralo thio ||
verses.translation: One who recognizes the Lord is very rare; his mind is pierced through with the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋੜਣਹਾਰਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਪਧਰੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: joRanahaaraa sa(n)t naanak paadhar padharo ||2||
verses.translation: Such a Saint is the Uniter, O Nanak - he straightens out the path. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: soiee sevih jeeaRe dhaataa bakhasi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Serve Him, O my soul, who is the Giver and the Forgiver.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: kilavikh sabh binaas hon simarat govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: All sinful mistakes are erased, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਦਸਿਆ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: har maarag saadhoo dhasiaa japeeaai gurma(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Holy Saint has shown me the Way to the Lord; I chant the GurMantra.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa suaadh sabh fikiaa har man bhaava(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The taste of Maya is totally bland and insipid; the Lord alone is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਧਿਆਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: dhiaai naanak paramesarai jin dhitee ji(n)dh ||14||
verses.translation: Meditate, O Nanak, on the Transcendent Lord, who has blessed you with your soul and your life. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਤ ਲਗੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vat lagee sache naam kee jo beeje so khai ||
verses.translation: The time has come to plant the seed of the Lord's Name; one who plants it, shall eat its fruit.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiseh paraapat naanakaa jis no likhiaa aai ||1||
verses.translation: He alone receives it, O Nanak, whose destiny is so pre-ordained. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੰਗਣਾ ਤ ਸਚੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ganaa ta sach ik jis tus dhevai aap ||
verses.translation: If one begs, then he should beg for the Name of the True One, which is given only by His Pleasure.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jit khaadhai man tirapateeaai naanak saahib dhaat ||2||
verses.translation: Eating this gift from the Lord and Master, O Nanak, the mind is satisfied. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੇ ਖਟਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa jag meh se khaTeh jin har dhan raas ||
verses.translation: They alone earn profit in this world, who have the wealth of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਚੇ ਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: dhuteeaa bhaau na jaananee sache dhee aas ||
verses.translation: They do not know the love of duality; they place their hopes in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal ek sareviaa hor sabh vinaas ||
verses.translation: They serve the One Eternal Lord, and give up everything else.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jis visarai tis birathaa saas ||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Supreme Lord God - useless is his breath.

verses.original: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਨ ਰਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th lai jan rakhiaa naanak bal jaas ||15||
verses.translation: God draws His humble servant close in His loving embrace and protects him - Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham furamaiaa meeh vuThaa sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God gave the Order, and the rain automatically began to fall.

verses.original: ਅੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਰਜੀ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)n dha(n)n bahut upajiaa pirathamee rajee tipat aghai ||
verses.translation: Grain and wealth were produced in abundance; the earth was totally satisfied and satiated.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa gun ucharai dhukh dhaaladh giaa bilai ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and pain and poverty shall run away.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa paiaa miliaa tisai rajai ||
verses.translation: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive, according to the Will of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paramesar jeevaaliaa naanak tisai dhiaai ||1||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord keeps you alive; O Nanak, meditate on Him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan padh nirabaan iko simareeaai ||
verses.translation: To obtain the state of life of Nirvaanaa, meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਧੀਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojee naahee jai kin bidh dheereeaai ||
verses.translation: There is no other place; how else can we be comforted?

verses.original: ਡਿਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: ddiThaa sabh sa(n)saar sukh na naam bin ||
verses.translation: I have seen the whole world - without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tan dhan hosee chhaar jaanai koi jan ||
verses.translation: Body and wealth shall return to dust - hardly anyone realizes this.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਬਾਦਿ ਕਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g roop ras baadh k kareh paraaneeaa ||
verses.translation: Pleasure, beauty and delicious tastes are useless; what are you doing, O mortal?

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਲ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis bhulaae aap tis kal nahee jaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord Himself misleads, does not understand His awesome power.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਚਾ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g rate nirabaan sachaa gaavahee ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord attain Nirvaanaa, singing the Praises of the True One.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saran dhuaar je tudh bhaavahee ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak: those who are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord, seek Sanctuary at Your Door. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran na tin(h) kau jo har laR laage ||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, do not suffer birth and death.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat se paravaan hoe har keeratan jaage ||
verses.translation: Those who remain awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - their lives are approved.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jin paiaa seiee vaddabhaage ||
verses.translation: Those who attain the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are very fortunate.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਤੂਟੇ ਕਚ ਧਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: nai visariaai dhirag jeevanaa tooTe kach dhaage ||
verses.translation: But those who forget the Name - their lives are cursed, and broken like thin strands of thread.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂੜਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਾਧ ਲਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਿਰਾਗੇ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak dhooR puneet saadh lakh koT piraage ||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy is more sacred than hundreds of thousands, even millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਰਣਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੀ ਖੜ ਰਤਨ ਜੜਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharan suva(n)nee khaR ratan jaRaavee har prem purakh man vuThaa ||
verses.translation: Like the beautiful earth, adorned with jewels of grass - such is the mind, within which the Love of the Lord abides.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੇ ਥੀਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabhe kaaj suhelaRe the'ee gur naanak satigur tuThaa ||1||
verses.translation: All one's affairs are easily resolved, O Nanak, when the Guru, the True Guru, is pleased. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਾ ਜਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: firadhee firadhee dheh dhisaa jal parabat banarai ||
verses.translation: Roaming and wandering in the ten directions, over water, mountains and forests

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਮਿਰਤਕੋ ਇਲ ਬਹਿਠੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jithai ddiThaa mritako il bahiThee aai ||2||
verses.translation: - wherever the vulture sees a dead body, he flies down and lands. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਲੋੜੀਅਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis sarab sukhaa fal loRe'eh so sach kamaavau ||
verses.translation: One who longs for all comforts and rewards should practice Truth.

verses.original: ਨੇੜੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: neRai dhekhau paarabraham ik naam dhiaavau ||
verses.translation: Behold the Supreme Lord God near you, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: hoi sagal kee renukaa har sa(n)g samaavau ||
verses.translation: Become the dust of all men's feet, and so merge with the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh na dheiee kisai jeea pat siau ghar jaavau ||
verses.translation: Do not cause any being to suffer, and you shall go to your true home with honor.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਉ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: patit puneet karataa purakh naanak sunaavau ||17||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks of the Purifier of sinners, the Creator, the Primal Being. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਦੋਹਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok dhohaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Dohaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਜਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: ek j saajan mai keeaa sarab kalaa samarath ||
verses.translation: I have made the One Lord my Friend; He is All-powerful to do everything.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਵਥੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeeau hamaaraa kha(n)neeaai har man tan sa(n)dhaRee vath ||1||
verses.translation: My soul is a sacrifice to Him; the Lord is the treasure of my mind and body. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: je kar gaheh piaaraRe tudh na chhoddaa mool ||
verses.translation: Take my hand, O my Beloved; I shall never forsake You.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਨਿ ਸੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਕੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har chhoddan se dhurajanaa paReh dhojak kai sool ||2||
verses.translation: Those who forsake the Lord, are the most evil people; they shall fall into the horrible pit of hell. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh nidhaan ghar jis dhai har kare su hovai ||
verses.translation: All treasures are in His Home; whatever the Lord does, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jap jap jeeveh sa(n)t jan paapaa mal dhovai ||
verses.translation: The Saints live by chanting and meditating on the Lord, washing off the filth of their sins.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal hiradhai vaseh sa(n)kaT sabh khovai ||
verses.translation: With the Lotus Feet of the Lord dwelling within the heart, all misfortune is taken away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa jis bheTeeaai mar janam na rovai ||
verses.translation: One who meets the Perfect Guru, shall not have to suffer through birth and death.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: prabh dharas piaas naanak ghanee kirapaa kar dhevai ||18||
verses.translation: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; by His Grace, He has bestowed it. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok ddakhanaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Dakhanaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੋਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਪਿਰੀ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
verses.translit: bhoree bharam van(j)ai piree muhabat hik too ||
verses.translation: If you can dispel your doubts, even for an instant, and love your only Beloved,

verses.original: ਜਿਥਹੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥਾਊ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jithahu va(n)n(j)ai jai tithaauoo maujoodh soi ||1||
verses.translation: then wherever you go, there you shall find Him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਘੋੜੜੈ ਕੁੰਦੇ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਖੂੰਡੀ ਦੀ ਖੇਡਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: chaR kai ghoRaRai ku(n)dhe pakaReh khoo(n)ddee dhee kheddaaree ||
verses.translation: Can they mount horses and handle guns, if all they know is the game of polo?

verses.original: ਹੰਸਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਕੁਕੜ ਦੀ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ha(n)saa setee chit ulaaseh kukaR dhee oddaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Can they be swans, and fulfill their conscious desires, if they can only fly like chickens? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਉਧਰੈ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa ucharai har sravanee sunai so udharai mitaa ||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Lord's Name with their tongues and hear it with their ears are saved, O my friend.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jas likheh lai bhaavanee se hasat pavitaa ||
verses.translation: Those hands which lovingly write the Praises of the Lord are pure.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath majanaa sabh pu(n)n tin kitaa ||
verses.translation: It is like performing all sorts of virtuous deeds, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੜੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar saagar te udhare bikhiaa gaR jitaa ||
verses.translation: They cross over the world-ocean, and conquer the fortress of corruption.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਦਯੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak laR lai udhaarian dhay sev amitaa ||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, serve the Infinite Lord; grasp the hem of His robe, and He will save you. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੰਧੜੇ ਕੁਲਾਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaRe kulaeh chit na aavai hekaRo ||
verses.translation: Worldly affairs are unprofitable, if the One Lord does not come to mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਤੰਨ ਫੁਟੰਨਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਵਿਸਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak seiee ta(n)n fuTa(n)n jinaa saa(n)iee visarai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the bodies of those who forget their Master shall burst apart. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paretahu keeton dhevataa tin karanaihaare ||
verses.translation: The ghost has been transformed into an angel by the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਸਿਖ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe sikh ubaarian prabh kaaj savaare ||
verses.translation: God has emancipated all the Sikhs and resolved their affairs.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਪਕੜਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak pakaR pachhaaRian jhooThe dharabaare ||
verses.translation: He has seized the slanderers and thrown them to the ground, and declared them false in His Court.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kaa prabh vaddaa hai aap saaj savaare ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak's God is glorious and great; He Himself creates and adorns. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bea(n)t kichh a(n)t naeh sabh tisai karanaa ||
verses.translation: God is unlimited; He has no limit; He is the One who does everything.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਾ ਪਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar saahibo jeeaa(n) kaa paranaa ||
verses.translation: The Inaccessible and Unapproachable Lord and Master is the Support of His beings.

verses.original: ਹਸਤ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: hasat dhei pratipaaladhaa bharan pokhan karanaa ||
verses.translation: Giving His Hand, He nurtures and cherishes; He is the Filler and Fulfiller.

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: miharavaan bakhasi(n)dh aap jap sache taranaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is Merciful and Forgiving. Chanting the True Name, one is saved.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa naanak dhaas saranaa ||20||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You - that alone is good; slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਾ ਰਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ti(n)naa bhukh na kaa rahee jis dhaa prabh hai soi ||
verses.translation: One who belongs to God has no hunger.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak charanee lagiaa udharai sabho koi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, everyone who falls at his feet is saved. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaachik ma(n)gai nit naam saahib kare kabool ||
verses.translation: If the beggar begs for the Lord's Name every day, his Lord and Master will grant his request.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak paramesar jajamaan tiseh bhukh na mool ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord is the most generous host; He does not lack anything at all. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: man rataa govi(n)dh sa(n)g sach bhojan joRe ||
verses.translation: To imbue the mind with the Lord of the Universe is the true food and dress.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਏ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: preet lagee har naam siau e hasatee ghoRe ||
verses.translation: To embrace love for the Name of the Lord is to possess horses and elephants.

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਘਣੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: raaj milakh khuseeaa ghanee dhiaai mukh na moRe ||
verses.translation: To meditate on the Lord steadfastly is to rule over kingdoms of property and enjoy all sorts of pleasures.

verses.original: ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਦਰੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: ddaaddee dhar prabh ma(n)ganaa dhar kadhe na chhoRe ||
verses.translation: The minstrel begs at God's Door - he shall never leave that Door.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੇ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ਕੀਚੇ
verses.translit: naanak man tan chaau eh nit prabh kau loRe ||21||1|| sudh keeche
verses.translation: Nanak has this yearning in his mind and body - he longs continually for God. ||21||1|| Sudh Keechay||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ
verses.translit: raag gauRee bhagataa(n) kee baanee
verses.translation: Raag Gauree, The Word Of The Devotees:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧੪ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree sree kabeer jeeau ke chaupadhe 14 ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourteen Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲਤ ਰਾਮ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh jalat raam jal paiaa ||
verses.translation: I was on fire, but now I have found the Water of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਤਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam udhak tan jalat bujhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This Water of the Lord's Name has cooled my burning body. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਣ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: man maaran kaaran ban jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: To subdue their minds, some go off into the forests;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so jal bin bhagava(n)t na paieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: but that Water is not found without the Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪਾਵਕ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਹੈ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh paavak sur nar hai jaare ||
verses.translation: That fire has consumed angels and mortal beings,

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਜਨ ਜਲਤ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam udhak jan jalat ubaare ||2||
verses.translation: but the Water of the Lord's Name saves His humble servants from burning. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhav saagar sukh saagar maahee ||
verses.translation: In the terrifying world-ocean, there is an ocean of peace.

verses.original: ਪੀਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: peev rahe jal nikhuTat naahee ||3||
verses.translation: I continue to drink it in, but this Water is never exhausted. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer bhaj saari(n)gapaanee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, like the rainbird remembering the water.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam udhak meree tikhaa bujhaanee ||4||1||
verses.translation: The Water of the Lord's Name has quenched my thirst. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਮਾਧਉ ਜਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maadhau jal kee piaas na jai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, my thirst for the Water of Your Name will not go away.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਠੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jal meh agan uThee adhikai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The fire of my thirst burns even more brightly in that Water. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਉ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) jalanidh hau jal kaa meen ||
verses.translation: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am just a fish in that Water.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਜਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jal meh rahau jaleh bin kheen ||1||
verses.translation: In that Water, I remain; without that Water, I would perish. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਹਉ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਤੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) pi(n)jar hau sooaTaa tor ||
verses.translation: You are the cage, and I am Your parrot.

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਮੰਜਾਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jam ma(n)jaar kahaa karai mor ||2||
verses.translation: So what can the cat of death do to me? ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਹਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) taravar hau pa(n)khee aaeh ||
verses.translation: You are the tree, and I am the bird.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhabhaagee tero dharasan naeh ||3||
verses.translation: I am so unfortunate - I cannot see the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan! ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਨਉਤਨੁ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) satigur hau nautan chelaa ||
verses.translation: You are the True Guru, and I am Your new disciple.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਿਲੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer mil a(n)t kee belaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please meet me - this is my very last chance! ||4||2||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jab ham eko ek kar jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: When I realize that there is One, and only One Lord,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਲੋਗਹ ਕਾਹੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tab logeh kaahe dhukh maaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: why then should the people be upset? ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਪਤਹ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ham apateh apunee pat khoiee ||
verses.translation: I am dishonored; I have lost my honor.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੈ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hamarai khoj parahu mat koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: No one should follow in my footsteps. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੰਦੇ ਮੰਦੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ham ma(n)dhe ma(n)dhe man maahee ||
verses.translation: I am bad, and bad in my mind as well.

verses.original: ਸਾਝ ਪਾਤਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saajh paat kaahoo siau naahee ||2||
verses.translation: I have no partnership with anyone. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਅਪਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: pat apat taa kee nahee laaj ||
verses.translation: I have no shame about honor or dishonor.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਜਾਨਹੁਗੇ ਜਬ ਉਘਰੈਗੋ ਪਾਜ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tab jaanahuge jab ugharaigo paaj ||3||
verses.translation: But you shall know, when your own false covering is laid bare. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer pat har paravaan ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, honor is that which is accepted by the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: sarab tiaag bhaj keval raam ||4||3||
verses.translation: Give up everything - meditate, vibrate upon the Lord alone. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਜੌ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: nagan firat jau paieeaai jog ||
verses.translation: If Yoga could be obtained by wandering around naked,

verses.original: ਬਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ban kaa mirag mukat sabh hog ||1||
verses.translation: then all the deer of the forest would be liberated. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਨਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਬਾਧੇ ਚਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa naage kiaa baadhe chaam ||
verses.translation: What does it matter whether someone goes naked, or wears a deer skin,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab nahee cheenas aatam raam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: if he does not remember the Lord within his soul? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੂਡ ਮੁੰਡਾਏ ਜੌ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: moodd mu(n)ddaae jau sidh paiee ||
verses.translation: If the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas could be obtained by shaving the head,

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤੀ ਭੇਡ ਨ ਗਈਆ ਕਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mukatee bhedd na gieeaa kaiee ||2||
verses.translation: then why haven't sheep found liberation? ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਜੌ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bi(n)dh raakh jau tareeaai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: If someone could save himself by celibacy, O Siblings of Destiny,

verses.original: ਖੁਸਰੈ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khusarai kiau na param gat paiee ||3||
verses.translation: why then haven't eunuchs obtained the state of supreme dignity? ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer sunahu nar bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O men, O Siblings of Destiny:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin kin gat paiee ||4||4||
verses.translation: without the Lord's Name, who has ever found salvation? ||4||4||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਸੰਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਇਸ੍ਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)dhiaa praat isanaan karaahee ||
verses.translation: Those who take their ritual baths in the evening and the morning

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਏ ਦਾਦੁਰ ਪਾਨੀ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau bhe dhaadhur paanee maahee ||1||
verses.translation: are like the frogs in the water. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jau pai raam raam rat naahee ||
verses.translation: When people do not love the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: te sabh dharam rai kai jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: they must all go to the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪ ਰਚਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa rat bahu roop rachaahee ||
verses.translation: Those who love their bodies and try different looks,

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin kau dhiaa supanai bhee naahee ||2||
verses.translation: do not feel compassion, even in dreams. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਆਗਰ ॥
verses.translit: chaar charan kaheh bahu aagar ||
verses.translation: The wise men call them four-footed creatures;

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਲਿ ਸਾਗਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sukh paaveh kal saagar ||3||
verses.translation: the Holy find peace in this ocean of pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer bahu kai kareejai ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, why do you perform so many rituals?

verses.original: ਸਰਬਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: sarabas chhodd mahaa ras peejai ||4||5||
verses.translation: Renounce everything, and drink in the supreme essence of the Lord. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer jee gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa jap kiaa tap kiaa brat poojaa ||
verses.translation: What use is chanting, and what use is penance, fasting or devotional worship,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kai ridhai bhaau hai dhoojaa ||1||
verses.translation: to one whose heart is filled with the love of duality? ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: re jan man maadhau siau laieeaai ||
verses.translation: O humble people, link your mind to the Lord.

verses.original: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨ ਚਤੁਰਭੁਜੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chaturaiee na chaturabhuj paieeaai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through cleverness, the four-armed Lord is not obtained. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਰਹਰੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: parahar lobh ar lokaachaar ||
verses.translation: Set aside your greed and worldly ways.

verses.original: ਪਰਹਰੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: parahar kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||2||
verses.translation: Set aside sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਬਧੇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: karam karat badhe aha(n)mev ||
verses.translation: Ritual practices bind people in egotism;

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mil paathar kee karahee sev ||3||
verses.translation: meeting together, they worship stones. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer bhagat kar paiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, He is obtained only by devotional worship.

verses.original: ਭੋਲੇ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: bhole bhai mile raghuraiaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: Through innocent love, the Lord is met. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: garabh vaas meh kul nahee jaatee ||
verses.translation: In the dwelling of the womb, there is no ancestry or social status.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਉਤਪਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: braham bi(n)dh te sabh utapaatee ||1||
verses.translation: All have originated from the Seed of God. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬਾਮਨ ਕਬ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ॥
verses.translit: kahu re pa(n)ddit baaman kab ke hoe ||
verses.translation: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: since when have you been a Brahmin?

verses.original: ਬਾਮਨ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਤ ਖੋਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baaman keh keh janam mat khoe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Don't waste your life by continually claiming to be a Brahmin. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੌ ਤੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jau too(n) braahaman brahamanee jaiaa ||
verses.translation: If you are indeed a Brahmin, born of a Brahmin mother,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਆਨ ਬਾਟ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tau aan baaT kaahe nahee aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: then why didn't you come by some other way? ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਹਮ ਕਤ ਸੂਦ ॥
verses.translit: tum kat braahaman ham kat soodh ||
verses.translation: How is it that you are a Brahmin, and I am of a low social status?

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕਤ ਲੋਹੂ ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਦੂਧ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ham kat lohoo tum kat dhoodh ||3||
verses.translation: How is it that I am formed of blood, and you are made of milk? ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jo braham beechaarai ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, one who contemplates God,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: so braahaman kaheeat hai hamaarai ||4||7||
verses.translation: is said to be a Brahmin among us. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhakaar sukh kabeh na soiee hai ||
verses.translation: In the darkness, no one can sleep in peace.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raajaa ra(n)k dhouoo mil roiee hai ||1||
verses.translation: The king and the pauper both weep and cry. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਬੋ ॥
verses.translit: jau pai rasanaa raam na kahibo ||
verses.translation: As long as the tongue does not chant the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਉਪਜਤ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਰੋਵਤ ਰਹਿਬੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aupajat binasat rovat rahibo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: the person continues coming and going in reincarnation, crying out in pain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਸ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jas dhekheeaai taravar kee chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: It is like the shadow of a tree;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਏ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: praan ge kahu kaa kee maiaa ||2||
verses.translation: when the breath of life passes out of the mortal being, tell me, what becomes of his wealth? ||2||

verses.original: ਜਸ ਜੰਤੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jas ja(n)tee meh jeeau samaanaa ||
verses.translation: It is like the music contained in the instrument;

verses.original: ਮੂਏ ਮਰਮੁ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mooe maram ko kaa kar jaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: how can anyone know the secret of the dead? ||3||

verses.original: ਹੰਸਾ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)saa saravar kaal sareer ||
verses.translation: Like the swan on the lake, death hovers over the body.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਪੀਉ ਰੇ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: raam rasain peeau re kabeer ||4||8||
verses.translation: Drink in the Lord's sweet elixir, Kabeer. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੀ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jot kee jaat jaat kee jotee ||
verses.translation: The creation is born of the Light, and the Light is in the creation.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ਕੰਚੂਆ ਫਲ ਮੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tit laage ka(n)chooaa fal motee ||1||
verses.translation: It bears two fruits: the false glass and the true pearl. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਜੋ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: kavanu su ghar jo nirabhau kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: Where is that home, which is said to be free of fear?

verses.original: ਭਉ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhau bhaj jai abhai hoi raheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: There, fear is dispelled and one lives without fear. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: taT teerath nahee man pateeaai ||
verses.translation: On the banks of sacred rivers, the mind is not appeased.

verses.original: ਚਾਰ ਅਚਾਰ ਰਹੇ ਉਰਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chaar achaar rahe urajhai ||2||
verses.translation: People remain entangled in good and bad deeds. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਦੁਇ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: paap pu(n)n dhui ek samaan ||
verses.translation: Sin and virtue are both the same.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਆਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nij ghar paaras tajahu gun aan ||3||
verses.translation: In the home of your own being, is the Philosopher's Stone; renounce your search for any other virtue. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer niragun naam na ros ||
verses.translation: Kabeer: O worthless mortal, do not lose the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਪਰਚਾਇ ਪਰਚਿ ਰਹੁ ਏਸੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: eis parachai parach rahu es ||4||9||
verses.translation: Keep this mind of yours involved in this involvement. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਰਮਨੁ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan paramit paraman jaanaa ||
verses.translation: He claims to know the Lord, who is beyond measure and beyond thought;

verses.original: ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baatan hee baiku(n)Th samaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: by mere words, he plans to enter heaven. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕਹਾ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: naa jaanaa baiku(n)Th kahaa hee ||
verses.translation: I do not know where heaven is.

verses.original: ਜਾਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaan jaan sabh kaheh tahaa hee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Everyone claims that he plans to go there. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਅਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahan kahaavan neh pateeiee hai ||
verses.translation: By mere talk, the mind is not appeased.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tau man maanai jaa te haumai jiee hai ||2||
verses.translation: The mind is only appeased, when egotism is conquered. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag man baiku(n)Th kee aas ||
verses.translation: As long as the mind is filled with the desire for heaven,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tab lag hoi nahee charan nivaas ||3||
verses.translation: he does not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer ieh kaheeaai kaeh ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, unto whom should I tell this?

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਆਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat baiku(n)Thai aaeh ||4||10||
verses.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਉਪਜੈ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਨਿਪਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aupajai nipajai nipaj samaiee ||
verses.translation: We are born, and we grow, and having grown, we pass away.

verses.original: ਨੈਨਹ ਦੇਖਤ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naineh dhekhat ih jag jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Before our very eyes, this world is passing away. ||1||

verses.original: ਲਾਜ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: laaj na marahu kahahu ghar meraa ||
verses.translation: How can you not die of shame, claiming, ""This world is mine""?

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kee baar nahee kachh teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, nothing is yours. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar kaiaa paalee ||
verses.translation: Trying various methods, you cherish your body,

verses.original: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maratee baar agan sa(n)g jaalee ||2||
verses.translation: but at the time of death, it is burned in the fire. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮਰਦਨ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: choaa cha(n)dhan maradhan a(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: You apply sandalwood oil to your limbs,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so tan jalai kaaTh kai sa(n)gaa ||3||
verses.translation: but that body is burned with the firewood. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer sunahu re guneeaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O virtuous people:

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸੈਗੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: binasaigo roop dhekhai sabh dhuneeaa ||4||11||
verses.translation: your beauty shall vanish, as the whole world watches. ||4||11||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਮੂਏ ਕਿਆ ਸੋਗੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: avar mooe kiaa sog kareejai ||
verses.translation: Why do you cry and mourn, when another person dies?

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau keejai jau aapan jeejai ||1||
verses.translation: Do so only if you yourself are to live. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨ ਮਰਉ ਮਰਿਬੋ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai na marau maribo sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: I shall not die as the rest of the world dies,

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਹੈ ਜੀਆਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh milio hai jeeaavanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: for now I have met the life-giving Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਰਮਲ ਮਹਕੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: eiaa dhehee paramal mahaka(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: People anoint their bodies with fragrant oils,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa sukh bisare paramaana(n)dhaa ||2||
verses.translation: and in that pleasure, they forget the supreme bliss. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੂਅਟਾ ਏਕੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kooaTaa ek pa(n)ch panihaaree ||
verses.translation: There is one well, and five water-carriers.

verses.original: ਟੂਟੀ ਲਾਜੁ ਭਰੈ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: TooTee laaj bharai mat haaree ||3||
verses.translation: Even though the rope is broken, the fools continue trying to draw water. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer ik budh beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਕੂਅਟਾ ਨਾ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naa oh kooaTaa naa panihaaree ||4||12||
verses.translation: There is no well, and no water-carrier. ||4||12||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਅਸਥਾਵਰ ਜੰਗਮ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: asathaavar ja(n)gam keeT pata(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: The mobile and immobile creatures, insects and moths

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik janam ke'ee bahu ra(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: - in numerous lifetimes, I have passed through those many forms. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਘਰ ਹਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aaise ghar ham bahut basaae ||
verses.translation: I lived in many such homes, O Lord,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਗਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab ham raam garabh hoi aae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: before I came into the womb this time. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jogee jatee tapee brahamachaaree ||
verses.translation: I was a Yogi, a celibate, a penitent, and a Brahmchaaree, with strict self-discipline.

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਰਾਜਾ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kabahoo raajaa chhatrapat kabahoo bhekhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Sometimes I was a king, sitting on the throne, and sometimes I was a beggar. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: saakat mareh sa(n)t sabh jeeveh ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics shall die, while the Saints shall all survive.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam rasain rasanaa peeveh ||3||
verses.translation: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence with their tongues. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer prabh kirapaa keejai ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, O God, have mercy on me.

verses.original: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਪੂਰਾ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: haar pare ab pooraa dheejai ||4||13||
verses.translation: I am so tired; now, please bless me with Your perfection. ||4||13||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee kee naal ralai likhiaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, With Writings Of The Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso acharaj dhekhio kabeer ||
verses.translation: Kabeer has seen such wonders!

verses.original: ਦਧਿ ਕੈ ਭੋਲੈ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhadh kai bholai birolai neer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Mistaking it for cream, the people are churning water. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰੀ ਅੰਗੂਰੀ ਗਦਹਾ ਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: haree a(n)gooree gadhahaa charai ||
verses.translation: The donkey grazes upon the green grass;

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਹਾਸੈ ਹੀਗੈ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nit uTh haasai heegai marai ||1||
verses.translation: arising each day, he laughs and brays, and then dies. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਤਾ ਭੈਸਾ ਅੰਮੁਹਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maataa bhaisaa a(n)muhaa jai ||
verses.translation: The bull is intoxicated, and runs around wildly.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਿ ਕੁਦਿ ਚਰੈ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kudh kudh charai rasaatal pai ||2||
verses.translation: He romps and eats and then falls into hell. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਖੇਡ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer paragaT bhiee khedd ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, a strange sport has become manifest:

verses.original: ਲੇਲੇ ਕਉ ਚੂਘੈ ਨਿਤ ਭੇਡ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: lele kau chooghai nit bhedd ||3||
verses.translation: the sheep is sucking the milk of her lamb. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam ramat mat paragaTee aaiee ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, my intellect is enlightened.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer gur sojhee paiee ||4||1||14||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the Guru has blessed me with this understanding. ||4||1||14||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee pa(n)chapadhe ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Panch-Padhay:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jal chhodd baahar bhio meenaa ||
verses.translation: I am like a fish out of water,

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਹਉ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poorab janam hau tap kaa heenaa ||1||
verses.translation: because in my previous life, I did not practice penance and intense meditation. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ab kahu raam kavan gat moree ||
verses.translation: Now tell me, Lord, what will my condition be?

verses.original: ਤਜੀ ਲੇ ਬਨਾਰਸ ਮਤਿ ਭਈ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tajee le banaaras mat bhiee thoree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I left Benares - I had little common sense. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sagal janam siv puree gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: I wasted my whole life in the city of Shiva;

verses.original: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਮਗਹਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maratee baar magahar uTh aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: at the time of my death, I moved to Magahar. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਰਸ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: bahut baras tap keeaa kaasee ||
verses.translation: For many years, I practiced penance and intense meditation at Kaashi;

verses.original: ਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਗਹਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maran bhiaa magahar kee baasee ||3||
verses.translation: now that my time to die has come, I have come to dwell at Magahar! ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਸੀ ਮਗਹਰ ਸਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaasee magahar sam beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Kaashi and Magahar - I consider them the same.

verses.original: ਓਛੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ochhee bhagat kaise utaras paaree ||4||
verses.translation: With inadequate devotion, how can anyone swim across? ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਜ ਸਿਵ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu gur gaj siv sabh ko jaanai ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the Guru and Ganaysha and Shiva all know

verses.original: ਮੁਆ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਮਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮੈ ॥੫॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: muaa kabeer ramat sree raamai ||5||15||
verses.translation: that Kabeer died chanting the Lord's Name. ||5||15||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਮਰਦਨ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: choaa cha(n)dhan maradhan a(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: You may anoint your limbs with sandalwood oil,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so tan jalai kaaTh kai sa(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: but in the end, that body will be burned with the firewood. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis tan dhan kee kavan baddaiee ||
verses.translation: Why should anyone take pride in this body or wealth?

verses.original: ਧਰਨਿ ਪਰੈ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharan parai uravaar na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They shall end up lying on the ground; they shall not go along with you to the world beyond. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: raat j soveh dhin kareh kaam ||
verses.translation: They sleep by night and work during the day,

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਲੇਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eik khin leh na har ko naam ||2||
verses.translation: but they do not chant the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਾਥਿ ਤ ਡੋਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇਓ ਤੰਬੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: haath ta ddor mukh khaio ta(n)bor ||
verses.translation: They hold the string of the kite in their hands, and chew betel leaves in their mouths,

verses.original: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਕਸਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਚੋਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maratee baar kas baadhio chor ||3||
verses.translation: but at the time of death, they shall be tied up tight, like thieves. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat ras ras har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, and immersed in His Love, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: raamai raam ramat sukh paavai ||4||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and find peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kar kai naam dhiraRaiee ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, He implants the Naam within us;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: har har baas suga(n)dh basaiee ||5||
verses.translation: inhale deeply the sweet aroma and fragrance of the Lord, Har, Har. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer chet re a(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, remember Him, you blind fool!

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੬॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: sat raam jhooThaa sabh dha(n)dhaa ||6||16||
verses.translation: The Lord is True; all worldly affairs are false. ||6||16||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਤਿਪਦੇ ਚਾਰਤੁਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee tipadhe chaaratuke ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Thi-Padhay And Chau-Thukay:

verses.original: ਜਮ ਤੇ ਉਲਟਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jam te ulaT bhe hai raam ||
verses.translation: I have turned away from death and turned to the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਓ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh binase sukh keeo bisaraam ||
verses.translation: Pain has been eliminated, and I dwell in peac and comfort.

verses.original: ਬੈਰੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bairee ulaT bhe hai meetaa ||
verses.translation: My enemies have been transformed into friends.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਉਲਟਿ ਸੁਜਨ ਭਏ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saakat ulaT sujan bhe cheetaa ||1||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics have been transformed into good-hearted people. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh sarab kusal kar maaniaa ||
verses.translation: Now, I feel that everything brings me peace.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਜਬ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t bhiee jab gobidh jaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Peace and tranquility have come, since I realized the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: tan meh hotee koT upaadh ||
verses.translation: My body was afflicted with millions of diseases.

verses.original: ਉਲਟਿ ਭਈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: aulaT bhiee sukh sahaj samaadh ||
verses.translation: They have been transformed into the peaceful, tranquil concentration of Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਆਪੈ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaanai aapai aap ||
verses.translation: When someone understands his own self,

verses.original: ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਤੀਨੌ ਤਾਪ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: rog na biaapai teenau taap ||2||
verses.translation: he no longer suffers from illness and the three fevers. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮਨੁ ਉਲਟਿ ਸਨਾਤਨੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: ab man ulaT sanaatan hooaa ||
verses.translation: My mind has now been restored to its original purity.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਜਬ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: tab jaaniaa jab jeevat mooaa ||
verses.translation: When I became dead while yet alive, only then did I come to know the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer sukh sahaj samaavau ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I am now immersed in intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਡਰਉ ਨ ਅਵਰ ਡਰਾਵਉ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: aap na ddarau na avar ddaraavau ||3||17||
verses.translation: I do not fear anyone, and I do not strike fear into anyone else. ||3||17||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਪਿੰਡਿ ਮੂਐ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: pi(n)dd mooaai jeeau keh ghar jaataa ||
verses.translation: When the body dies, where does the soul go?

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ateet anaahadh raataa ||
verses.translation: It is absorbed into the untouched, unstruck melody of the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin raam jaaniaa tineh pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Only one who knows the Lord realizes Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਸਾਕਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau goo(n)ge saakar man maaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: The mind is satisfied and satiated, like the mute who eats the sugar candy and just smiles, without speaking. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਥੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa giaan kathai banavaaree ||
verses.translation: Such is the spiritual wisdom which the Lord has imparted.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man re pavan dhiraR sukhaman naaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O mind, hold your breath steady within the central channel of the Sushmanaa. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: so gur karahu j bahur na karanaa ||
verses.translation: Adopt such a Guru, that you shall not have to adopt another again.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਦੁ ਰਵਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਰਵਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: so padh ravahu j bahur na ravanaa ||
verses.translation: Dwell in such a state, that you shall never have to dwell in any other.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: so dhiaan dharahu j bahur na dharanaa ||
verses.translation: Embrace such a meditation, that you shall never have to embrace any other.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaise marahu j bahur na maranaa ||2||
verses.translation: Die in such a way, that you shall never have to die again. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਲਟੀ ਗੰਗਾ ਜਮੁਨ ਮਿਲਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: aulaTee ga(n)gaa jamun milaavau ||
verses.translation: Turn your breath away from the left channel, and away from the right channel, and unite them in the central channel of the Sushmanaa.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸੰਗਮ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੑਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin jal sa(n)gam man meh n(h)aavau ||
verses.translation: At their confluence within your mind, take your bath there without water.

verses.original: ਲੋਚਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: lochaa samasar ih biauhaaraa ||
verses.translation: To look upon all with an impartial eye - let this be your daily occupation.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਅਵਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tat beechaar kiaa avar beechaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Contemplate this essence of reality - what else is there to contemplate? ||3||

verses.original: ਅਪੁ ਤੇਜੁ ਬਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਆਕਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: ap tej bai pirathamee aakaasaa ||
verses.translation: Water, fire, wind, earth and ether

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਰਹਤ ਰਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee rahat rahau har paasaa ||
verses.translation: adopt such a way of life and you shall be close to the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahai kabeer nira(n)jan dhiaavau ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: tit ghar jaau j bahur na aavau ||4||18||
verses.translation: Go to that home, which you shall never have to leave. ||4||18||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee tipadhe ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Thi-Padhay:

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan siau paieeaai nahee tol ||
verses.translation: He cannot be obtained by offering your weight in gold.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ਹੈ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man dhe raam leeaa hai mol ||1||
verses.translation: But I have bought the Lord by giving my mind to Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ab moh raam apunaa kar jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Now I recognize that He is my Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj subhai meraa man maaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind is intuitively pleased with Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: brahamai kath kath a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma spoke of Him continually, but could not find His limit.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam bhagat baiThe ghar aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Because of my devotion to the Lord, He has come to sit within the home of my inner being. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer cha(n)chal mat tiaagee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have renounced my restless intellect.

verses.original: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਜ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੯॥
