verses.translit: keval raam bhagat nij bhaagee ||3||1||19||
verses.translation: It is my destiny to worship the Lord alone. ||3||1||19||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਮਰਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeh maranai sabh jagat taraasiaa ||
verses.translation: That death which terrifies the entire world

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਰਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so maranaa gur sabadh pragaasiaa ||1||
verses.translation: - the nature of that death has been revealed to me, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਰਉ ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ab kaise marau maran man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: Now, how shall I die? My mind has already accepted death.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mar mar jaate jin raam na jaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who do not know the Lord, die over and over again, and then depart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਰਨੋ ਮਰਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: marano maran kahai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone says, ""I will die, I will die.""

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahaje marai amar hoi soiee ||2||
verses.translation: But he alone becomes immortal, who dies with intuitive understanding. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer man bhiaa ana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, my mind is filled with bliss;

verses.original: ਗਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: giaa bharam rahiaa paramaana(n)dhaa ||3||20||
verses.translation: my doubts have been eliminated, and I am in ecstasy. ||3||20||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਤ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: kat nahee Thaur mool kat laavau ||
verses.translation: There is no special place where the soul aches; where should I apply the ointment?

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khojat tan meh Thaur na paavau ||1||
verses.translation: I have searched the body, but I have not found such a place. ||1||

verses.original: ਲਾਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: laagee hoi su jaanai peer ||
verses.translation: He alone knows it, who feels the pain of such love;

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਨੀਆਲੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam bhagat aneeaale teer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: the arrows of the Lord's devotional worship are so sharp! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਭਾਇ ਦੇਖਉ ਸਭ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ek bhai dhekhau sabh naaree ||
verses.translation: I look upon all His soul-brides with an impartial eye;

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ਸਹ ਕਉਨ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kiaa jaanau seh kaun piaaree ||2||
verses.translation: how can I know which ones are dear to the Husband Lord? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jaa kai masatak bhaag ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, one who has such destiny inscribed upon her forehead

verses.original: ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੩॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: sabh parahar taa kau milai suhaag ||3||21||
verses.translation: - her Husband Lord turns all others away, and meets with her. ||3||21||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai har saa Thaakur bhaiee ||
verses.translation: One who has the Lord as his Master, O Siblings of Destiny

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਅਨੰਤ ਪੁਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mukat ana(n)t pukaaran jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: - countless liberations knock at his door. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ab kahu raam bharosaa toraa ||
verses.translation: If I say now that my trust is in You alone, Lord,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tab kaahoo kaa kavan nihoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: then what obligation do I have to anyone else? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਹਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: teen lok jaa kai heh bhaar ||
verses.translation: He bears the burden of the three worlds;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so kaahe na karai pratipaar ||2||
verses.translation: why should He not cherish you also? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer ik budh beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਬਸੁ ਜਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: kiaa bas jau bikh dhe mahataaree ||3||22||
verses.translation: If the mother poisons her own child, what can anyone do? ||3||22||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤ ਸਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin sat satee hoi kaise naar ||
verses.translation: Without Truth, how can the woman be a true satee - a widow who burns herself on her husband's funeral pyre?

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit dhekhahu ridhai beechaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, see this and contemplate it within your heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਧੈ ਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: preet binaa kaise badhai saneh ||
verses.translation: Without love, how can one's affection increase?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਸੁ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag ras tab lag nahee neh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As long as there is attachment to pleasure, there can be no spiritual love. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਨਿ ਸਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਅ ਅਪਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: saahan sat karai jeea apanai ||
verses.translation: One who, in his own soul, believes the Queen Maya to be true,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਰਮਯੇ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਸੁਪਨੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so ramaye kau milai na supanai ||2||
verses.translation: does not meet the Lord, even in dreams. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tan man dhan girahu saup sareer ||
verses.translation: One who surrenders her body, mind, wealth, home and self

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੩॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: soiee suhaagan kahai kabeer ||3||23||
verses.translation: - she is the true soul-bride, says Kabeer. ||3||23||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa biaapiaa sagal sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The whole world is engrossed in corruption.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੈ ਡੂਬੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa lai ddoobee paravaar ||1||
verses.translation: This corruption has drowned entire families. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਵ ਚਉੜਿ ਕਤ ਬੋੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: re nar naav chauR kat boRee ||
verses.translation: O man, why have you wrecked your boat and sunk it?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਤੋੜਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋੜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har siau toR bikhiaa sa(n)g joRee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You have broken with the Lord, and joined hands with corruption. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦਾਧੇ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar dhaadhe laagee aag ||
verses.translation: Angels and human beings alike are burning in the raging fire.

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਸੁ ਪੀਵਸਿ ਨ ਝਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nikaT neer pas peevas na jhaag ||2||
verses.translation: The water is near at hand, but the beast does not drink it in. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੇਤਤ ਚੇਤਤ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: chetat chetat nikasio neer ||
verses.translation: By constant contemplation and awareness, the water is brought forth.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਥਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੩॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: so jal niramal kathat kabeer ||3||24||
verses.translation: That water is immaculate and pure, says Kabeer. ||3||24||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲਿ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh kul poot na giaan beechaaree ||
verses.translation: That family, whose son has no spiritual wisdom or contemplation

verses.original: ਬਿਧਵਾ ਕਸ ਨ ਭਈ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bidhavaa kas na bhiee mahataaree ||1||
verses.translation: - why didn't his mother just become a widow? ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh nar raam bhagat neh saadhee ||
verses.translation: That man who has not practiced devotional worship of the Lord

verses.original: ਜਨਮਤ ਕਸ ਨ ਮੁਓ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janamat kas na muo aparaadhee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - why didn't such a sinful man die at birth? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੁਚੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰਭ ਗਏ ਕੀਨ ਬਚਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: much much garabh ge keen bachiaa ||
verses.translation: So many pregnancies end in miscarriage - why was this one spared?

verses.original: ਬੁਡਭੁਜ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਵੇ ਜਗ ਮਝਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: buddabhuj roop jeeve jag majhiaa ||2||
verses.translation: He lives his life in this world like a deformed amputee. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰੂਪ ॥ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਬਜ ਕੁਰੂਪ ॥੩॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jaise su(n)dhar saroop || naam binaa jaise kubaj kuroop ||3||25||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, beautiful and handsome people are just ugly hunch-backs. ||3||25||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੇਹਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jan leh khasam kaa naau || tin kai sadh balihaarai jaau ||1||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those humble beings who take the Name of their Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so niramal niramal har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Pure Lord are pure.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so bhaiee merai man bhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They are my Siblings of Destiny, so dear to my heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਹਮ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeh ghaT raam rahiaa bharapoor || tin kee pag pa(n)kaj ham dhoor ||2||
verses.translation: I am the dust of the lotus feet of those whose hearts are filled with the All-pervading Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaat julaahaa mat kaa dheer ||
verses.translation: I am a weaver by birth, and patient of mind.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: sahaj sahaj gun ramai kabeer ||3||26||
verses.translation: Slowly, steadily, Kabeer chants the Glories of God. ||3||26||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਗਗਨਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਚੁਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਭਾਠੀ ॥
verses.translit: gagan rasaal chuaai meree bhaaThee ||
verses.translation: From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the nectar trickles down, distilled from my furnace.

verses.original: ਸੰਚਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਾਠੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)ch mahaa ras tan bhiaa kaaThee ||1||
verses.translation: I have gathered in this most sublime essence, making my body into firewood. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਆ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਹਜ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: auaa kau kaheeaai sahaj matavaaraa ||
verses.translation: He alone is called intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise,

verses.original: ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: peevat raam ras giaan beechaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: who drinks in the juice of the Lord's essence, contemplating spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਕਲਾਲਨਿ ਜਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj kalaalan jau mil aaiee ||
verses.translation: Intuitive poise is the bar-maid who comes to serve it.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh maate anadhin jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: I pass my nights and days in ecstasy. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੀਨਤ ਚੀਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: cheenat cheet nira(n)jan laiaa ||
verses.translation: Through conscious meditation, I linked my consciousness with the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੌ ਅਨਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer tau anabhau paiaa ||3||27||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, then I obtained the Fearless Lord. ||3||27||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa subhaau maneh biaapee ||
verses.translation: The natural tendency of the mind is to chase the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਵਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਥਾਪੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maneh maar kavan sidh thaapee ||1||
verses.translation: Who has established himself as a Siddha, a being of miraculous spiritual powers, by killing his mind? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavanu su mun jo man maarai ||
verses.translation: Who is that silent sage, who has killed his mind?

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man kau maar kahahu kis taarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By killing the mind, tell me, who is saved? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: man a(n)tar bolai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone speaks through the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man maare bin bhagat na hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: Without killing the mind, devotional worship is not performed. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jo jaanai bheau ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, one who knows the secret of this mystery,

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: man madhusoodhan tirabhavan dheau ||3||28||
verses.translation: beholds within his own mind the Lord of the three worlds. ||3||28||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਅੰਬਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi ju dheeseh a(n)bar taare ||
verses.translation: The stars which are seen in the sky

verses.original: ਕਿਨਿ ਓਇ ਚੀਤੇ ਚੀਤਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kin oi cheete cheetanahaare ||1||
verses.translation: - who is the painter who painted them? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu re pa(n)ddit a(n)bar kaa siau laagaa ||
verses.translation: Tell me, O Pandit, what is the sky attached to?

verses.original: ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: boojhai boojhanahaar sabhaagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate is the knower who knows this. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sooraj cha(n)dh kareh ujeeaaraa ||
verses.translation: The sun and the moon give their light;

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh meh pasariaa braham pasaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: God's creative extension extends everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾਨੈਗਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jaanaigaa soi ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, he alone knows this,

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: hiradhai raam mukh raamai hoi ||3||29||
verses.translation: whose heart is filled with the Lord, and whose mouth is also filled with the Lord. ||3||29||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bedh kee putree si(n)mirat bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Simritee is the daughter of the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਕਲ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਲੈ ਹੈ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saa(n)kal jevaree lai hai aaiee ||1||
verses.translation: She has brought a chain and a rope. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਨਗਰੁ ਆਪ ਤੇ ਬਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapan nagar aap te baadhiaa ||
verses.translation: She has imprisoned the people in her own city.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਫਾਧਿ ਕਾਲ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh kai faadh kaal sar saa(n)dhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: She has tightened the noose of emotional attachment and shot the arrow of death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਟੀ ਨ ਕਟੈ ਤੂਟਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaTee na kaTai tooT neh jaiee ||
verses.translation: By cutting, she cannot be cut, and she cannot be broken.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਸਾਪਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saa saapan hoi jag kau khaiee ||2||
verses.translation: She has become a serpent, and she is eating the world. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਦੇਖਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ham dhekhat jin sabh jag looTiaa ||
verses.translation: Before my very eyes, she has plundered the entire world.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer mai raam keh chhooTiaa ||3||30||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, I have escaped her. ||3||30||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਦੇਇ ਮੁਹਾਰ ਲਗਾਮੁ ਪਹਿਰਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhei muhaar lagaam pahiraavau ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the reins and attached the bridle;

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਤ ਜੀਨੁ ਗਗਨ ਦਉਰਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal ta jeen gagan dhauraavau ||1||
verses.translation: abandoning everything, I now ride through the skies. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: apanai beechaar asavaaree keejai ||
verses.translation: I made self-reflection my mount,

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੜੈ ਪਗੁ ਧਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj kai paavaRai pag dhar leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and in the stirrups of intuitive poise, I placed my feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਲੁ ਰੇ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਲੇ ਤਾਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: chal re baiku(n)Th tujheh le taarau ||
verses.translation: Come, and let me ride you to heaven.

verses.original: ਹਿਚਹਿ ਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਮਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hicheh ta prem kai chaabuk maarau ||2||
verses.translation: If you hold back, then I shall strike you with the whip of spiritual love. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਲੇ ਅਸਵਾਰਾ ॥ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer bhale asavaaraa || bedh kateb te raheh niraaraa ||3||31||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, those who remain detached from the Vedas, the Koran and the Bible are the best riders. ||3||31||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਂਚਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeh mukh paa(n)chau a(n)mirat khaae ||
verses.translation: That mouth, which used to eat the five delicacies

verses.original: ਤਿਹ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖਤ ਲੂਕਟ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teh mukh dhekhat lookaT laae ||1||
verses.translation: - I have seen the flames being applied to that mouth. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhukh raam rai kaaTahu meraa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, my King, please rid me of this one affliction:

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ ਅਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: agan dhahai ar garabh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: may I not be burned in fire, or cast into the womb again. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਬਿਗੂਤੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa bigootee bahu bidh bhaatee ||
verses.translation: The body is destroyed by so many ways and means.

verses.original: ਕੋ ਜਾਰੇ ਕੋ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ko jaare ko gadd le maaTee ||2||
verses.translation: Some burn it, and some bury it in the earth. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer har charan dhikhaavahu ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please reveal to me Your Lotus Feet;

verses.original: ਪਾਛੈ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: paachhai te jam kiau na paThaavahu ||3||32||
verses.translation: after that, go ahead and send me to my death. ||3||32||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape paavak aape pavanaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the fire, and He Himself is the wind.

verses.original: ਜਾਰੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਤ ਰਾਖੈ ਕਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaarai khasam ta raakhai kavanaa ||1||
verses.translation: When our Lord and Master wishes to burn someone, then who can save him? ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਤਨੁ ਜਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: raam japat tan jar kee na jai ||
verses.translation: When I chant the Lord's Name, what does it matter if my body burns?

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam chit rahiaa samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My consciousness remains absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਜਰੈ ਕਾਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaa ko jarai kaeh hoi haan ||
verses.translation: Who is burned, and who suffers loss?

verses.original: ਨਟ ਵਟ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naT vaT khelai saarigapaan ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord plays, like the juggler with his ball. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਖਿ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer akhar dhui bhaakh ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, chant the two letters of the Lord's Name - Raa Maa.

verses.original: ਹੋਇਗਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਤ ਲੇਇਗਾ ਰਾਖਿ ॥੩॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: hoigaa khasam ta leigaa raakh ||3||33||
verses.translation: If He is your Lord and Master, He will protect you. ||3||33||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee dhupadhe ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa mai jog dhiaan chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: I have not practiced Yoga, or focused my consciousness on meditation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin bairaag na chhooTas maiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Without renunciation, I cannot escape Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaise jeevan hoi hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: How have I passed my life?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab na hoi raam naam adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have not taken the Lord's Name as my Support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਖੋਜਉ ਅਸਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer khojau asamaan ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have searched the skies,

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਸਮਾਨ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਆਨ ॥੨॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: raam samaan na dhekhau aan ||2||34||
verses.translation: and have not seen another, equal to the Lord. ||2||34||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਬਾਧਤ ਪਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: jeh sir rach rach baadhat paag ||
verses.translation: That head which was once embellished with the finest turban

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਚੁੰਚ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so sir chu(n)ch savaareh kaag ||1||
verses.translation: - upon that head, the crow now cleans his beak. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: eis tan dhan ko kiaa garabieeaa ||
verses.translation: What pride should we take in this body and wealth?

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam kaahe na dhiraR(h)eeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Why not hold tight to the Lord's Name instead? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu man mere ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mind:

verses.original: ਇਹੀ ਹਵਾਲ ਹੋਹਿਗੇ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: eihee havaal hohige tere ||2||35||
verses.translation: this may be your fate as well! ||2||35||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਪੈਤੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree ke padhe paitees ||
verses.translation: Thirty-Five Steps Of Gauree Gwaarayree. ||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag gauRee guaareree asaTapadhee kabeer jee kee
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Ashtpadheeyaa Of Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sukh maa(n)gat dhukh aagai aavai ||
verses.translation: People beg for pleasure, but pain comes instead.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਂਗਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so sukh hamahu na maa(n)giaa bhaavai ||1||
verses.translation: I would rather not beg for that pleasure. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅਜਹੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa ajahu surat sukh aasaa ||
verses.translation: People are involved in corruption, but still, they hope for pleasure.

verses.original: ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaise hoiee hai raajaa raam nivaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How will they find their home in the Sovereign Lord King? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਡਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis sukh te siv braham ddaraanaa ||
verses.translation: Even Shiva and Brahma are afraid of this pleasure,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so sukh hamahu saach kar jaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: but I have judged that pleasure to be true. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਸੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: sanakaadhik naaradh mun sekhaa ||
verses.translation: Even sages like Sanak and Naarad, and the thousand-headed serpent,

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin bhee tan meh man nahee pekhaa ||3||
verses.translation: did not see the mind within the body. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis man kau koiee khojahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Anyone can search for this mind, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਤਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tan chhooTe man kahaa samaiee ||4||
verses.translation: When it escapes from the body, where does the mind go? ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਨਾਮਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jaidheau naamaa(n) ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, Jai Dayv and Naam Dayv

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bhagat kai prem in hee hai jaanaa(n) ||5||
verses.translation: came to know this, through loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis man kau nahee aavan jaanaa ||
verses.translation: This mind does not come or go.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jis kaa bharam giaa tin saach pachhaanaa ||6||
verses.translation: One whose doubt is dispelled, knows the Truth. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis man kau roop na rekhiaa kaiee ||
verses.translation: This mind has no form or outline.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: hukame hoiaa hukam boojh samaiee ||7||
verses.translation: By God's Command it was created; understanding God's Command, it will be absorbed into Him again. ||7||

verses.original: ਇਸ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: eis man kaa koiee jaanai bheau ||
verses.translation: Does anyone know the secret of this mind?

verses.original: ਇਹ ਮਨਿ ਲੀਣ ਭਏ ਸੁਖਦੇਉ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: eeh man leen bhe sukhadheau ||8||
verses.translation: This mind shall merge into the Lord, the Giver of peace and pleasure. ||8||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਏਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau ek ar sagal sareeraa ||
verses.translation: There is One Soul, and it pervades all bodies.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੯॥੧॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: eis man kau rav rahe kabeeraa ||9||1||36||
verses.translation: Kabeer dwells upon this Mind. ||9||1||36||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee guaareree ||
verses.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree:

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis ek naam jo jaage ||
verses.translation: Those who are awake to the One Name, day and night

verses.original: ਕੇਤਕ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ketak sidh bhe liv laage ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - many of them have become Siddhas - perfect spiritual beings - with their consciousness attuned to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhak sidh sagal mun haare ||
verses.translation: The seekers, the Siddhas and the silent sages have all lost the game.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕਲਿਪ ਤਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek naam kalip tar taare ||1||
verses.translation: The One Name is the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree, which saves them and carries them across. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo har hare su hoh na aanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are rejuvenated by the Lord, do not belong to any other.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer raam naam pachhaanaa ||2||37||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, they realize the Name of the Lord. ||2||37||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਭੀ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਭੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee bhee soraTh bhee ||
verses.translation: Gauree And Also Sorat'h:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਿਲਜ ਲਾਜ ਤੋੁਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: re jeea nilaj laaj tuoh naahee ||
verses.translation: O shameless being, don't you feel ashamed?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ ਕਤ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har taj kat kaahoo ke jaa(n)hee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You have forsaken the Lord - now where will you go? Unto whom will you turn? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ko Thaakur uoochaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: One whose Lord and Master is the highest and most exalted

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਸੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so jan par ghar jaat na sohee ||1||
verses.translation: - it is not proper for him to go to the house of another. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: so saahib rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: That Lord and Master is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sa(n)g naahee har dhoor ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord is always with us; He is never far away. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: kavalaa charan saran hai jaa ke ||
verses.translation: Even Maya takes to the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu jan kaa naahee ghar taa ke ||3||
verses.translation: Tell me, what is there which is not in His home? ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kouoo kahai jaas kee baataa ||
verses.translation: Everyone speaks of Him; He is All-powerful.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: so sa(n)mrath nij pat hai dhaataa ||4||
verses.translation: He is His Own Master; He is the Giver. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahai kabeer pooran jag soiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, he alone is perfect in this world,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: jaa ke hiradhai avar na hoiee ||5||38||
verses.translation: in whose heart there is none other than the Lord. ||5||38||

verses.original: ਕਉਨੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit: kaun ko poot pitaa ko kaa ko ||
verses.translation: Whose son is he? Whose father is he?

verses.original: ਕਉਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਕੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੰਤਾਪੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaun marai ko dhei sa(n)taapo ||1||
verses.translation: Who dies? Who inflicts pain? ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਠਗ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har Thag jag kau Thagauree laiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the thug, who has drugged and robbed the whole world.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਓਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਅਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ke biog kaise jeeaau meree maiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am separated from the Lord; how can I survive, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਉਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaun ko purakh kaun kee naaree ||
verses.translation: Whose husband is he? Whose wife is she?

verses.original: ਇਆ ਤਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eiaa tat leh sareer bichaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Contemplate this reality within your body. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਠਗ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer Thag siau man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and satisfied with the thug.

verses.original: ਗਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਠਗੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: giee Thagauree Thag pahichaaniaa ||3||39||
verses.translation: The effects of the drug have vanished, since I recognized the thug. ||3||39||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ab mo kau bhe raajaa raam sahaiee ||
verses.translation: Now, the Lord, my King, has become my help and support.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਟਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran kaT param gat paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have cut away birth and death, and attained the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਓ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)gat dheeo ralai ||
verses.translation: He has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੇ ਲੀਓ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhoot te leeo chhaddai ||
verses.translation: He has rescued me from the five demons.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam japau jap rasanaa ||
verses.translation: I chant with my tongue and meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਮੋਲ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: amol dhaas kar leeno apanaa ||1||
verses.translation: He has made me his own slave. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੋ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur keeno paraupakaar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has blessed me with His generosity.

verses.original: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kaadd leen saagar sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: He has lifted me up, out of the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau laagee preet ||
verses.translation: I have fallen in love with His Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh basai nitaa nit cheet ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe dwells continually within my consciousness. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਅੰਗਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa tapat bujhiaa a(n)giaar ||
verses.translation: The burning fire of Maya has been extinguished.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man sa(n)tokh naam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: My mind is contented with the Support of the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal poor rahe prabh suaamee ||
verses.translation: God, the Lord and Master, is totally permeating the water and the land.

verses.original: ਜਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jat pekhau tat a(n)tarajaamee ||3||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: apanee bhagat aap hee dhiraRaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself has implanted His devotional worship within me.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: poorab likhat miliaa mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: By pre-ordained destiny, one meets Him, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: jis kirapaa kare tis pooran saaj ||
verses.translation: When He grants His Grace, one is perfectly fulfilled.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥੪॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: kabeer ko suaamee gareeb nivaaj ||4||40||
verses.translation: Kabeer's Lord and Master is the Cherisher of the poor. ||4||40||

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਥਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jal hai sootak thal hai sootak sootak opat hoiee ||
verses.translation: There is pollution in the water, and pollution on the land; whatever is born is polluted.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੇ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੂਏ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਪਰਜ ਬਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janame sootak mooe fun sootak sootak paraj bigoiee ||1||
verses.translation: There is pollution in birth, and more pollution in death; all beings are ruined by pollution. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਕਉਨ ਪਵੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu re pa(n)ddeeaa kaun paveetaa ||
verses.translation: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: who is clean and pure?

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa giaan japahu mere meetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਬੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: nainahu sootak bainahu sootak sootak sravanee hoiee ||
verses.translation: There is pollution in the eyes, and pollution in speech; there is pollution in the ears as well.

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਰੈ ਰਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat sootak laagai sootak parai rasoiee ||2||
verses.translation: Standing up and sitting down, one is polluted; one's kitchen is polluted as well. ||2||

verses.original: ਫਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੀ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: faasan kee bidh sabh kouoo jaanai chhooTan kee ik koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone knows how to be caught, but hardly anyone knows how to escape.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer raam ridhai bichaarai sootak tinai na hoiee ||3||41||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, those who meditate on the Lord within their hearts, are not polluted. ||3||41||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਝਗਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jhagaraa ek niberahu raam ||
verses.translation: Resolve this one conflict for me, O Lord,

verses.original: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੌ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jau tum apane jan sau kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: if you require any work from Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾ ਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih man baddaa k jaa sau man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: Is this mind greater, or the One to whom the mind is attuned?

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਬਡਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam baddaa kai raameh jaaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: Is the Lord greater, or one who knows the Lord? ||1||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa baddaa k jaas upaiaa ||
verses.translation: Is Brahma greater, or the One who created Him?

verses.original: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bedh baddaa k jahaa(n) te aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Are the Vedas greater, or the One from which they came? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer hau bhiaa udhaas ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have become depressed;

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: teerath baddaa k har kaa dhaas ||3||42||
verses.translation: is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage greater, or the slave of the Lord? ||3||42||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee chetee ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Chaytee:

verses.original: ਦੇਖੌ ਭਾਈ ਗੵਾਨ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਆਂਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhau bhaiee gayeaan kee aaiee aa(n)dhee ||
verses.translation: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny, the storm of spiritual wisdom has come.

verses.original: ਸਭੈ ਉਡਾਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਾਂਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabhai uddaanee bhram kee TaaTee rahai na maiaa baa(n)dhee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It has totally blown away the thatched huts of doubt, and torn apart the bonds of Maya. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਚਿਤੇ ਕੀ ਦੁਇ ਥੂਨਿ ਗਿਰਾਨੀ ਮੋਹ ਬਲੇਡਾ ਟੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhuchite kee dhui thoon giraanee moh baleddaa TooTaa ||
verses.translation: The two pillars of double-mindedness have fallen, and the beams of emotional attachment have come crashing down.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਛਾਨਿ ਪਰੀ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਫੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tisanaa chhaan paree dhar uoopar dhuramat bhaa(n)ddaa fooTaa ||1||
verses.translation: The thatched roof of greed has caved in, and the pitcher of evil-mindedness has been broken. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਂਧੀ ਪਾਛੇ ਜੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਖੈ ਤਿਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: aa(n)dhee paachhe jo jal barakhai teh teraa jan bheenaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Your servant is drenched with the rain that has fallen in this storm.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਉਦੈ ਭਾਨੁ ਜਬ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer man bhiaa pragaasaa udhai bhaan jab cheenaa ||2||43||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, my mind became enlightened, when I saw the sun rise. ||2||43||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ
verses.translit: gauRee chetee
verses.translation: Gauree Chaytee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jas suneh na har gun gaaveh ||
verses.translation: They do not listen to the Lord's Praises, and they do not sing the Lord's Glories,

verses.original: ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਗਿਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baatan hee asamaan giraaveh ||1||
verses.translation: but they try to bring down the sky with their talk. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aaise logan siau kiaa kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: What can anyone say to such people?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਜ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਡਰਾਨੇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo prabh ke'ee bhagat te baahaj tin te sadhaa ddaraane raheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You should always be careful around those whom God has excluded from His devotional worship. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ਚੁਰੂ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aap na dheh churoo bhar paanee ||
verses.translation: They do not offer even a handful of water,

verses.original: ਤਿਹ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਜਿਹ ਗੰਗਾ ਆਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: teh ni(n)dheh jeh ga(n)gaa aanee ||2||
verses.translation: while they slander the one who brought forth the Ganges. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੈਠਤ ਉਠਤ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਚਾਲਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: baiThat uThat kuTilataa chaaleh ||
verses.translation: Sitting down or standing up, their ways are crooked and evil.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਘਾਲਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap ge aauran hoo ghaaleh ||3||
verses.translation: They ruin themselves, and then they ruin others. ||3||

verses.original: ਛਾਡਿ ਕੁਚਰਚਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: chhaadd kucharachaa aan na jaaneh ||
verses.translation: They know nothing except evil talk.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਹੂ ਕੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: brahamaa hoo ko kahio na maaneh ||4||
verses.translation: They would not even obey Brahma's orders. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap ge aauran hoo khoveh ||
verses.translation: They themselves are lost, and they mislead others as well.

verses.original: ਆਗਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਸੋਵਹਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aag lagai ma(n)dhar mai soveh ||5||
verses.translation: They set their own temple on fire, and then they fall asleep within it. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਵਰਨ ਹਸਤ ਆਪ ਹਹਿ ਕਾਂਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: avaran hasat aap heh kaa(n)ne ||
verses.translation: They laugh at others, while they themselves are one-eyed.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਜਾਨੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: tin kau dhekh kabeer lajaane ||6||1||44||
verses.translation: Seeing them, Kabeer is embarrassed. ||6||1||44||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ
verses.translit: raag gauRee bairaagan kabeer jee
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਪਿਤਰ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਏਂ ਸਿਰਾਧ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat pitar na maanai kouoo mooe(n) siraadh karaahee ||
verses.translation: He does not honor his ancestors while they are alive, but he holds feasts in their honor after they have died.

verses.original: ਪਿਤਰ ਭੀ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਊਆ ਕੂਕਰ ਖਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pitar bhee bapure kahu kiau paaveh kuooaa kookar khaahee ||1||
verses.translation: Tell me, how can his poor ancestors receive what the crows and the dogs have eaten up? ||1||

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau kusal bataavahu koiee ||
verses.translation: If only someone would tell me what real happiness is!

verses.original: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kusal kusal karate jag binasai kusal bhee kaise hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Speaking of happiness and joy, the world is perishing. How can happiness be found? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: maaTee ke kar dhevee dhevaa tis aagai jeeau dhehee ||
verses.translation: Making gods and goddesses out of clay, people sacrifice living beings to them.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਪਿਤਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaise pitar tumaare kahe'eeh aapan kahiaa na lehee ||2||
verses.translation: Such are your dead ancestors, who cannot ask for what they want. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਜੀਉ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਕਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sarajeeau kaaTeh nirajeeau poojeh a(n)t kaal kau bhaaree ||
verses.translation: You murder living beings and worship lifeless things; at your very last moment, you shall suffer in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਭੈ ਡੂਬੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee bhai ddoobe sa(n)saaree ||3||
verses.translation: You do not know the value of the Lord's Name; you shall drown in the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhevee dhevaa poojeh ddoleh paarabraham nahee jaanaa ||
verses.translation: You worship gods and goddesses, but you do not know the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer akul nahee chetiaa bikhiaa siau lapaTaanaa ||4||1||45||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, you have not remembered the Lord who has no ancestors; you are clinging to your corrupt ways. ||4||1||45||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਐਸੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai marai fun jeevai aaise su(n)n samaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who remains dead while yet alive, will live even after death; thus he merges into the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan raheeaai bahuR na bhavajal paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Remaining pure in the midst of impurity, he will never again fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਐਸਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam aaisaa kheer biloieeaai ||
verses.translation: O my Lord, this is the milk to be churned.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਓਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat manooaa asathir raakhahu in bidh a(n)mrit peeoieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, hold your mind steady and stable, and in this way, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਲ ਛੇਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪਦੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai baan bajar kal chhedhee pragaTiaa padh paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru's arrow has pierced the hard core of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and the state of enlightenment has dawned.

verses.original: ਸਕਤਿ ਅਧੇਰ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sakat adher jevaRee bhram chookaa nihachal siv ghar baasaa ||2||
verses.translation: In the darkness of Maya, I mistook the rope for the snake, but that is over, and now I dwell in the eternal home of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੈ ਧਨਖੁ ਚਢਾਈਐ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tin bin baanai dhanakh chaddaieeaai ih jag bedhiaa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Maya has drawn her bow without an arrow, and has pierced this world, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬੂਡੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਵੈ ਡੋਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis booddee pavan jhulaavai ddor rahee liv laiee ||3||
verses.translation: The drowning person is blown around in the ten directions by the wind, but I hold tight to the string of the Lord's Love. ||3||

verses.original: ਉਨਮਨਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aunaman manooaa su(n)n samaanaa dhubidhaa dhuramat bhaagee ||
verses.translation: The disturbed mind has been absorbed in the Lord; duality and evil-mindedness have run away.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਨਭਉ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer anabhau ik dhekhiaa raam naam liv laagee ||4||2||46||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have seen the One Lord, the Fearless One; I am attuned to the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||46||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee bairaagan tipadhe ||
verses.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Thi-Padhay:

verses.original: ਉਲਟਤ ਪਵਨ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਖਟੁ ਭੇਦੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aulaTat pavan chakar khaT bhedhe surat su(n)n anaraagee ||
verses.translation: I turned my breath inwards, and pierced through the six chakras of the body, and my awareness was centered on the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavai na jai marai na jeevai taas khoj bairaagee ||1||
verses.translation: Search for the One who does not come or go, who does not die and is not born, O renunciate. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man man hee ulaT samaanaa ||
verses.translation: My mind has turned away from the world, and is absorbed in the Mind of God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਅਵਰੈ ਨਾਤਰੁ ਥਾ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh akal bhiee avarai naatar thaa begaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, my understanding has been changed; otherwise, I was totally ignorant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਵਰੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: nivarai dhoor dhoor fun nivarai jin jaisaa kar maaniaa ||
verses.translation: That which was near has become distant, and again, that which was distant is near, for those who realize the Lord as He is.

verses.original: ਅਲਉਤੀ ਕਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਇਆ ਬਰੇਡਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: alautee kaa jaise bhiaa bareddaa jin peeaa tin jaaniaa ||2||
verses.translation: It is like the sugar water made from the candy; only one who drinks it knows its taste. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਥਾ ਕਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: teree niragun kathaa kai siau kaheeaai aaisaa koi bibekee ||
verses.translation: Unto whom should I speak Your speech, O Lord; it is beyond the three qualities. Is there anyone with such discerning wisdom?

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਪਲੀਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਝਲ ਦੇਖੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer jin dheeaa paleetaa tin taisee jhal dhekhee ||3||3||47||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, as is the fuse which you apply, so is the flash you will see. ||3||3||47||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਤਹ ਪਾਵਸ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਧੂਪ ਨਹੀ ਛਹੀਆ ਤਹ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: teh paavas si(n)dh dhoop nahee chhaheeaa teh utapat paralau naahee ||
verses.translation: There is no rainy season, ocean, sunshine or shade, no creation or destruction there.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeevan mrit na dhukh sukh biaapai su(n)n samaadh dhouoo teh naahee ||1||
verses.translation: No life or death, no pain or pleasure is felt there. There is only the Primal Trance of Samaadhi, and no duality. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj kee akath kathaa hai niraaree ||
verses.translation: The description of the state of intuitive poise is indescribable and sublime.

verses.original: ਤੁਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਚਢੈ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮੁਕਾਤੀ ਹਲੁਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tul nahee chaddai jai na mukaatee halukee lagai na bhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is not measured, and it is not exhausted. It is neither light nor heavy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aradh uradh dhouoo teh naahee raat dhinas teh naahee ||
verses.translation: Neither lower nor upper worlds are there; neither day nor night are there.

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਹਾ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jal nahee pavan paavak fun naahee satigur tahaa samaahee ||2||
verses.translation: There is no water, wind or fire; there, the True Guru is contained. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar rahai nira(n)tar gur kirapaa te laheeaai ||
verses.translation: The Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord dwells there within Himself; by Guru's Grace, He is found.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥੪॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer bal jaau gur apune satasa(n)gat mil raheeaai ||3||4||48||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||4||48||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਸਾਹੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: paap pu(n)n dhui bail bisaahe pavan poojee paragaasio ||
verses.translation: With both sin and virtue, the ox of the body is purchased; the air of the breath is the capital which has appeared.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੂਣਿ ਭਰੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਟਾਂਡ ਬਿਸਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa goon bharee ghaT bheetar in bidh Taa(n)dd bisaahio ||1||
verses.translation: The bag on its back is filled with desire; this is how we purchase the herd. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa naik raam hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: My Lord is such a wealthy merchant!

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਬਨਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal sa(n)saar keeo banajaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has made the whole world his peddler. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਏ ਜਗਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਤਰੰਗ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh dhui bhe jagaatee man tara(n)g baTavaaraa ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire and anger are the tax-collectors, and the waves of the mind are the highway robbers.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹਿ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat mil dhaan nibereh Taa(n)ddaa utario paaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The five elements join together and divide up their loot. This is how our herd is disposed of! ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਬ ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu ab aaisee ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: This is the state of affairs now!

verses.original: ਘਾਟੀ ਚਢਤ ਬੈਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਚਲੋ ਗੋਨਿ ਛਿਟਕਾਈ ॥੩॥੫॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: ghaaTee chaddat bail ik thaakaa chalo gon chhiTakaiee ||3||5||49||
verses.translation: Going uphill, the ox has grown weary; throwing off his load, he continues on his journey. ||3||5||49||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee pa(n)chapadhaa ||
verses.translation: Gauree, Panch-Padhay:

verses.original: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: pevakaRai dhin chaar hai saahuraRai jaanaa ||
verses.translation: For a few short days, the soul-bride stays in her parent's house; then, she must go to her in-laws.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਆਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa lok na jaaniee moorakh eaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: The blind, foolish and ignorant people do not know this. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਡਡੀਆ ਬਾਧੈ ਧਨ ਖੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu ddaddeeaa baadhai dhan khaRee ||
verses.translation: Tell me, why is the bride wearing her ordinary clothes?

verses.original: ਪਾਹੂ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਮੁਕਲਾਊ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paahoo ghar aae mukalaauoo aae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The guests have arrived at her home, and her Husband has come to take her away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਓਹ ਜਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਖੂਹੜੀ ਕਉਨ ਲਾਜੁ ਵਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: oh j dhisai khoohaRee kaun laaj vahaaree ||
verses.translation: Who has lowered the rope of the breath down, into the well of the world which we see?

verses.original: ਲਾਜੁ ਘੜੀ ਸਿਉ ਤੂਟਿ ਪੜੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laaj ghaRee siau tooT paRee uTh chalee panihaaree ||2||
verses.translation: The rope of the breath breaks away from the pitcher of the body, and the water-carrier gets up and departs. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saahib hoi dhiaal kirapaa kare apunaa kaaraj savaare ||
verses.translation: When the Lord and Master is kind and grants His Grace, then her affairs are all resolved.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa sohaagan jaaneeaai gur sabadh beechaare ||3||
verses.translation: Then she is known as the happy soul-bride, if she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kirat kee baa(n)dhee sabh firai dhekhahu beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Bound by the actions she has committed, she wanders around - see this and understand.

verses.original: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: es no kiaa aakheeaai kiaa kare vichaaree ||4||
verses.translation: What can we say to her? What can the poor soul-bride do? ||4||

verses.original: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਚਿਤ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhiee niraasee uTh chalee chit ba(n)dh na dheeraa ||
verses.translation: Disappointed and hopeless, she gets up and departs. There is no support or encouragement in her consciousness.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: har kee charanee laag rahu bhaj saran kabeeraa ||5||6||50||
verses.translation: So remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet, and hurry to His Sanctuary, Kabeer! ||5||6||50||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree :

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jogee kaheh jog bhal meeThaa avar na dhoojaa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Yogi says that Yoga is good and sweet, and nothing else is, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਰੁੰਡਿਤ ਮੁੰਡਿਤ ਏਕੈ ਸਬਦੀ ਏਇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ru(n)ddit mu(n)ddit ekai sabadhee ei kaheh sidh paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Those who shave their heads, and those who amputate their limbs, and those who utter only a single word, all say that they have attained the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: har bin bharam bhulaane a(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, the blind ones are deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ ਆਪੁ ਛੁਟਕਾਵਨਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa peh jaau aap chhuTakaavan te baadhe bahu fa(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: And those, to whom I go to find release - they themselves are bound by all sorts of chains. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh te upajee tahee samaanee ieh bidh bisaree tab hee ||
verses.translation: The soul is re-absorbed into that from which it originated, when one leaves this path of errors.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਏਹਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਡ ਹਮ ਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit gunee soor ham dhaate eh kaheh badd ham hee ||2||
verses.translation: The scholarly Pandits, the virtuous, the brave and the generous, all assert that they alone are great. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh bujhaae soiee boojhai bin boojhe kiau raheeaai ||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Without understanding, what can anyone do?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur milai a(n)dheraa chookai in bidh maanak laheeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled, and in this way, the jewel is obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਬਾਵੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: taj baave dhaahane bikaaraa har padh dhiraR kar raheeaai ||
verses.translation: Give up the evil actions of your left and right hands, and grasp hold of the Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer goo(n)gai guR khaiaa poochhe te kiaa kaheeaai ||4||7||51||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the mute has tasted the molasses, but what can he say about it if he is asked? ||4||7||51||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee poorabee kabeer jee ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਹ ਕਛੁ ਅਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh kachh ahaa tahaa kichh naahee pa(n)ch tat teh naahee ||
verses.translation: Where something existed, now there is nothing. The five elements are no longer there.

verses.original: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਬੰਦੇ ਏ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eiRaa pi(n)gulaa sukhaman ba(n)dhe e avagan kat jaahee ||1||
verses.translation: The Ida, the Pingala and the Sushmanaa - O human being, how can the breaths through these be counted now? ||1||

verses.original: ਤਾਗਾ ਤੂਟਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੋਲਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taagaa tooTaa gagan binas giaa teraa bolat kahaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: The string has been broken, and the Sky of the Tenth Gate has been destroyed. Where has your speech gone?

verses.original: ਏਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eh sa(n)saa mo kau anadhin biaapai mo kau ko na kahai samajhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This cynicism afflicts me, night and day; who can explain this to me and help me understand? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਬਰਭੰਡੁ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh barabha(n)dd pi(n)dd teh naahee rachanahaar teh naahee ||
verses.translation: Where the world is - the body is not there; the mind is not there either.

verses.original: ਜੋੜਨਹਾਰੋ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: joRanahaaro sadhaa ateetaa ieh kaheeaai kis maahee ||2||
verses.translation: The Joiner is forever unattached; now, within whom is the soul said to be contained? ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੈ ਨ ਤੋੜੀ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: joRee juRai na toRee tooTai jab lag hoi binaasee ||
verses.translation: By joining the elements, people cannot join them, and by breaking, they cannot be broken, until the body perishes.

verses.original: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaa ko Thaakur kaa ko sevak ko kaahoo kai jaasee ||3||
verses.translation: Of whom is the soul the master, and of whom is it the servant? Where, and to whom does it go? ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਬਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer liv laag rahee hai jahaa base dhin raatee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have lovingly focused my attention on that place where the Lord dwells, day and night.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: auaa kaa maram ohee par jaanai oh tau sadhaa abinaasee ||4||1||52||
verses.translation: Only He Himself truly knows the secrets of His mystery; He is eternal and indestructible. ||4||1||52||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਕੰਨੀ ਮੁੰਦਾ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: surat simirat dhui ka(n)nee mu(n)dhaa paramit baahar khi(n)thaa ||
verses.translation: Let contemplation and intuitive meditation be your two ear-rings, and true wisdom your patched overcoat.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਕਲਪ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਪੰਥਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: su(n)n gufaa meh aasan baisan kalap bibarajit pa(n)thaa ||1||
verses.translation: In the cave of silence, dwell in your Yogic posture; let the subjugation of desire be your spiritual path. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਮੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: mere raajan mai bairaagee jogee ||
verses.translation: O my King, I am a Yogi, a hermit, a renunciate.

verses.original: ਮਰਤ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: marat na sog biogee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I do not die or suffer pain or separation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਟੂਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਸਮਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd meh si(n)n(g)ee meraa baTooaa sabh jag bhasamaadhaaree ||
verses.translation: The solar systems and galaxies are my horn; the whole world is the bag to carry my ashes.

verses.original: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਲੁ ਪਲਟੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taaRee laagee tirapal palaTeeaai chhooTai hoi pasaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Eliminating the three qualities and finding release from this world is my deep meditation. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰਬਾ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਰਦ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: man pavan dhui too(n)baa karee hai jug jug saaradh saajee ||
verses.translation: My mind and breath are the two gourds of my fiddle, and the Lord of all the ages is its frame.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਭਈ ਤੰਤੀ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: thir bhiee ta(n)tee tooTas naahee anahadh ki(n)guree baajee ||3||
verses.translation: The string has become steady, and it does not break; this guitar vibrates with the unstruck melody. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun man magan bhe hai poore maiaa ddol na laagee ||
verses.translation: Hearing it, the mind is enraptured and becomes perfect; it does not waver, and it is not affected by Maya.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer taa kau punarap janam nahee khel gio bairaagee ||4||2||53||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, the bairaagee, the renunciate, who has played such a game, is not reincarnated again into the world of form and substance. ||4||2||53||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਗਜ ਨਵ ਗਜ ਦਸ ਗਜ ਇਕੀਸ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਤਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gaj nav gaj dhas gaj ikees pureeaa ek tanaiee ||
verses.translation: Nine yards, ten yards, and twenty-one yards - weave these into the full piece of cloth;

verses.original: ਸਾਠ ਸੂਤ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saaTh soot nav kha(n)dd bahatar paaT lago adhikaiee ||1||
verses.translation: take the sixty threads and add nine joints to the seventy-two on the loom. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਈ ਬੁਨਾਵਨ ਮਾਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: giee bunaavan maaho ||
verses.translation: Life weaves itself into its patterns.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਛੋਡਿਐ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghar chhoddiaai jai julaaho ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Leaving her home, the soul goes to the world of the weaver. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਜੀ ਨ ਮਿਨੀਐ ਤੋਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪਾਚਨੁ ਸੇਰ ਅਢਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gajee na mineeaai tol na tuleeaai paachan ser addaiee ||
verses.translation: This cloth cannot be measured in yards or weighed with weights; its food is two and a half measures.

verses.original: ਜੌ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਚਨੁ ਬੇਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਝਗਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਘਰਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jau kar paachan beg na paavai jhagar karai gharahaiee ||2||
verses.translation: If it does not obtain food right away, it quarrels with the master of the house. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਿਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਠ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਸ ਇਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਤ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhin kee baiTh khasam kee barakas ieh belaa kat aaiee ||
verses.translation: How many days will you sit here, in opposition to your Lord and Master? When will this opportunity come again?

verses.original: ਛੂਟੇ ਕੂੰਡੇ ਭੀਗੈ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਚਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ਰੀਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chhooTe koo(n)dde bheegai pureeaa chalio julaaho reesaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Leaving his pots and pans, and the bobbins wet with his tears, the weaver soul departs in jealous anger. ||3||

verses.original: ਛੋਛੀ ਨਲੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਨਤਰ ਰਹੀ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: chhochhee nalee ta(n)t nahee nikasai natar rahee urajhaiee ||
verses.translation: The wind-pipe is empty now; the thread of the breath does not come out any longer. The thread is tangled; it has run out.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਈਹਾ ਰਹੁ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: chhodd pasaar ieehaa rahu bapuree kahu kabeer samajhaiee ||4||3||54||
verses.translation: So renounce the world of form and substance while you remain here, O poor soul; says Kabeer: you must understand this! ||4||3||54||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਮਿਲੀ ਕਿੰਬਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ek jot ekaa milee ki(n)baa hoi mahoi ||
verses.translation: When one light merges into another, what becomes of it then?

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jit ghaT naam na uoopajai fooT marai jan soi ||1||
verses.translation: That person, within whose heart the Lord's Name does not well up - may that person burst and die! ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: saaval su(n)dhar raamieeaa ||
verses.translation: O my dark and beautiful Lord,

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man laagaa toh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: my mind is attached to You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadh milai sidh paieeaai k eh jog k bhog ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Holy, the perfection of the Siddhas is obtained. What good is Yoga or indulgence in pleasures?

verses.original: ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhuh mil kaaraj uoopajai raam naam sa(n)jog ||2||
verses.translation: When the two meet together, the business is conducted, and the link with the Lord's Name is established. ||2||

verses.original: ਲੋਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: log jaanai ih geet hai ih tau braham beechaar ||
verses.translation: People believe that this is just a song, but it is a meditation on God.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਸੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau kaasee upadhes hoi maanas maratee baar ||3||
verses.translation: It is like the instructions given to the dying man at Benares. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee gaavai ko sunai har naamaa chit lai ||
verses.translation: Whoever sings or listens to the Lord's Name with conscious awareness

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer sa(n)saa nahee a(n)t param gat pai ||4||1||4||55||
verses.translation: - says Kabeer, without a doubt, in the end, he obtains the highest status. ||4||1||4||55||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਤੇ ਡੂਬੇ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jete jatan karat te ddoobe bhav saagar nahee taario re ||
verses.translation: Those who try to do things by their own efforts are drowned in the terrifying world-ocean; they cannot cross over.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karam dharam karate bahu sa(n)jam aha(n)budh man jaario re ||1||
verses.translation: Those who practice religious rituals and strict self-discipline - their egotistical pride shall consume their minds. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਤੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saas graas ko dhaato Thaakur so kiau manahu bisaario re ||
verses.translation: Your Lord and Master has given you the breath of life and food to sustain you; Oh, why have you forgotten Him?

verses.original: ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: heeraa laal amol janam hai kauddee badhalai haario re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Human birth is a priceless jewel, which has been squandered in exchange for a worthless shell. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਭੂਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa tirakhaa bhookh bhram laagee hiradhai naeh beechaario re ||
verses.translation: The thirst of desire and the hunger of doubt afflict you; you do not contemplate the Lord in your heart.

verses.original: ਉਨਮਤ ਮਾਨ ਹਿਰਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aunamat maan hirio man maahee gur kaa sabadh na dhaario re ||2||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with pride, you cheat yourself; you have not enshrined the Word of the Guru's Shabad within your mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਆਦ ਲੁਭਤ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਮਦ ਰਸ ਲੈਤ ਬਿਕਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: suaadh lubhat i(n)dhree ras prerio madh ras lait bikaario re ||
verses.translation: Those who are deluded by sensual pleasures, who are tempted by sexual delights and enjoy wine are corrupt.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਭਾਗ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਾਨੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karam bhaag sa(n)tan sa(n)gaane kaasaT loh udhaario re ||3||
verses.translation: But those who, through destiny and good karma, join the Society of the Saints, float over the ocean, like iron attached to wood. ||3||

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਅਬ ਦੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavat jon janam bhram thaake ab dhukh kar ham haario re ||
verses.translation: I have wandered in doubt and confusion, through birth and reincarnation; now, I am so tired. I am suffering in pain and wasting away.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer gur milat mahaa ras prem bhagat nisataario re ||4||1||5||56||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, meeting with the Guru, I have obtained supreme joy; my love and devotion have saved me. ||4||1||5||56||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਕਾਲਬੂਤ ਕੀ ਹਸਤਨੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: kaalaboot kee hasatanee man bauraa re chalat rachio jagadhees ||
verses.translation: Like the straw figure of a female elephant, fashioned to trap the bull elephant, O crazy mind, the Lord of the Universe has staged the drama of this world.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਇ ਗਜ ਬਸਿ ਪਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਹਿਓ ਸੀਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaam suaai gaj bas pare man bauraa re a(n)kas sahio sees ||1||
verses.translation: Attracted by the lure of sexual desire, the elephant is captured, O crazy mind, and now the halter is placed around its neck. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੁ ਸਮਝੁ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bikhai baach har raach samajh man bauraa re ||
verses.translation: So escape from corruption and immerse yourself in the Lord; take this advice, O crazy mind.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਰਾਮ ਜਹਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhai hoi na har bhaje man bauraa re gahio na raam jahaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You have not meditated fearlessly on the Lord, O crazy mind; you have not embarked upon the Lord's Boat. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਰਕਟ ਮੁਸਟੀ ਅਨਾਜ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: marakaT musaTee anaaj kee man bauraa re leenee haath pasaar ||
verses.translation: The monkey stretches out its hand, O crazy mind, and takes a handful of corn;

verses.original: ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਨਾਚਿਓ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chhooTan ko sahasaa pariaa man bauraa re naachio ghar ghar baar ||2||
verses.translation: now unable to escape, O crazy mind, it is made to dance door to door. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਗਹਿਓ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਮਾਯਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau nalanee sooaTaa gahio man bauraa re maayaa ih biauhaar ||
verses.translation: Like the parrot caught in the trap, O crazy mind, you trapped by the affairs of Maya.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaisaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa man bauraa re tiau pasario paasaar ||3||
verses.translation: Like the weak dye of the safflower, O crazy mind, so is the expanse of this world of form and substance. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਘਨੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਪੂਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: naavan kau teerath ghane man bauraa re poojan kau bahu dhev ||
verses.translation: There are so many holy shrines in which to bathe, O crazy mind, and so many gods to worship.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer chhooTan nahee man bauraa re chhooTan har kee sev ||4||1||6||57||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, you shall not be saved like this, O crazy mind; only by serving the Lord will you find release. ||4||1||6||57||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਦਹੈ ਪਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਗਨੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨੇਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: agan na dhahai pavan nahee maganai tasakar ner na aavai ||
verses.translation: Fire does not burn it, and the wind does not blow it away; thieves cannot get near it.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚਉਨੀ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan kar sa(n)chaunee so dhan kat hee na jaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Accumulate the wealth of the Lord's Name; that wealth does not go anywhere. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa dhan maadhau gobi(n)dh dharaneedhar ihai saar dhan kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: My wealth is God, the Lord of Wealth, the Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth: this is called the most excellent wealth.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo sukh prabh gobi(n)dh kee sevaa so sukh raaj na laheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The peace which is obtained by serving God, the Lord of the Universe - that peace cannot be found in kingdoms or power. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: eis dhan kaaran siv sanakaadhik khojat bhe udhaasee ||
verses.translation: Shiva and Sanak, in their search for this wealth, became Udaasees, and renounced the world.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man muka(n)dh jihabaa naarain parai na jam kee faasee ||2||
verses.translation: One whose mind is filled with the Lord of liberation, and whose tongue chants the Name of the Lord, shall not be caught by the noose of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: nij dhan giaan bhagat gur dheenee taas sumat man laagaa ||
verses.translation: My own wealth is the spiritual wisdom and devotion given by the Guru; my mind is held steady in perfect neutral balance.

verses.original: ਜਲਤ ਅੰਭ ਥੰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤ ਭਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jalat a(n)bh tha(n)bh man dhaavat bharam ba(n)dhan bhau bhaagaa ||3||
verses.translation: It is like water for the burning soul, like an anchoring support for the wandering mind; the bondage of doubt and fear is dispelled. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਮਦਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahai kabeer madhan ke maate hiradhai dhekh beechaaree ||
