verses.translation: Says Kabeer: O you who are intoxicated with sexual desire, reflect upon this in your heart, and see.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹਸਤੀ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: tum ghar laakh koT asavai hasatee ham ghar ek muraaree ||4||1||7||58||
verses.translation: Within your home there are hundreds of thousands, millions of horses and elephants; but within my home is the One Lord. ||4||1||7||58||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕਪਿ ਕੇ ਕਰ ਮੁਸਟਿ ਚਨਨ ਕੀ ਲੁਬਧਿ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: jiau kap ke kar musaT chanan kee lubadh na tiaag dhio ||
verses.translation: Like the monkey with a handful of grain, who will not let go because of greed

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਲਾਲਚ ਸਿਉ ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jo karam ke'ee laalach siau te fir gareh pario ||1||
verses.translation: - just so, all the deeds committed in greed ultimately become a noose around one's neck. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat bin birathe janam gio ||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship, human life passes away in vain.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat bhagavaan bhajan bin kahee na sach rahio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, without vibrating and meditating on the Lord God, one does not abide in Truth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘ੍ਰਾਉ ਲਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: jiau udhiaan kusam parafulit kineh na ghraau lio ||
verses.translation: Like the flower which blossoms in the wilderness with no one to enjoy its fragrance,

verses.original: ਤੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲ ਹਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taise bhramat anek jon meh fir fir kaal hio ||2||
verses.translation: so do people wander in reincarnation; over and over again, they are destroyed by Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਆ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਜੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: eiaa dhan joban ar sut dhaaraa pekhan kau ju dhio ||
verses.translation: This wealth, youth, children and spouse which the Lord has given you - this is all just a passing show.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਟਕਿ ਜੋ ਉਰਝੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿ ਲਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin hee maeh aTak jo urajhe i(n)dhree prer lio ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are caught and entangled in these are carried away by sensual desire. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਉਧ ਅਨਲ ਤਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਠਾਟੁ ਠਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: aaudh anal tan tin ko ma(n)dhar chahu dhis ThaaT Thio ||
verses.translation: Age is the fire, and the body is the house of straw; on all four sides, this play is being played out.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰਨ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਲਇਓ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer bhai saagar taran kau mai satigur oT lio ||4||1||8||59||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, to cross over the terriffying world-ocean, I have taken to the Shelter of the True Guru. ||4||1||8||59||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਗੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: paanee mailaa maaTee goree ||
verses.translation: The water of the sperm is cloudy, and the egg of the ovary is crimson.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eis maaTee kee putaree joree ||1||
verses.translation: From this clay, the puppet is fashioned. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai naahee kachh aaeh na moraa ||
verses.translation: I am nothing, and nothing is mine.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਸੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan dhan sabh ras gobi(n)dh toraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This body, wealth, and all delicacies are Yours, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eis maaTee meh pavan samaiaa ||
verses.translation: Into this clay, the breath is infused.

verses.original: ਝੂਠਾ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jhooThaa parapa(n)ch jor chalaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: By Your Power, You have set this false contrivance in motion. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੂ ਲਾਖ ਪਾਂਚ ਕੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kinahoo laakh paa(n)ch kee joree ||
verses.translation: Some collect hundreds of thousands of dollars,

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਗਗਰੀਆ ਫੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kee baar gagareeaa foree ||3||
verses.translation: but in the end, the pitcher of the body bursts. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਨੀਵ ਉਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer ik neev usaaree ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, that single foundation which you have laid

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੯॥੬੦॥
verses.translit: khin meh binas jai aha(n)kaaree ||4||1||9||60||
verses.translation: will be destroyed in an instant - you are so egotistical. ||4||1||9||60||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਉ ਜੀਅ ਐਸੇ ਐਸੇ ॥ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam japau jeea aaise aaise || dhraoo prahilaadh japio har jaise ||1||
verses.translation: Just as Dhroo and Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, so should you meditate on the Lord, O my soul. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal bharose tere ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, I have placed my faith in You;

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਬੇੜੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh paravaar chaRaiaa beRe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: along with all my family, I have come aboard Your boat. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaavai taa hukam manaavai ||
verses.translation: When it is pleasing to Him, then He inspires us to obey the Hukam of His Command.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਬੇੜੇ ਕਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eis beRe kau paar laghaavai ||2||
verses.translation: He causes this boat to cross over. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਐਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh aaisee budh samaanee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, such understanding is infused into me;

verses.original: ਚੂਕਿ ਗਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chook giee fir aavan jaanee ||3||
verses.translation: my comings and goings in reincarnation have ended. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer bhaj saarigapaanee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.

verses.original: ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: auravaar paar sabh eko dhaanee ||4||2||10||61||
verses.translation: In this world, in the world beyond and everywhere, He alone is the Giver. ||4||2||10||61||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee 9 ||
verses.translation: Gauree 9:

verses.original: ਜੋਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਜਉ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: jon chhaadd jau jag meh aaio ||
verses.translation: He leaves the womb, and comes into the world;

verses.original: ਲਾਗਤ ਪਵਨ ਖਸਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: laagat pavan khasam bisaraio ||1||
verses.translation: as soon as the air touches him, he forgets his Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeearaa har ke gunaa gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my soul, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: garabh jon meh uradh tap karataa ||
verses.translation: You were upside-down, living in the womb; you generated the intense meditative heat of 'tapas'.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਜਠਰ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tau jaThar agan meh rahataa ||2||
verses.translation: Then, you escaped the fire of the belly. ||2||

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh jon bhram aaio ||
verses.translation: After wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, you came.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ab ke chhuTake Thaur na Thaio ||3||
verses.translation: If you stumble and fall now, you shall find no home or place of rest. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer bhaj saarigapaanee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.

verses.translit: aavat dheesai jaat na jaanee ||4||1||11||62||
verses.translation: He is not seen to be coming or going; He is the Knower of all. ||4||1||11||62||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee ||
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee:

verses.original: ਸੁਰਗ ਬਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਾਛੀਐ ਡਰੀਐ ਨ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: surag baas na baachheeaai ddareeaai na narak nivaas ||
verses.translation: Don't wish for a home in heaven, and don't be afraid to live in hell.

verses.original: ਹੋਨਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: honaa hai so hoiee hai maneh na keejai aas ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever will be will be, so don't get your hopes up in your mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਮਈਆ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: ramieeaa gun gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te paieeaai param nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: from whom the most excellent treasure is obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਕਿਆ ਬਰਤੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa jap kiaa tap sa(n)jamo kiaa barat kiaa isanaan ||
verses.translation: What good is chanting, penance or self-mortification? What good is fasting or cleansing baths,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jab lag jugat na jaaneeaai bhaau bhagat bhagavaan ||2||
verses.translation: unless you know the way to worship the Lord God with loving devotion? ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਪੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਹਰਖੀਐ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)pai dhekh na harakheeaai bipat dhekh na roi ||
verses.translation: Don't feel so delighted at the sight of wealth, and don't weep at the sight of suffering and adversity.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸੰਪੈ ਤਿਉ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਧ ਨੇ ਰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau sa(n)pai tiau bipat hai bidh ne rachiaa so hoi ||3||
verses.translation: As is wealth, so is adversity; whatever the Lord proposes, comes to pass. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer ab jaaniaa sa(n)tan ridhai majhaar ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, now I know that the Lord dwells within the hearts of His Saints;

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਬਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: sevak so sevaa bhale jeh ghaT basai muraar ||4||1||12||63||
verses.translation: that servant performs the best service, whose heart is filled with the Lord. ||4||1||12||63||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਲੇਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: re man tero koi nahee khi(n)ch lei jin bhaar ||
verses.translation: O my mind, even if you carry someone's burden, they don't belong to you.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਖ ਬਸੇਰੋ ਪੰਖਿ ਕੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: birakh basero pa(n)kh ko taiso ih sa(n)saar ||1||
verses.translation: This world is like the perch of the bird on the tree. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam ras peeaa re ||
verses.translation: I drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਰਸ ਅਉਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh ras bisar ge ras aaur ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With the taste of this essence, I have forgotten all other tastes. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਉਰ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਈਐ ਜਉ ਆਪਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaur mue kiaa roieeaai jau aapaa thir na rahai ||
verses.translation: Why should we weep at the death of others, when we ourselves are not permanent?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo upajai so binas hai dhukh kar rovai balai ||2||
verses.translation: Whoever is born shall pass away; why should we cry out in grief? ||2||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਰਚੀ ਪੀਵਤ ਮਰਦਨ ਲਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: jeh kee upajee teh rachee peevat maradhan laag ||
verses.translation: We are re-absorbed into the One from whom we came; drink in the Lord's essence, and remain attached to Him.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੩॥੬੪॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer chit chetiaa raam simar bairaag ||3||2||13||64||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, my consciousness is filled with thoughts of remembrance of the Lord; I have become detached from the world. ||3||2||13||64||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree:

verses.original: ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਲੋਚਨ ਭਰੀ ਲੇ ਉਸਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)th nihaarai kaamanee lochan bharee le usaasaa ||
verses.translation: The bride gazes at the path, and sighs with tearful eyes.

verses.original: ਉਰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਪਗੁ ਨਾ ਖਿਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aur na bheejai pag naa khisai har dharasan kee aasaa ||1||
verses.translation: Her heart is not happy, but she does not retrace her steps, in hopes of seeing the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਡਹੁ ਨ ਕਾਗਾ ਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: auddahu na kaagaa kaare ||
verses.translation: So fly away, black crow,

verses.original: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: beg mileejai apune raam piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: so that I may quickly meet my Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer jeevan padh kaaran har kee bhagat kareejai ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, to obtain the status of eternal life, worship the Lord with devotion.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥੬੫॥
verses.translit: ek aadhaar naam naarain rasanaa raam raveejai ||2||1||14||65||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is my only Support; with my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name. ||2||1||14||65||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ੧੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee 11 ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree 11:

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਘਨ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਮਾਝ ਬਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਊਂ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aas paas ghan turasee kaa biravaa maajh banaa ras gaauoo(n) re ||
verses.translation: All around, there are thick bushes of sweet basil, and there in the midst of the forest, the Lord is singing with joy.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਆਰਨਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: auaa kaa saroop dhekh mohee guaaran mo kau chhodd na aau na jaahoo re ||1||
verses.translation: Beholding His wondrous beauty, the milk-maid was entranced, and said, ""Please don't leave me; please don't come and go!""||1||

verses.original: ਤੋਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ॥
verses.translit: toh charan man laago saari(n)gadhar ||
verses.translation: My mind is attached to Your Feet, O Archer of the Universe;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਬਡਭਾਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so milai jo baddabhaago ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: he alone meets You, who is blessed by great good fortune. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਨ ਹਰਨ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bi(n)dhraaban man haran manohar kirasan charaavat gaauoo re ||
verses.translation: In Brindaaban, where Krishna grazes his cows, he entices and fascinates my mind.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾਊ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa Thaakur tuhee saari(n)gadhar moh kabeeraa naauoo re ||2||2||15||66||
verses.translation: You are my Lord Master, the Archer of the Universe; my name is Kabeer. ||2||2||15||66||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ੧੨ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee poorabee 12 ||
verses.translation: Gauree Poorbee 12:

verses.original: ਬਿਪਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: bipal basatr kete hai pahire kiaa ban madhe baasaa ||
verses.translation: Many people wear various robes, but what is the use of living in the forest?

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ਧੋਖੇ ਕਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਬੋਰਿਓ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahaa bhiaa nar dhevaa dhokhe kiaa jal borio giaataa ||1||
verses.translation: What good does it do if a man burns incense before his gods? What good does it do to dip one's body in water? ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: jeeare jaahigaa mai jaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: O soul, I know that I will have to depart.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਗਤ ਸਮਝੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: abigat samajh iaanaa ||
verses.translation: You ignorant idiot: understand the Imperishable Lord.

verses.original: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jat jat dhekhau bahur na pekhau sa(n)g maiaa lapaTaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever you see, you will not see that again, but still, you cling to Maya. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee dhiaanee bahu upadhesee ih jag sagalo dha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: The spiritual teachers, meditators and the great preachers are all engrossed in these worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer ik raam naam bin iaa jag maiaa a(n)dhaa ||2||1||16||67||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the One Lord, this world is blinded by Maya. ||2||1||16||67||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੨ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee 12 ||
verses.translation: Gauree 12:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਛਾਡਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਡਾਂਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: man re chhaaddahu bharam pragaT hoi naachahu iaa maiaa ke ddaa(n)dde ||
verses.translation: O people, O victims of this Maya, abandon your doubts and dance out in the open.

verses.original: ਸੂਰੁ ਕਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪੈ ਸਤੀ ਕਿ ਸਾਂਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: soor k sanamukh ran te ddarapai satee k saa(n)chai bhaa(n)dde ||1||
verses.translation: What sort of a hero is one who is afraid to face the battle? What sort of satee is she who, when her time comes, starts collecting her pots and pans? ||1||

verses.original: ਡਗਮਗ ਛਾਡਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddagamag chhaadd re man bauraa ||
verses.translation: Stop your wavering, O crazy people!

verses.original: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਲੀਨੋ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਧਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ab tau jare mare sidh paieeaai leeno haath sa(n)dhauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Now that you have taken up the challenge of death, let yourself burn and die, and attain perfection. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh maiaa ke leene iaa bidh jagat bigootaa ||
verses.translation: The world is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya; in this way it is plundered and ruined.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਗਲ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer raajaa raam na chhoddau sagal uooch te uoochaa ||2||2||17||68||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, do not forsake the Lord, your Sovereign King, the Highest of the High. ||2||2||17||68||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੩ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee 13 ||
verses.translation: Gauree 13:

verses.original: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: furamaan teraa sirai uoopar fir na karat beechaar ||
verses.translation: Your Command is upon my head, and I no longer question it.

verses.original: ਤੁਹੀ ਦਰੀਆ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਰੀਆ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tuhee dhareeaa tuhee kareeaa tujhai te nisataar ||1||
verses.translation: You are the river, and You are the boatman; salvation comes from You. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੰਦੇ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਇਕਤੀਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhe ba(n)dhagee ikateeaar ||
verses.translation: O human being, embrace the Lord's meditation,

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰੋਸੁ ਧਰਉ ਕਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saahib ros dharau k piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: whether your Lord and Master is angry with you or in love with you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਫੂਲੁ ਜਈ ਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam teraa aadhaar meraa jiau fool jiee hai naar ||
verses.translation: Your Name is my Support, like the flower blossoming in the water.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜੀਆਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੬੯॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer gulaam ghar kaa jeeaai bhaavai maar ||2||18||69||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I am the slave of Your home; I live or die as You will. ||2||18||69||

verses.original: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gauRee ||
verses.translation: Gauree:

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨੰਦੁ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh jeea jon meh bhramat na(n)dh bahu thaako re ||
verses.translation: Wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, Krishna's father Nand was totally exhausted.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਲੀਓ ਹੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਬਡੋ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagat het avataar leeo hai bhaag baddo bapuraa ko re ||1||
verses.translation: Because of his devotion, Krishna was incarnated in his home; how great was the good fortune of this poor man! ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਨੰਦ ਕੋ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਨੰਦ ਸੁ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) ju kahat hau na(n)dh ko na(n)dhan na(n)dh su na(n)dhan kaa ko re ||
verses.translation: You say that Krishna was Nand's son, but whose son was Nand himself?

verses.original: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਨੰਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਥੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharan akaas dhaso dhis naahee tab ih na(n)dh kahaa tho re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When there was no earth or ether or the ten directions, where was this Nand then? ||1||Pause||
